title.en: China: English to be removed as a graded core subject?
title.zh: 中国：英语将不再是评分的核心科目？

summary.en: A university professor is calling for English to no longer be taught as a graded core subject in Chinese schools. Opponents argue that, in a globalized world, knowing English is beneficial for the country and career.
summary.zh: 一位大学教授呼吁在中国学校不再将英语作为评分的核心科目。反对者认为，在全球化的世界中，掌握英语对国家和个人职业发展都有益。

body.en:
A university professor is calling for English to no longer be taught as a graded core subject in Chinese schools. Opponents argue that, in a globalized world, knowing English benefits the country and one's career.

From business and academia to social media and entertainment — English is considered the dominant global language. One in five people on Earth actively uses this lingua franca. In China , a mathematics professor specializing in vector algebra is now challenging this dominance in no uncertain terms. Tang Jiafeng believes that English should be abolished as a core subject in elementary schools, secondary schools and universities.

Tang is convinced that no other country in the world has placed as much importance on English as China has.

"Our children desperately begin learning English even before they have properly mastered their native language. Yet we are a civilization that dates back thousands of years. English is just a tool. It's enough to be able to use it. The tradition of revering and emulating Western cultures must come to an end," Tang says in social media.

English is considered difficult in China, since the Chinese language does not use an alphabetic script. It is a required subject starting in third grade. It is graded on par with Chinese and mathematics on the entrance exam for secondary schools, the central exam after 9th grade, and the high school graduation exam. A maximum of 150 points can be earned on the latter.

"How many resources and how much time do our children, parents and schools invest in a subject that is completely irrelevant to the majority of people in their future professional lives?" the mathematician asks, explaining his position.

He became well-known because many of his students achieved full scores on state math exams; in the class of 2011, six students from a single class did so.

"Why cram for English when artificial intelligence can translate everything in seconds?" comments a user from Beijing.

Another suggestion from the southern province of Guangdong is to at least adjust the scoring — for example, to 120 points instead of 150 on the high school graduation exam.

Many parents invest in private tutoring that focuses specifically on exam questions. In addition, all bachelor's students must pass the English exam before being admitted to master's programs. Tang suspects that this could cause many young talents in the natural sciences to fail, even though they have great potential to become top researchers.

There is no question that English is also important for STEM subjects. Research on future-oriented topics is typically published in English. There are fears circulating online that cutting back on English instruction could lead to a decline in China's competitiveness. A prominent...
body.zh: 一位大学教授呼吁中国学校不再将英语作为分级核心科目来教授。反对者认为，在全球化的世界中，懂英语对国家和职业都有好处。 从商业和学术界到社交媒体和娱乐——英语被认为是全球主导语言。地球上五分之一的人积极使用这种通用语言。在中国，一位专门研究向量代数的数学教授现在正在毫不含糊地挑战这一主导地位。唐家峰认为，应该取消英语作为小学、中学和大学的核心科目。 唐坚信，世界上没有哪个国家像中国一样重视英语。 唐在社交媒体上表示：“我们的孩子在还没有真正掌握母语之前就拼命地开始学习英语。但我们是一个有着数千年历史的文明。英语只是一种工具，能够使用它就足够了。尊重和效仿西方文化的传统必须结束。” 英语在中国被认为很难，因为中文不使用字母文字。这是从三年级开始的必修科目。中学入学考试、九年级后的集中考试和高中毕业考试的成绩与语文和数学同等。后者最多可获得 150 点积分。 “我们的孩子、家长和学校在一个与大多数人未来职业生涯完全无关的主题上投入了多少资源和时间？”数学家问道，并解释了他的立场。 他之所以出名，是因为他的许多学生在州数学考试中取得了满分。 2011届的一个班有六名学生这样做了。 “当人工智能可以在几秒钟内翻译所有内容时，为什么还要死记硬背英语呢？”北京网友评论。 来自南方省份广东省的另一项建议是至少调整分数——例如，高中毕业考试的分数从150分调整为120分。 许多家长投资专门针对考试问题的私人辅导。此外，所有学士学生必须通过英语考试才能进入硕士课程。唐怀疑这可能会导致许多自然科学领域的年轻人才失败，尽管他们有成为顶尖研究人员的巨大潜力。 毫无疑问，英语对于 STEM 科目也很重要。面向未来的主题的研究通常以英文发表。网上流传着这样的担忧：削减英语教学可能会导致中国竞争力下降。一位杰出的...

reflection.en: The debate in China over English as a core subject highlights a tension between national identity and global connection. Proverbs 18:15 reminds us that the pursuit of knowledge is valuable, suggesting that wisdom involves discerning how best to acquire and apply learning in a complex world. Balancing national interests with the benefits of international...
reflection.zh: 中国关于英语作为核心科目的争论，凸显了国家认同与全球联系之间的紧张关系。箴言 18:15 提醒我们，追求知识是有价值的，这表明智慧在于辨别如何在复杂的世界中最好地获取和应用所学知识。平衡国家利益与国际交流的好处，是一项需要深思熟虑的挑战。

verse.textEn: The heart of the discerning acquires knowledge, for the ears of the wise seek it out.
verse.textZh: 聪明人的心得知识；智慧人的耳求知识。

title.en: EU unveils ‘buy European’ public procurement rules to counter China
title.zh: 欧盟公布“购买欧洲”公共采购规则以对抗中国

summary.en: European authorities and public bodies will be encouraged to buy more domestic goods and services when spending public money, as part of the EU's latest effort to counter China's economic might. The European Commission has proposed a significant overhaul of EU public procurement rules, aiming to boost European...
summary.zh: 作为欧盟最新对抗中国经济实力的举措的一部分，欧洲当局和公共机构在花费公共资金时将被鼓励购买更多国内商品和服务。欧盟委员会已提议对欧盟公共采购规则进行重大改革，旨在提振欧洲产业。

body.en: Authorities and public bodies to be urged to buy goods and services from Europe, but without binding quotas European authorities will be encouraged to buy more domestic goods and services when they spend public money under the EU latest effort to counter China’s economic might. In a further “Buy European” plan, the European Commission published proposals on Wednesday for a sweeping overhaul of EU public procurement rules. Continue reading...
body.zh: 敦促当局和公共机构从欧洲购买商品和服务，但没有约束性配额。根据欧盟对抗中国经济实力的最新举措，欧洲当局在花费公共资金时将被鼓励购买更多国内商品和服务。在进一步的“购买欧洲”计划中，欧盟委员会周三公布了对欧盟公共采购规则进行全面改革的提案。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Nations often seek to bolster their own economies through trade policies. The EU's new 'Buy European' initiative aims to strengthen domestic industries by directing public spending towards European goods and services. This highlights the complex interplay of national economies and the desire for self-sufficiency, a dynamic that calls for wisdom and fairness...
reflection.zh: 各国常常试图通过贸易政策来支撑本国经济。欧盟新的“购买欧洲”倡议旨在通过将公共支出导向欧洲商品和服务来加强国内产业。这凸显了国家经济之间复杂的相互作用，以及对自给自足的渴望，这种动态呼吁在所有交易中都要有智慧和公平。

verse.textEn: Yahweh detests dishonest scales, but accurate weights find favor with him.
verse.textZh: 诡诈的天平为雅伟所憎恶；公平的法码为他所喜悦。

title.en: Yuja review – portrait of star pianist who is intellectually curious and deeply musically attuned
title.zh: Yuja乐评——这位求知欲强、音乐造诣深厚的钢琴家画像

summary.en: Musician is also rattled to find her appearance gets far more attention than her playing in this reflective documentary from Lorna Tucker As well as her film about her own difficult teenage years, British director Lorna Tucker is probably best known for her documentaries on famous women with big personalities:...
summary.zh: 在这部由洛娜·塔克执导的反思性纪录片中，音乐家发现自己的外表比演奏更受关注，这让她感到不安。除了她关于自己艰难青少年时期的电影外，英国导演洛娜·塔克可能最出名的是她拍摄的关于个性鲜明的名人的纪录片：薇薇恩·韦斯特伍德（ Westwood: Punk, Icon, Activist ）、凯瑟琳·赫本（ Call Me...

body.en: Musician is also rattled to find her appearance gets far more attention than her playing in this reflective documentary from Lorna Tucker As well as her film about her own difficult teenage years , British director Lorna Tucker is probably best known for her documentaries on famous women with big personalities: Vivienne Westwood ( Westwood: Punk, Icon, Activist ), Katharine Hepburn (Call Me Kate) and Greta Garbo ( Garbo: Where Did You Go? ). Her latest subject, pianist Yuja Wang, is another high-achiever – but not someone with quite the same name recognition unless you’re a devotee of classical music, a field in which she is ranked among the very best alive. Wang certainly has a flamboyant side, expressed in her highly expressive, virtuoso performances and her sartorial style on stage. In fact some shocking pull quotes illustrate how her dress sense has been bizarrely over-examined in the press; she has been likened to a stripper for her outfits, and the New Yorker, of all publications, once described her as “fat” , which hardly seems germane to any discussion of her ability to play Tchaikovsky or Ligeti. But Wang’s biography and the texture of her daily life are very different from that of Tucker’s previous subjects. She was a child prodigy from an artistic Beijing family who came of age just in time to break records for views on YouTube. Sure, her life here looks glamorous in one way, with a lush New York apartment she barely ever sees because she’s constantly on the road. But her life is also one of perpetual practice and striving for perfection, the loneliness of the long-distance soloist. It’s a regimen that leaves almost no time for relationships or family, or even many friendships with peers who understand what she is going through – apart from a few mentors or collaborators such as fellow pianist Emanuel Ax or composer Teddy Abrams, with whom she recently won a Grammy. Still, she comes across as an effervescent character, intellectually curious and deeply attuned to the music she plays. Continue reading...
body.zh: 音乐家还惊讶地发现，在洛娜·塔克 (Lorna Tucker) 的这部反思性纪录片中，她的外表比她的演奏受到更多关注。除了她关于自己艰难的青少年时期的电影外，英国导演洛娜·塔克 (Lorna Tucker) 最出名的可能是她关于具有大个性的著名女性的纪录片：维维安·韦斯特伍德 (维维安·韦斯特伍德) (韦斯特伍德：朋克、偶像、激进分子)、凯瑟琳·赫本 (叫我凯特) 和葛丽泰·嘉宝 (嘉宝：你去哪儿了？)。她最新的对象钢琴家王羽佳是另一位成就斐然的人，但除非你是古典音乐的爱好者，否则她的知名度不会很高，而她在古典音乐领域被列为当今最优秀的音乐爱好者之一。王确实有华丽的一面，这体现在她极具表现力、精湛的表演和舞台上的服装风格上。事实上，一些令人震惊的引述说明了媒体如何奇怪地过度审视了她的着装品味。她因服装而被比作脱衣舞娘，所有出版物中的《纽约客》曾将她描述为“胖子”，这似乎与她扮演柴可夫斯基或利盖蒂的能力的任何讨论都没有关系。但王的传记和她的日常生活质感与塔克之前的主题有很大不同。她是来自北京一个艺术家庭的神童，成年后正好打破了 YouTube 上的观看次数记录。当然，她在这里的生活在某种程度上看起来很迷人，她几乎从未见过纽约的一套豪华公寓，因为她经常在路上。但她的生活也是一种不断练习和追求完美的生活，一种长距离独奏者的孤独。这种生活方式几乎没有时间留给人际关系或家庭，甚至没有时间与理解她正在经历的事情的同龄人建立友谊——除了一些导师或合作者，比如钢琴家伊曼纽尔·阿克斯(Emanuel Ax)或作曲家泰迪·艾布拉姆斯(Teddy Abrams)，她最近与他们一起赢得了格莱美奖。尽管如此，她仍然给人一种热情洋溢的感觉，求知欲强，对她演奏的音乐有着深刻的理解。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This documentary offers a glimpse into the life of pianist Yuja Wang, showcasing her intense dedication and intellectual curiosity in the demanding world of classical music. Her commitment to mastering her art, even when facing external distractions like undue attention to her appearance, speaks to a deep-seated passion for her calling. Colossians 3:23...
reflection.zh: 这部纪录片让我们得以一窥钢琴家王羽佳的生活，展现了她在古典音乐这个要求严苛的领域中，她那份强烈的奉献精神和求知欲。即使面对外表受到不当关注等外部干扰，她仍致力于精进技艺，这体现了她对自己使命的深切热情。 歌罗西书 3:23 提醒我们：“无论做什么，都要从心里去做，像是为主做的，不像为人做的。”...

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: Hong Kong's first leader after British handover dies
title.zh: 香港首任特首、英国移交后首位领导人董建华逝世

summary.en: Tung Chee-hwa, the first chief executive of Hong Kong after its handover from British to Chinese rule, has died at the age of 89. His time in office, from 1997 to 2005, was characterized by significant challenges including the Asian Financial Crisis, two epidemics, and major protests.
summary.zh: 香港首任行政长官董建华（在英国将香港移交中国后）于周二晚逝世，享年89岁。他在1997年至2005年任职期间，经历了亚洲金融危机、两次重大疫情以及大规模抗议活动等严峻挑战。

body.en:
Tung Chee-hwa, Hong Kong's first leader after the city returned to Chinese rule, has died at the age of 89.

The former shipping scion took over the reins from the last British Governor Chris Patten in July 1997 when the UK handed Hong Kong back to China , ending more than 150 years of British control.

Tung's rocky tenure was marked by the Asian Financial Crisis, two major epidemics, and historic protests which attracted criticism of his administration. He eventually resigned in 2005.

Tung died on Tuesday night surrounded by loved ones, local media reported. His office described him as a man "devoted to his country and its people".

Born in Shanghai in 1937, Tung graduated with a mechanical engineering degree from Liverpool University in the UK before moving to the US, where he worked at General Electric for almost a decade.

In 1969, he moved to Hong Kong and worked in his father's shipping conglomerate, the Orient Overseas, eventually taking over the reins in 1979.

His political career began in 1992 when he was appointed a member of Patten's executive council.

Despite having little political experience, Tung was believed to be handpicked by Beijing to lead Hong Kong after the handover. He was seen as a loyalist, especially after China's state-run banks helped rescue his family business during a global slump in the mid-1980s.

During a reception at the Great Hall of the People in January 1996, China's then-president Jiang Zemin walked across a packed room to shake Tung's hands – a widely photographed gesture that at the time famously signalled Beijing's backing of Tung for the top job.

The Asian Financial Crisis hit shortly after Tung took over, which sent home prices diving. His administration was also beset by a series of public health challenges, including a bird flu outbreak from 1997 to 2002 and the 2003 outbreak of Sars, also known as Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome.

But Tung's biggest political challenge took place in July 2003 during his second term, when half a million Hongkongers took to the streets to protest against a proposed national security law they feared would threaten their civic rights.

His administration abandoned the proposed legislation following the massive outcry, which also contributed to Tung stepping down in March 2005.

At the time his declining health was cited as a reason - but some said he was pressured by Beijing to step down.

Beijing ultimately imposed a national security law on Hong Kong in 2020, which authorities have argued is necessary to maintain stability. Critics however have called it "the end of Hong Kong" and say it has created a climate of fear in the city.

Tung's last public outing was in July 2021, at an event marking the 100th anniversary of the founding of the Chinese Communist Party. He...
body.zh: 香港回归中国后的首任领导人董建华去世，享年89岁。 1997 年 7 月，英国将香港交还给中国，结束了英国 150 多年的控制，这位前航运业子弟从最后一任英国总督彭定康 (Chris Patten) 手中接过了权力。 亚洲金融危机、两次重大流行病以及引发对其政府批评的历史性抗议活动，标志着董建华的任期充满坎坷。他最终于2005年辞职。 据当地媒体报道，董于周二晚上在亲人的陪伴下去世。他的办公室形容他是一个“献身于他的国家和人民”的人。 董先生 1937 年出生于上海，毕业于英国利物浦大学，获得机械工程学位，随后移居美国，在通用电气工作了近十年。 1969年，他移居香港，在其父亲的航运集团东方海外工作，最终于1979年接手大权。 他的政治生涯始于1992年，当时他被任命为彭定康行政委员会成员。 尽管董建华缺乏政治经验，但据信是北京精心挑选的，在香港回归后领导香港。他被视为忠诚者，特别是在 20 世纪 80 年代中期全球经济衰退期间，中国国有银行帮助拯救了他的家族企业之后。 1996 年 1 月，在人民大会堂举行的招待会上，时任中国国家主席江泽民走过挤满人的房间，与董建华握手，这一举动被广泛拍照，在当时标志着北京支持董建华担任国家主席。 董建华上任后不久，亚洲金融危机袭来，房价暴跌。他的政府还受到一系列公共卫生挑战的困扰，包括1997年至2002年爆发的禽流感和2003年爆发的非典（又称严重急性呼吸系统综合症）。 但董建华最大的政治挑战发生在他的第二个任期内的 2003 年 7 月，当时 50 万香港人走上街头抗议一项拟议的国家安全法，他们担心这会威胁到他们的公民权利。 在遭到强烈抗议后，他的政府放弃了拟议的立法，这也导致董建华于 2005 年 3 月下台。 当时他的健康状况恶化被认为是一个原因，但也有人说他是受到北京方面的压力才下台的。 北京最终于 2020 年对香港实施了国家安全法，当局认为这是维持稳定所必需的。然而，批评者称其为“香港的终结”，并称这在这座城市造成了恐惧气氛。 董建华最后一次公开露面是在 2021 年 7 月的中国共产党成立 100 周年纪念活动上。他...

reflection.en: The news of Tung Chee-hwa's passing invites reflection on leadership and public service. Micah 6:8 calls for acting justly, loving mercy, and walking humbly with God. Leaders, like Tung, face immense pressures and complex decisions, and the measure of their tenure often lies in how they sought to balance these divine imperatives amidst crises.
reflection.zh: 董建华先生的逝世，引人深思领导力与公共服务。弥迦书6章8节呼吁我们行公义、好怜悯、存谦卑的心与雅伟同行。像董先生这样的领导者，在任期内面临巨大的压力和复杂的抉择，他们任职期间的成效，往往体现在如何在危机中努力平衡这些神圣的原则。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: How Mao Zedong's legacy still shapes China 50 years on
title.zh: 毛泽东的遗产如何至今仍在塑造中国

summary.en: Fifty years after Mao Zedong's death, China has undergone significant transformation. However, his legacy persists, influencing current leadership under Xi Jinping and fueling a resurgence of Maoist nostalgia among younger generations.
summary.zh: 毛泽东逝世五十年来，中国发生了翻天覆地的变化。然而，他的遗产依然存在，影响着习近平领导下的当今政权，并在年轻一代中引发了对毛泽东时代的新怀旧潮。

body.en:
China has transformed since Mao Zedong's death 50 years ago. But his legacy endures — from Xi Jinping's rule to a new wave of Mao nostalgia among young Chinese.

On September 9, 1976, Mao Zedong died. The revolutionary leader who led the Chinese Communist Party (CCP) to power and founded the People's Republic of China left behind a profoundly contradictory historical legacy.

He shaped the narratives of revolution, nation-building and national independence, but also left behind immense social trauma as a result of successive political campaigns and persecutions.

When Mao died, China was still a poor and relatively isolated communist state. Today, it is the world's second-largest economy, deeply embedded in the supply and value chains of global capitalism, with a vast private sector, a large urban middle class and a highly digitalized society. 

Zhang Lun, a professor at Cergy-Paris University, said Mao left behind four major political legacies: the authoritarian and highly centralized political system; a model of governance that relies on revolution and political campaigns to solve social problems; populist tendencies marked by anti-elitism and anti-rationalism; and utopian visions of egalitarianism and moralism.

From the perspective of political legacies, Zhang told DW, the most fundamental change in China over the past five decades has been "de-Maoization" — while its greatest challenge has been that this process was never fully completed.

Mao's name remains written into the CCP's constitution, while his thought remains part of China's official ideology and his portrait still hangs in Beijing's Tiananmen Square.

Mao helped forge the Chinese Communist Party, and his insistence on the party's supremacy over the state and society has remained a fundamental principle throughout the decades, said Jean Christopher Mittelstaedt, professor at the University of Zurich.

Veteran journalist and political commentator Chang Ping agrees, adding that what has truly endured is the institutional core of the principle that "the party leads everything," serving a state vision of being able to "concentrate resources to accomplish major tasks." 

The CCP, he said, can pursue such objectives "at all costs" — meaning the interests of ordinary people can be sacrificed to the maximum extent necessary to preserve the regime. 

Under current leader Xi Jinping , a number of political concepts and methods of governance associated with the Mao era — such as ideological unity and the spirit of "struggle" — have again attracted attention.

Xi's actions such as abolishing the presidential term limits, strengthening his personal authority and the incorporation of his political...
body.zh: 毛泽东逝世50年来，中国发生了翻天覆地的变化。但他的遗产依然存在——从习近平的统治到中国年轻人新一轮的毛泽东怀旧浪潮。 1976年9月9日，毛泽东逝世。 这位领导中国共产党夺取政权、建立中华人民共和国的革命领袖，留下了极其矛盾的历史遗产。 他塑造了革命、国家建设和民族独立的叙事，但也因连续的政治运动和迫害而留下了巨大的社会创伤。 毛泽东去世时，中国仍然是一个贫穷且相对孤立的共产主义国家。如今，它是世界第二大经济体，深深嵌入全球资本主义的供应链和价值链，拥有庞大的私营部门、庞大的城市中产阶级和高度数字化的社会。 巴黎塞尔吉大学教授张伦表示，毛泽东留下了四大政治遗产：专制和高度集权的政治制度；依靠革命和政治运动来解决社会问题的治理模式；以反精英主义和反理性主义为标志的民粹主义倾向；以及平等主义和道德主义的乌托邦愿景。 张向德国之声表示，从政治遗产的角度来看，中国过去50年最根本的变化是“去毛化”，而最大的挑战是这一过程从未完全完成。 毛泽东的名字仍然写进了中国共产党的党章，他的思想仍然是中国官方意识形态的一部分，他的肖像仍然悬挂在北京天安门广场上。 苏黎世大学教授吉恩·克里斯托弗·米特尔施塔特 (Jean Christopher Mittelstaedt) 表示，毛泽东帮助建立了中国共产党，几十年来，他坚持党对国家和社会的至高无上一直是一项基本原则。 资深记者、时事评论员常平对此表示赞同，并补充道，真正经久不衰的是“党领导一切”的制度核心，服务于“集中资源办好大事”的国家愿景。 他说，中共可以“不惜一切代价”追求这些目标——这意味着为了维护政权，可以最大限度地牺牲普通民众的利益。 在现任领导人习近平的领导下，一些与毛泽东时代相关的政治理念和执政方式——例如思想统一和“斗争”精神——再次引起人们的关注。 习近平的行动包括取消国家主席任期限制、加强他的个人权威以及纳入他的政治...

reflection.en: Mao Zedong's death 50 years ago marked a turning point for China, yet his ideological and political shadow continues to shape the nation. This enduring influence, from state narratives to popular nostalgia, speaks to the profound and often complex impact of historical figures. The story prompts reflection on how legacies, whether positive or negative, can...
reflection.zh: 毛泽东逝世五十周年标志着中国的一个转折点，但他的意识形态和政治影响至今仍在塑造着这个国家。这种从国家叙事到大众怀旧的持久影响，体现了历史人物深刻而复杂的作用。这个故事促使我们反思，无论正面还是负面，遗产如何能够持续并塑造现在，并提醒我们，不受约束的权力和野心可能带来长远甚至意想不到的后果。

verse.textEn: Pride goes before destruction, a haughty spirit before a fall.
verse.textZh: 骄傲在败坏以先；狂心在跌倒之前。

title.en: Another Australian found alive nearly two weeks after Nepal-Tibet floods
title.zh: 尼泊尔洪水过后近两周，又一名澳大利亚人被发现生还

summary.en: An Australian citizen, previously unaccounted for after catastrophic flooding in Nepal, has been confirmed safe. This news brings relief to families anxiously awaiting word of their loved ones, though 35 Australians remain missing following the disaster last month which killed at least 1,399 people and left over 5,400...
summary.zh: 一名在尼泊尔失联的澳大利亚公民在灾难性洪水过后已被确认安全。这一消息为焦急等待亲人消息的家庭带来了宽慰，尽管上个月的灾难已造成至少1399人死亡、超过5400人失踪，仍有35名澳大利亚人下落不明。

body.en:
An Australian citizen who was in Nepal has been confirmed safe in the wake of the catastrophic flooding that swept through the region nearly two weeks ago.

The Australian was uncontactable but has today confirmed they are safe and well and do not require consular assistance, SBS News understands.

At least 1,399 people were killed by the 26 August mudslide and flooding in Nepal and Tibet and more than 5,400 are missing, including around 800 foreigners.

A group of Australian families with missing loved ones released a statement on Sunday, calling for greater transparency from tour groups and authorities.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

They expressed gratitude to the Australian Federal Police and search teams working to find missing Australians, but criticised the Australian government for what they said was its failure to provide answers.

The federal government has sent a disaster assistance response team and other specialist resources to Kathmandu to assist with the search.

It has also committed $11 million to support the disaster response, which Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said on Monday was of national importance.

Hundreds of hydropower workers are among the missing, but the rescue of three of them from deep inside tunnels — two Nepalis on Friday and a Chinese man on Saturday — have buoyed hopes that more could still be alive.

At least 11 hydropower projects were engulfed when a glacier collapsed into a river on the Nepal-China border on August 26, burying the entrances to the tunnels of these projects under debris and mud and cutting off those trapped inside.

Authorities said Tuesday that rescuers in Nepal are focusing on three hydropower project tunnels where they believe dozens of workers could be trapped.

"Our search operation is focussed on finding survivors, including in tunnels. Our bigger focus is on the Chilime hydroelectric project, where we believe people are trapped, because there was a canteen, residency and arrangements for food," Dharma Raj Upreti, chief of the country's disaster authority, told Reuters.

Australian tunnel rescue expert Arnold Dix, who is advising Nepali teams, has said the operation presents an unprecedented challenge.

"Not one rescue, but multiple potential rescues, unfolding at the same time, in different places, each with its own dangers, uncertainties, and lives that may still be saved."

For the latest from SBS News, download our app and subscribe to our newsletter .
body.zh: 近两周前席卷该地区的灾难性洪水后，一名身在尼泊尔的澳大利亚公民已被确认安全。 据 SBS 新闻了解，这名澳大利亚人无法联系上，但今天确认他们安全无恙，不需要领事协助。 8月26日尼泊尔和西藏发生的泥石流和洪水造成至少1,399人死亡，5,400多人失踪，其中包括约800名外国人。 一群失踪亲人的澳大利亚家庭周日发表声明，呼吁旅游团和当局提高透明度。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 他们对澳大利亚联邦警察和寻找失踪澳大利亚人的搜救队表示感谢，但批评澳大利亚政府未能提供答案。 联邦政府已派出救灾响应小组和其他专业资源前往加德满都协助搜寻。 它还承诺提供 1100 万美元来支持救灾，总理安东尼·阿尔巴内塞周一表示，这对国家具有重要意义。 数百名水电工人失踪，但其中三人从隧道深处获救——周五是两名尼泊尔人，周六是一名中国男子——这让人们燃起了更多生还的希望。 8月26日，尼泊尔和中国边境的一座冰川崩塌成河，至少11个水电项目被吞没，这些项目的隧道入口被瓦砾和泥土掩埋，并切断了被困人员的通道。 当局周二表示，尼泊尔的救援人员正在重点关注三个水电项目隧道，他们认为那里可能有数十名工人被困。 “我们的搜索行动主要是寻找幸存者，包括在隧道中寻找幸存者。我们更关注的是 Chilime 水力发电项目，我们相信那里有人被困，因为那里有食堂、住所和食物安排，”该国灾害管理局局长 Dharma Raj Upreti 告诉路透社。 为尼泊尔救援队提供咨询的澳大利亚隧道救援专家阿诺德·迪克斯表示，这次行动带来了前所未有的挑战。 “这不是一次救援，而是多次潜在的救援，在不同的时间、不同的地点同时展开，每一次都有自己的危险、不确定性和仍然可以挽救的生命。” 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

reflection.en: In the midst of devastating floods that claimed many lives and left others missing, the news of a found Australian offers a beacon of hope. This story echoes the Psalmist's declaration that weeping may last for a night, but joy comes in the morning. For the families who feared the worst, this reunion is a profound answer to prayer and a testament to...
reflection.zh: 在夺走许多生命并导致多人失踪的毁灭性洪水灾难中，一名澳大利亚人被找到的消息带来了希望的曙光。这个故事呼应了诗篇作者的宣告：哭泣虽可过夜，但早晨必带来欢欣。对于那些曾恐惧最坏情况的家庭来说，这次重逢是对祷告的深刻回应，也是坚韧不拔的证明。

verse.textEn: Weeping may stay for the night, but rejoicing comes in the morning.
verse.textZh: 一宿虽然有哭泣，早晨便必欢呼。

title.en: How the Nepal-Tibet disaster became the latest victim of China’s ‘Clean Internet’ campaign
title.zh: 尼泊尔-西藏灾难如何成为中国“净网”运动的最新牺牲品

summary.en: The online campaign, which used to focus on tackling cybercrime and hacking, has since expanded to suppress information that differs from official narratives. Tsering Phuntsok watched news of the Nepal-Tibet flood unfold from thousands of miles away in southern India. The 46-year-old Tibetan in exile has missing...
summary.zh: 这场网络运动曾专注于打击网络犯罪和黑客攻击，但现已扩大到压制与官方叙述不同的信息。46岁的藏族流亡者丹增·普措（Tsering...

body.en: The online campaign used to focus on tackling cybercrime and hacking but has since expanded to suppress information that differs from official narratives Tsering Phuntsok watched news of the Nepal-Tibet flood unfold from thousands of miles away in southern India. The 46-year-old Tibetan in exile has missing family members on both sides of the border; those in Nepal are named in official government lists, but in Tibet he has received no information. “I have started praying for the lost ones now. I have to accept they will not return [because] … I’m not getting any information.” Continue reading...
body.zh: 这场在线运动过去的重点是打击网络犯罪和黑客攻击，但后来扩大到压制与官方叙述不同的信息。次仁平措在千里之外的印度南部观看了尼泊尔西藏洪水的新闻。 46岁流亡藏人在边境两侧都有家人失踪；尼泊尔的那些人被列入政府官方名单，但在西藏，他没有收到任何信息。 “我现在开始为失踪的人祈祷。我必须接受他们不会回来的事实，[因为]……我没有得到任何信息。”继续阅读...

reflection.en: In the wake of the Nepal-Tibet disaster, Tsering Phuntsok faces a double tragedy: the potential loss of family members and the silencing of information. His inability to confirm their fate due to China's 'Clean Internet' campaign leaves him in agonizing uncertainty. This situation calls to mind the ancient call to 'speak up for those who cannot speak for...
reflection.zh: 在尼泊尔-西藏灾难之后，丹增·普措面临着双重悲剧：可能失去家人以及信息被噤声。由于中国“净网”运动，他无法确认家人的命运，这让他陷入痛苦的不确定之中。这种情况令人想起古老的呼吁：“为那些不能说话的人辩护，为所有贫困者伸张正义”（箴言31:8-9），敦促我们为那些声音被故意压制的人们发声。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Weather tracker: Typhoon Saudel causes mass evacuations in south-east China
title.zh: 台风“苏德罗”导致中国东南部大规模疏散

summary.en: Typhoon Saudel brought days of torrential rain to south-east China last week, causing widespread damage and forcing mass evacuations. The city of Putian recorded 416.5mm of rain in 24 hours, leading to the evacuation of almost 600,000 people in Fujian province and affecting thousands more in other provinces.
summary.zh: 上周，台风“苏德罗”给中国东南部带来了数日的倾盆大雨，造成大范围破坏并导致大规模疏散。福建省莆田市在24小时内记录到416.5毫米的降雨量，迫使福建省近60万人撤离，另有数千人受到江西等省份的影响。

body.en: Torrential rain causes widespread damage; while north-west South Africa hit by thunderstorms and central-southern US faces oppressive heat Typhoon Saudel brought days of torrential rain to Zhejiang, Jiangxi, Fujian and Guangdong provinces in south-east China last week. The city of Putian, in Fujian province, recorded 416.5mm of rain in a 24-hour period between Thursday and Friday, with surrounding villages recording more than 500mm in the same period. In Fujian, authorities estimate that almost 600,000 people were evacuated from high-risk, flood-prone areas. A further 128,000 people in 53 counties were also affected across Jiangxi, with emergency evacuations affecting 9,000 people. Flooding, landslips and infrastructure damage were reported widely in the region. More than 2,500 teachers and students were trapped in a school compound in the Zhejiang city of Wenzhou on Wednesday after extreme rainfall caused flash floods in low-lying areas. At least 1,260 people reportedly had to be rescued in Putian after a river embankment collapsed on Thursday, flattening 100 homes. On Saturday, a landslip in a village of Suichuan county, in Jiangxi province, killed three people and nine others remaining missing. Continue reading...
body.zh: 暴雨造成大面积破坏；南非西北部遭遇雷暴袭击，美国中南部遭遇酷热，台风“萨德尔”上周给中国东南部的浙江、江西、福建和广东省带来连日暴雨。福建省莆田市周四至周五24小时内降雨量达416.5毫米，周边村庄同期降雨量超过500毫米。在福建，当局估计近 60 万人从高风险、洪水易发地区撤离。江西53个县12.8万人受灾，紧急疏散9000人。据报道，该地区发生了洪水、山体滑坡和基础设施损坏。周三，极端降雨导致低洼地区山洪暴发，2500多名师生被困在浙江温州一所学校大院内。据报道，莆田市周四河堤崩塌，夷为平地，至少有 1,260 人需要救援。周六，江西省遂川县一个村庄发生山体滑坡，造成三人死亡，另有九人失踪。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Typhoon Saudel's torrential rains and subsequent evacuations in China underscore the harsh realities of natural disasters. In times of devastation, the human spirit is tested, yet the biblical narrative offers a path through suffering. Romans 5:3-4 reminds us that hardship can produce perseverance, character, and hope, even amidst overwhelming loss.
reflection.zh: 台风“苏德罗”带来的倾盆大雨和中国随后的大规模疏散，凸显了自然灾害的严酷现实。在毁灭性的灾难面前，人类的精神受到考验，但圣经的叙事提供了一条穿越苦难的道路。罗马书5:3-4提醒我们，即使在巨大的损失中，艰难困苦也能磨炼出忍耐、品格和盼望。

verse.textEn: We also glory in our sufferings, because we know that suffering produces perseverance; perseverance, character; and character, hope.
verse.textZh: 就是在患难中也是欢欢喜喜的；因为知道患难生忍耐，忍耐生老练，老练生盼望。

summary.en: South Australian Premier Peter Malinauskas has warned Prime Minister Anthony Albanese against adopting the One Nation party's stance on cutting migration, arguing that Australia faces a housing crisis, not a migration crisis. He suggests that focusing on bringing in skilled workers for the construction industry is a...

body.en: This blog is now closed Labor introducing new laws to crack down on illegal tobacco Labor will introduce new laws to make it easier to prosecute criminals involved in the illicit tobacco trade, as the government fights an uphill battle against the exploding black market. The new laws think about it as a list of observable indicators, very simple, fact-based things like: is the tobacco appropriately packaged? Is it a menthol cigarette even hiding in plain packaging? Is it being concealed? Does it have paperwork at the border? Or my personal favourite: is the retail price of this packet of cigarettes less than the amount of excise and GST combined? If any of these facts are proven, just one of them, that establishes the reasonable suspicion of the criminal offence of importing, possession, or conveying. It’ll give powerful new tools to Border Force but every state and territory police force to go after the crooks. I said, look, my door’s open if you want to talk about this. I don’t know why he thinks I’m a liar. I don’t quite know why he believes I lied about it. I’m disappointed he thinks I’m a coward. I don’t know how he came to that opinion but that’s up to him. I don’t think he’s a traitor. I absolutely respect the services given to our nation, like my family, has given to the service of New Zealand and Australia. Democracy’s a robust thing. Continue reading...
body.zh: 关注当天的新闻直播 “我们需要解释澳大利亚没有移民危机”：马利瑙卡斯 Peter Malinaukas 表示，他理解澳大利亚人对澳大利亚移民和住房短缺的担忧，但答案是政客们需要解释正在发生的是住房危机，而不是移民危机。我们需要解释一下，澳大利亚真正面临的不是移民危机，而是住房危机。如果我们遇到住房危机，我们最好将技能政策的重点放在确保引进住房建筑行业所需的工人上。你知道，澳大利亚几乎所有行业都严重短缺。我认为每个人都承认这需要一个经过良好校准、平衡的移民计划。我的观点是，过去几年我们在这个国家的政治话语中没有看到太多支持移民的证据。只是看到许多针对移民的文化战争正在发生。我认为这是弄巧成拙的，我们有责任站起来反对它。最重要的是，[我们必须]保留我们强有力的移民计划……对反移民政治和民粹主义者的正确政治反应不是绥靖政策。更令人不安的是，主流政治可能会进入一场政治竞赛，看看谁能最大程度地减少移民数量。这并不不幸——这是疯狂。想象一下，如果我们对采矿业这样做，世界上每个电视台和手机上都会有一个广告，讲述我们如何杀鸡取卵。这太疯狂了。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The debate over migration in Australia highlights a tension between perceived crises and underlying realities. Premier Malinauskas urges a focus on the housing shortage, suggesting that skilled migration could be part of the solution rather than the problem. This calls for national discernment, seeking policies that build up rather than tear down, and...
reflection.zh: 澳大利亚关于移民的争论凸显了人们感知的危机与实际现实之间的紧张关系。州长马利纳斯敦促将重点放在住房短缺问题上，并认为技术移民可以成为解决方案的一部分，而不是问题本身。这需要国家具备辨别力，寻求能够建设而非破坏的政策，并以诚信的态度解决根本原因。

verse.textEn: Righteousness exalts a nation, but sin condemns any people.
verse.textZh: 公义使邦国高举；罪恶是人民的羞辱。

title.en: Victoria’s historic work from home laws have unexpectedly stalled. Will they survive?
title.zh: 维多利亚州历史性的居家办公法律意外陷入停滞。它们能幸存下来吗？

summary.en: Victoria's groundbreaking legislation, which would have enshrined the right to work from home two days a week, is unlikely to pass before the November state election. The Coalition and crossbench have joined forces to refer the bill to an inquiry, delaying its passage.
summary.zh: 维多利亚州一项保障每周两天居家办公权利的开创性立法，在11月州选举前不太可能在议会通过。反对党联盟和独立议员联手将该法案提交给一个调查委员会，导致其通过受阻。

title.en: Can you really lifestyle your way out of dementia risk?
title.zh: 您真的可以通过生活方式来摆脱痴呆症的风险吗？

summary.en: Australians have been focused on lifestyle changes for dementia prevention. New research says other factors are being ignored.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚人一直专注于通过改变生活方式来预防痴呆症。新的研究表明，其他因素被忽视了。

body.en:
Exercise, healthy eating and blood pressure management are the most common pieces of advice for those at risk of dementia. But new research suggests Australia is ignoring crucial factors.

Dr Jennifer Dunne, an epidemiologist who was the research lead on the Curtin University paper, said dementia prevention is focused heavily "on the individual".

She said the study, published in the peer-reviewed Lancet journal, was a "broader look" at dementia risk factors, mapping them to identify where "the evidence already was".

It builds off a "large systematic review and meta-analysis" previously conducted by co-author professor Blossom Stephan, Curtin's enAble Institute Dementia chair, which identified 61 risk factors — surpassing the previously identified 14.

The research, the first of its kind, categorised the 61 risk factors using a socioecological model.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

It found a lack of knowledge on how social and environmental conditions affect dementia — information crucial for dementia prevention.

Dunne, a Curtin University Dementia Centre of Excellence research fellow, said the report identifies "gaps" where researchers "should be looking".

"There's so much focus on preventing dementia, but we need to think more broadly about how we work together to prevent it," Dunne said.

"We need to move away from the message of telling people you need to do all these [lifestyle] things because they can only be successful if the environment around them is supportive."

Dementia is an umbrella term for more than 100 conditions — the most common being vascular dementia and Alzheimer's disease.

Alzheimer's accounts for up to 80 per cent of dementia cases, and impacts a person's memory, thinking and behaviour.

Dementia is caused by neurodegeneration — damage or death of the brain's neurons.

Uncorrected vision or hearing loss, social isolation and early childhood education are among the study's 61 risk factors.

"You start thinking about dementia prevention in mid-life ... but you can't go back and do your childhood education again — you can't change that risk factor," Dunne explained.

"We need to ensure that the broader society in which we live supports high-quality education that is accessible to everybody."

She noted that employed adults face a higher risk of social isolation as they approach retirement age.

Social isolation is enmeshed with other risk factors including loss of vision, loss of hearing, physical inactivity and depression.

"We know that when people sometimes become socially isolated, they become depressed. Then they tend to withdraw and stop exercising. They might start smoking, or...
body.zh: 对于患有痴呆症的人来说，锻炼、健康饮食和血压管理是最常见的建议。但新的研究表明澳大利亚忽视了关键因素。 科廷大学论文的研究负责人、流行病学家詹妮弗·邓恩博士表示，痴呆症的预防主要关注“个人”。 她说，这项发表在同行评审的《柳叶刀》杂志上的研究是对痴呆症风险因素的“更广泛的审视”，将它们绘制出来以确定“证据已经在哪里”。 它建立在之前由合著者、科廷大学 enAble 痴呆症研究所主席 Blossom Stephan 教授进行的“大型系统回顾和荟萃分析”的基础上，该分析确定了 61 个风险因素，超过了之前确定的 14 个。 该研究利用社会生态学模型对 61 种风险因素进行了分类，这在同类研究中尚属首次。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 研究发现，人们缺乏关于社会和环境条件如何影响痴呆症的知识，而这些信息对于预防痴呆症至关重要。 科廷大学痴呆症卓越中心研究员邓恩表示，该报告指出了研究人员“应该关注”的“差距”。 邓恩说：“人们非常关注预防痴呆症，但我们需要更广泛地思考如何共同努力预防痴呆症。” “我们需要摆脱告诉人们你需要做所有这些[生活方式]事情的信息，因为只有周围的环境给予支持，他们才能成功。” 痴呆症是 100 多种疾病的总称，其中最常见的是血管性痴呆和阿尔茨海默病。 阿尔茨海默病占痴呆症病例的 80%，它会影响一个人的记忆、思维和行为。 痴呆症是由神经退行性病变（大脑神经元损伤或死亡）引起的。 未矫正的视力或听力损失、社会孤立和幼儿教育是该研究的 61 个风险因素之一。 “你在中年时开始考虑预防痴呆症……但你不能回去重新接受童年教育——你无法改变这个风险因素，”邓恩解释道。 “我们需要确保我们生活的更广泛的社会支持每个人都能获得的高质量教育。” 她指出，在职成年人在接近退休年龄时面临着更高的社会孤立风险。 社会孤立与其他风险因素交织在一起，包括视力丧失、听力丧失、缺乏身体活动和抑郁。 “我们知道，当人们有时变得与社会隔绝时，他们就会变得抑郁。然后他们往往会退缩并停止锻炼。他们可能会开始吸烟，或者......

reflection.en: The pursuit of health often centers on individual actions like diet and exercise. However, this research from Curtin University suggests that a broader perspective is needed for dementia prevention, pointing to factors beyond personal control. It reminds us that true wisdom in addressing complex issues like public health requires listening to diverse...
reflection.zh: 追求健康常常以饮食和运动等个人行为为中心。然而，科廷大学的这项研究表明，在预防痴呆症方面需要更广泛的视角，指出了个人控制之外的因素。它提醒我们，在解决公共卫生等复杂问题时，真正的智慧需要倾听各种意见，并考虑系统性影响，而不仅仅是个人选择。

reflection.zh: 作者分享了与挚友告别的感人时刻，承认了死亡的深刻现实。《希伯来书》9:27提醒我们，死亡是全人类的共同经历，是注定要发生的。在这些失落的时刻，我们被呼召诚实地面对死亡，并珍惜我们所拥有的联结。

verse.textEn: Just as people are destined to die once, and after that to face judgment.
verse.textZh: 按着定命，人人都有一死，死后且有审判。

title.en: Three Greens senators to cross floor amid internal brawl over contentious koala park plan
title.zh: 三名绿党参议员将在内部争吵中跨越地板，反对有争议的考拉公园计划

summary.en: The Greens party will support a plan allowing major industries to offset their climate pollution by using a new koala national park in New South Wales. However, three senators—Nick McKim, Vanessa Bleyer, and Jordon Steele-John—voted against the party's decision, crossing the floor to oppose the deal.
summary.zh: 绿党将支持一项允许大型工业通过利用新南威尔士州的一个新的考拉国家公园来抵消其气候污染的计划。然而，三名参议员——尼克·麦金、瓦内萨·布莱尔和乔丹·斯蒂尔-约翰——投票反对该党的决定，跨越了地板以反对这项协议。

body.en: Party will back plan to allow big industry to use a new koala national park in NSW to offset its climate pollution, but three senators will dissent Sign up for climate and environment editor Adam Morton’s free Clear Air newsletter here A controversial plan to allow big industry to use a new koala national park in New South Wales to offset its climate pollution will go ahead after the Greens reached a deal with Labor, and decided not to vote with the Coalition to block it. But three Greens – Tasmanians Nick McKim and Vanessa Bleyer, and Western Australia’s Jordon Steele-John – crossed the floor to oppose the deal on Thursday afternoon. Continue reading...
body.zh: 工党将支持允许大工业在新南威尔士州建立一个新的考拉国家公园来抵消其气候污染的计划，但三名参议员将表示反对。在绿党与工党达成协议并决定不与联盟党投票阻止该计划后，允许大工业在新南威尔士州建立一个新的考拉国家公园来抵消气候污染的一项有争议的计划将继续进行。但三名绿党——塔斯马尼亚人尼克·麦金(Nick McKim)和凡妮莎·布莱尔(Vanessa Bleyer)，以及西澳大利亚州的乔丹·斯蒂尔-约翰(Jordon Steele-John)——在周四下午站出来反对该交易。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In a move that highlights the tension between party loyalty and personal conviction, three Greens senators defied their party's leadership. Their decision to 'cross the floor' signifies a profound commitment to their conscience, even when it means standing apart from their colleagues. This act echoes the principle of prioritizing divine guidance over human...
reflection.zh: 三名绿党参议员不顾党内领导层的反对，做出了一个突显党派忠诚与个人信念之间紧张关系的举动。他们‘跨越地板’的决定，即使意味着与同事们分道扬镳，也表明了他们对良知的坚定承诺。这一行为呼应了当神圣的指引与人类的指令发生分歧时，应优先考虑神圣指引的原则。

verse.textEn: We must obey God rather than human beings!
verse.textZh: 顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。

title.en: 'Angry little woman': Lambie lashes Hanson amid growing storm over political cartoon
title.zh: 兰比称汉森为“懦夫”，因政治漫画引发的争议日益加剧

summary.en: Independent senator Jacqui Lambie has called Pauline Hanson a 'coward' over a One Nation cartoon that labeled Liberal MP Andrew Hastie a 'traitor' for providing evidence against former SAS soldier Ben Roberts-Smith. The cartoon has drawn widespread condemnation, with even fellow One Nation senator Barnaby Joyce...
summary.zh: 独立参议员杰奎·兰比（Jacqui Lambie）在一幅“一人党”（One Nation）的政治漫画将自由党议员安德鲁·哈斯蒂（Andrew Hastie）描绘成“叛徒”，因其提供了针对前特种空勤团士兵本·罗伯茨-史密斯（Ben...

body.en:
Independent senator Jacqui Lambie has branded Pauline Hanson an "angry little woman" over a One Nation cartoon labelling Liberal MP Andrew Hastie a "traitor" for giving evidence against former SAS soldier Ben Roberts-Smith.

Hanson's cartoon has drawn condemnation from across the political spectrum, with even fellow One Nation senator Barnaby Joyce saying he did not consider defence veteran Hastie a traitor.

"Anybody that hides behind a cartoon and goes after a veteran and calls them a traitor, a paranoid traitor and a washed-up gutless maggot, I have to say you're a bloody maggot yourself and you're a coward," Lambie said in an interview with News24 on Thursday.

"(Andrew) Hastie's right to call her out because she's a bloody coward. She wouldn't serve one day in that uniform because she wouldn't last."

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The video is part of a political cartoon series created by One Nation titled Please Explain, which periodically targets politicians from various parties while promoting One Nation.

"She should pull it down, and she should get out there today and show some bloody courage and apologise to that veteran, to Andrew Hastie, right now," Lambie said.

"She's dividing this country. She's not uniting it. She's an angry little woman … and her supporters think that is acceptable behaviour."

"Any veteran out there thinking about voting for One Nation or standing for them, I tell you what, you had better think twice," Lambie said, in a separate interview with ABC Radio National on Thursday morning.

Hastie was among several former SAS soldiers who gave evidence during Roberts-Smith's defamation case in 2022, which the decorated former soldier ultimately lost.

On Wednesday, he told News24 that Hanson should "own" the cartoon, acknowledge it called him a "traitor" and remove it.

In an interview on Wednesday evening, Hanson refused to take down the video and accused Hastie of making a "mountain out of a molehill".

Hastie has called on Hanson and One Nation MP Barnaby Joyce "lying cowards" and has challenged the party to remove the video.

"It shows her to be weak and glass-jawed. I gave the opportunity to either own her words publicly, or to take it down, she chose neither," he told ABC Radio on Thursday.

He accused the party of politicising the court proceedings of Roberts-Smith and "trashing" his own service record.

Hastie said the video amounted to a broader attack on veterans who testified in the case.

"It's actually an attack on veterans, not just an attack on me, because you've got to remember more than 20-plus SAS combat veterans were called to give evidence in...
body.zh: 独立参议员雅基·兰比因一部一国漫画将波琳·汉森称为“胆小鬼”，将自由党议员安德鲁·哈斯蒂称为“叛徒”，因为他提供了针对前特种空勤团士兵本·罗伯茨-史密斯的证据。 汉森的漫画引起了各个政治派别的谴责，甚至一国党参议员巴纳比·乔伊斯也表示，他并不认为国防老兵哈斯蒂是叛徒。 该视频是一国集团创作的政治漫画系列的一部分，名为“请解释一下”，该系列在宣传一国集团的同时定期针对不同政党的政客。 周四早上，兰比告诉美国广播公司国家广播电台：“她今天就应该把哈斯蒂的那一件取下来。” 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 “任何考虑投票支持一国党或代表他们的退伍军人，我告诉你，你最好三思而后行。” 哈斯蒂是在 2022 年罗伯茨-史密斯诽谤案中提供证据的几名前 SAS 士兵之一，这位功勋卓著的前士兵最终败诉。 周三，他告诉 News24，汉森应该“拥有”这部漫画，承认它称他为“叛徒”，并将其删除。 在周三晚上的一次采访中，汉森拒绝删除这段视频，并指责哈斯蒂“小题大做”。 哈斯蒂称汉森和一国党议员巴纳比·乔伊斯是“撒谎的胆小鬼”，并要求该党删除该视频。 “这表明她很软弱，玻璃下巴。我给了她机会，要么公开承认她的话，要么撤下它，她两者都没有选择，”他周四告诉美国广播公司广播电台。 他指责该党将罗伯茨-史密斯的法庭诉讼政治化，并“毁坏”他自己的服务记录。 哈斯蒂说，这段视频是对在该案中作证的退伍军人的更广泛的攻击。 “这实际上是对退伍军人的攻击，而不仅仅是对我的攻击，因为你必须记住，有超过 20 多名 SAS 战斗退伍军人被传唤到联邦法院提供证据。他们也是叛徒吗？”他说。 乔伊斯说，他不知道一国漫画，但尊重哈斯蒂的服兵役经历。 “我很失望他认为我是个胆小鬼。我不知道他是如何得出这个观点的，但这取决于他。我不认为他是叛徒，”乔伊斯周四在议会外对记者说。 反对派辩护发言人詹姆斯·帕特森表示，汉森没有对这段视频承担责任，因此他很软弱。 他告诉 News24：“她拒绝对一部漫画负责，该漫画被固定在她的 X 页面顶部，是她授权的，她为该漫画提供画外音……她拒绝承担责任。” 绿党参议员大卫...

reflection.en: Words carry immense power, capable of building up or tearing down. This political cartoon, using the label 'traitor,' demonstrates how language can be weaponized to inflict damage and ignite controversy. It serves as a stark reminder to consider the impact of our words, especially in the public sphere, and to pursue truth with integrity rather than...
reflection.zh: 言语拥有巨大的力量，既能建造也能摧毁。这幅政治漫画使用“叛徒”的标签，表明语言可以被武器化以造成伤害并引发争议。它警示我们要考虑言语的影响，尤其是在公共领域，并以正直的态度追求真理，而不是诉诸分裂性的言辞。

verse.textZh: 生死在舌头的权下；喜爱它的，必吃它所结的果子。

title.en: The countries showing Australia a way out of its 'miserable' classroom situation
title.zh: 澳大利亚可以从世界上一些最好的教育方法中学到什么

summary.en: Australia's neighbours are among the world's top-ranked education performers, while Australian schools are reportedly sliding backwards on key measures like literacy, maths, and science.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚的邻国在教育表现方面位居世界前列，而澳大利亚的学校在识字、数学和科学等关键指标上却据称正在滑坡。

body.en:
Heightened classroom disruption, gender divides, dwindling reading and maths scores — a major global student performance report shows Australian schools are continuing to slide backwards on key measures.

Every three years, the global Programme for International Student Assessment (PISA) measures student literacy in mathematics, reading, science and computational problem-solving.

The 2025 edition, which tested 15-year-olds from 91 OECD countries and economies, also measured the effects of gender divides, differences between high and low socio-economic status, and the impacts of technology and classroom disruption.

In the latest report, released on Tuesday, Australia's scores continued a 20-year decline, with maths and reading at Australia's lowest since testing began in 2000.

But Pasi Sahlberg, a Finnish education expert, author and professor at the University of Melbourne, says reports focusing on issues with the Australian school system were missing the big picture.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"The headline is that we have all-time-low results. I think it's absolutely astonishing that our mainstream media are saying this. The truth is every country in the OECD is showing all-time-low results in everything. Very few countries were able to improve their results in 2025," Sahlberg told SBS News.

In the global ranking, Australia moved up one place in reading to 11th, maintained its 17th place in maths, and fell one place in science to 11th. In the computational problem solving category, introduced in 2025, Australia ranked 8th globally. Australia's scores were well above the OECD average in all four key tests.

On Wednesday, in light of the results, federal Education Minister Jason Clare announced new reforms in reading, mathematics and science. He pointed to England's success — the country jumped three places in reading to reach the top 10, four places in maths to 10th place and seven places in science to rank at 8th in the 2025 PISA report — to illustrate a need for various reforms. This includes a focus on phonics, which is a method of teaching reading and writing that uses the sounds of spoken language, changes to the maths curriculum, and reforms to screen time.

"The UK results are impressive. It’s also hard-earned. It’s something almost 20 years in the making," Clare said in a statement.

He said that Australian schools that have been following English methods for a while are showing improvements but he wants a broader roll-out.

body.zh: 课堂混乱加剧、性别鸿沟、阅读和数学成绩下降——一份主要的全球学生成绩报告显示，澳大利亚学校在关键指标上继续倒退。 每三年，全球国际学生评估计划 (PISA) 都会衡量学生在数学、阅读、科学和计算问题解决方面的素养。 2025 年版本对来自 91 个经合组织国家和经济体的 15 岁青少年进行了测试，还衡量了性别鸿沟的影响、高低社会经济地位之间的差异以及技术和课堂干扰的影响。 在周二发布的最新报告中，澳大利亚的成绩持续20年来的下降，其中数学和阅读成绩处于澳大利亚自2000年开始测试以来的最低水平。 但芬兰教育专家、作家兼墨尔本大学教授帕西·萨尔伯格表示，关注澳大利亚学校系统问题的报告忽视了全局。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 萨尔伯格对 SBS 新闻表示：“头条新闻是我们的业绩创下历史新低。我认为我们的主流媒体这么说绝对令人惊讶。事实是，经合组织中的每个国家在所有方面的业绩都创下历史新低。很少有国家能够在 2025 年改善其业绩。” 在全球排名中，澳大利亚在阅读方面上升一位至第 11 位，在数学方面保持第 17 位，在科学方面下降一位至第 11 位。在 2025 年推出的计算问题解决类别中，澳大利亚在全球排名第八。澳大利亚在所有四项关键测试中的得分均远高于经合组织的平均水平。 周三，根据结果，联邦教育部长贾森·克莱尔宣布了阅读、数学和科学方面的新改革。他指出英国的成功——在 2025 年 PISA 报告中，该国在阅读方面跃升了 3 位，进入前 10 名；在数学方面跃升了 4 位，跃居第 10 位；在科学方面跃升了 7 位，跃居第 8 位——以说明进行各种改革的必要性。其中包括对自然拼读法（一种利用口语发音进行阅读和写作教学的方法）的关注、数学课程的改变以及放映时间的改革。 “英国的成绩令人印象深刻。这也是来之不易的。这是近 20 年来的成果，”克莱尔在一份声明中说。 他说，一段时间以来一直遵循英语教学法的澳大利亚学校正在取得进步，但他希望更广泛地推广。 “我们需要超越这些排名，因为这些数据还向我们展示了澳大利亚和许多其他国家的年轻人的情况非常令人震惊......

This decline underscores the critical importance of how we shape and train the next generation, as Proverbs 22:6 advises, 'Train up a child in the way he should go; even when he is old he will not depart from it.' title.en: I became a grandparent at 37 when our other kids were in primary school. We felt guilty
title.zh: 37岁成为祖父母，其他孩子还在上小学。我们感到内疚

summary.en: Matt and Esther Acton say that being young grandparents comes with unexpected difficulties but also benefits.
summary.zh: 马特和埃丝特·阿克顿说，年轻的祖父母身份带来了意想不到的困难，但也带来了好处。

body.en:
What does grandparenting look like today? Insight explores whether the demands on modern-day grandparents are keeping them physically fit and mentally well, or if the younger generations' wants and needs are being prioritised to the detriment of grandparents. Watch Insight episode Grandparenting on SBS On Demand.

I love telling people I'm a grandfather at 39, then immediately stopping to leave dead silence between us.

Their eyes widen, and you see them do calculations in their head — wondering if they should ask the follow-up question: "How old were you when you had your first child?"

After a few seconds, I explain how my wife and I met when I was 18, and she was 22 and already had a three-year-old, Ethan. And Ethan and his wife, Maddy, had a child named Illyria when he was 22 years old — almost two years ago now.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

One minute, I'm doing school pickup or coaching our second son Zander's U12 rugby team.

The next, my wife Esther asks if I remembered to put our two-year-old granddaughter Illyria's car seat in the car to pick her up for a sleepover.

We threw all our baby stuff out the moment our youngest Eden was too big for it five years ago. We weren't expecting to need it so soon — only three years later.

Arguably, most older grandparents have children who are all grown up and they are retired — or close to it — and have the free time to put more energy into their grandchildren.

And sometimes, I feel a pang of jealousy for these older grandparents. I'm not jealous because it's a competition, but because they're at a stage of life with extra time to help their children.

We have more energy (we like to think) and remember what it was like to have a baby in the house. I mean, it was only six years ago that Eden, 9, was a toddler.

She and our granddaughter absolutely adore each other, and their relationship is somewhat unconventional, with just a seven-year age gap.

Eden is known as 'Yaunty' (young aunty), and her duties look more like a sister's duties. I love watching her play with her niece and getting the experience of having a little sister. 

Grandparenting episode • Insight • News And Current Affairs • 51m And watching our 23-year-old Ethan become a dad has been the next best thing to becoming one myself.

He's not just attentive as a father, but he gives his heart fully to his wife and daughters. (I should mention they've just had another baby, Ananyah, who is one week old as I write this.)

He and I were extremely close when he was little, and we had a bit more distance when he was a teenager, becoming his own man, which is a normal and healthy rite of passage...
body.zh: 今天的祖父母是什么样子的？ 《洞察》探讨了对现代祖父母的要求是否使他们保持身体健康和心理健康，或者是否优先考虑了年轻一代的需求，而损害了祖父母的利益。观看 SBS On Demand 的《Insight》剧集《祖父母》。 我喜欢在 39 岁时告诉别人我已经是祖父了，然后立即停下来，让我们之间陷入死一般的沉默。 他们睁大眼睛，你会看到他们在脑子里进行计算——想知道他们是否应该问后续问题：“你生第一个孩子的时候多大了？” 几秒钟后，我解释了我和妻子是如何在我 18 岁时认识的，当时她 22 岁，已经有了一个三岁的孩子伊森 (Ethan)。伊森 (Ethan) 和他的妻子麦迪 (Maddy) 在他 22 岁时生了一个孩子，名叫伊利里亚 (Illyria)——差不多是两年前的事了。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 前一分钟，我正在学校接送或指导我们的二儿子 Zander 的 U12 橄榄球队。 接下来，我的妻子埃丝特问我是否记得将我们两岁的孙女伊利里亚的汽车座椅放在车里，以便接她去过夜。 五年前，当我们最小的伊甸园太大而无法容纳婴儿时，我们就把所有婴儿用品都扔掉了。我们没想到这么快就需要它——仅仅三年后。 可以说，大多数年长的祖父母都有已经长大的孩子，他们已经退休——或者接近退休——并且有空闲时间把更多的精力放在孙辈身上。 有时，我对这些年长的祖父母感到一阵嫉妒。我嫉妒不是因为这是一场比赛，而是因为他们正处于人生的一个阶段，有额外的时间来帮助他们的孩子。 我们有更多的精力（我们喜欢思考）并且记得在家里生孩子的感觉。我的意思是，仅仅六年前，9 岁的伊登还是个蹒跚学步的孩子。 她和我们的孙女非常相爱，而且他们的关系有些非传统，年龄差距只有七岁。 伊甸园被称为“Yaunty”（年轻的阿姨），她的职责看起来更像是姐妹的职责。我喜欢看她和她的侄女一起玩耍，并获得有一个小妹妹的经历。 祖父母剧集• 洞察• 新闻与时事• 51m 看着我们23 岁的Ethan 成为一名父亲，是仅次于我自己成为一名父亲的最好的事情。 他不仅是一个父亲，更是全心全意地照顾妻子和女儿。 （我应该提一下，他们刚刚生了另一个孩子，Ananyah，在我写这篇文章时他已经一周大了。） 当他小的时候，我和他关系非常亲密，而当他十几岁的时候，我们的距离就远了一些，成为了自己的男人，这是一个正常而健康的成人仪式……

reflection.en: The news story touches on the unique experience of becoming a grandparent at a young age, highlighting both the challenges and joys. Psalm 127:3 reminds us that children are a gift from Yahweh, a blessing that transcends age and circumstance. This perspective can help reframe the 'guilt' mentioned by the parents, seeing their role not as a burden, but as a...
reflection.zh: 这则新闻报道触及了年轻时成为祖父母的独特经历，既强调了挑战，也强调了乐趣。诗篇127:3提醒我们，儿女是雅伟所赐的产业，是一份超越年龄和环境的祝福。这种视角有助于重新定义父母提到的“内疚感”，将他们的角色视为神圣的托付，而非负担。

verse.textEn: Children are a heritage from Yahweh, offspring a reward from him.
verse.textZh: 儿女是雅伟所赐的产业。

title.en: ‘Lying cowards’: Hastie lashes Hanson and Joyce over cartoon dispute
title.zh: “撒谎的懦夫”：哈斯蒂抨击汉森和乔伊斯关于漫画的争端

summary.en: Liberal MP Andrew Hastie has demanded One Nation leader Pauline Hanson remove a cartoon video he claims smeared his military service, calling her and Barnaby Joyce "lying cowards" amid an intensifying row over an accused war criminal.
summary.zh: 自由党议员安德鲁·哈斯蒂要求一国党领袖宝琳·汉森删除一幅他声称诽谤其军旅生涯的漫画视频，并称她和巴纳比·乔伊斯为“撒谎的懦夫”，此前围绕一名被指控的战争罪犯的争执愈演愈烈。

body.en:
Pauline Hanson and Barnaby Joyce have been labelled "lying cowards" by a federal Liberal MP as a row over an alleged war criminal intensifies.

Liberal MP Andrew Hastie claimed in an email to supporters this week that Hanson had branded him a traitor, following a cartoon video posted to the One Nation leader's X account.

The nine-minute video, posted on 23 July, remained pinned at the top of the senator's X account.

There has been tension between Hastie, an SAS veteran, and Hanson since he spoke out against accused war criminal Ben Roberts-Smith.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The row heightened when Hastie was subpoenaed to testify in court against Roberts-Smith.

Hanson's closest supporter, billionaire Gina Rinehart, has backed Roberts-Smith and has named a planned housing complex for veterans in his honour.

But Hanson denied suggesting Hastie was a traitor, telling The Nightly newspaper she would define him as "a w****r".

"I dearly hope that nobody is threatening Andrew or his family, and certainly not premising (threats) on anything to do with One Nation,'' he told reporters.

Hastie branded Hanson and Joyce, his former coalition colleague, as "lying cowards", speaking to News24 on Wednesday.

The WA MP accused the party of politicising the Roberts-Smith court proceedings and "trashing" his own service record.

"I would say that Pauline Hanson and Barnaby Joyce are lying cowards, and I'll say it again so there's no ambiguity,'' he said.

"And then: On July 23, at the top of her X account, she posted a cartoon ... I'm called a traitor eight times ... when you start calling me a traitor to my own country, then we have a big, big problem."

"I stand with a lot of Australians who believe in the rule of law, who believe that Australian soldiers should be held to high standards of battlefield conduct," Hastie said.

body.zh: 随着围绕一名战犯的争吵愈演愈烈，宝琳·汉森（Pauline Hanson）和巴纳比·乔伊斯（Barnaby Joyce）被一名联邦自由党议员称为“撒谎的胆小鬼”。 自由党议员安德鲁·哈斯蒂本周在给支持者的一封电子邮件中声称，在一国党领导人的 X 账户上发布了一段卡通视频后，汉森将他称为叛徒。 这段 9 分钟的视频于 7 月 23 日发布，仍然固定在参议员 X 帐户的顶部。 自从汉森公开反对被指控的战犯本·罗伯茨-史密斯以来，SAS退伍军人哈斯蒂和汉森之间的关系一直紧张。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 当哈斯蒂被传唤出庭作证指控罗伯茨-史密斯时，争吵加剧。 汉森最亲密的支持者、亿万富翁吉娜·莱因哈特支持罗伯茨·史密斯，并以他的名字命名了一个计划中的退伍军人住宅区。 但汉森否认暗示哈斯蒂是叛徒，并告诉《晚间报》，她将把他定义为“一个w****r”。 他对记者说：“我衷心希望没有人威胁安德鲁或他的家人，当然也不要以与一国党有关的任何事情为前提（威胁）。” 周三，哈斯蒂在接受 News24 采访时，将汉森和他的前联盟同事乔伊斯称为“撒谎的胆小鬼”。 这位西澳议员指责该党将罗伯茨-史密斯法庭诉讼政治化，并“毁掉”了他自己的服务记录。 “我想说宝琳·汉森和巴纳比·乔伊斯都是撒谎的胆小鬼，我会再说一遍，这样就不会含糊不清了，”他说。 “然后：7月23日，在她的X账户顶部，她发布了一幅漫画……我被称为叛徒八次……当你开始称我为祖国的叛徒时，我们就有了一个很大很大的问题。” 哈斯蒂说：“我与许多相信法治的澳大利亚人站在一起，他们认为澳大利亚士兵应该遵守高标准的战场行为。” 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

reflection.en: Words carry immense power, capable of building up or tearing down reputations and lives. The exchange between MP Hastie and Senator Hanson, involving accusations and a controversial cartoon, demonstrates how language can escalate conflict and inflict deep wounds. May we be mindful of the impact of our words, choosing truth and respect even in disagreement,...
reflection.zh: 言语拥有巨大的力量，既能建设也能摧毁声誉和生命。哈斯蒂议员和汉森参议员之间的争执，涉及指控和一幅有争议的漫画，表明语言如何加剧冲突并造成深刻的伤害。愿我们铭记言语的影响力，即使在意见不合时也选择真理和尊重，体现“生死在舌头的权下”的智慧。

verse.textEn: The tongue has the power of life and death, and those who love it will eat its fruit.
verse.textZh: 生死在舌头的权下；喜爱它的，必吃它所结的果子。

title.en: How an NFL match in Melbourne came to be, and its historic links
title.zh: NFL在墨尔本的比赛如何实现，及其历史渊源

summary.en: A century before the NFL arrived for its anticipated match at the MCG, American football had already reached Melbourne.
summary.zh: 在NFL抵达墨尔本板球场进行备受期待的比赛一个世纪前，美式足球早已传入墨尔本。

body.en:
The San Francisco 49ers take on the Los Angeles Rams at the Melbourne Cricket Ground on Friday morning in what will be the league's first regular-season game in Australia, and just the second game overall of the 2026 season.

The match kicks off on Friday at 10.35am and is geared around the Thursday night TV audience in the US. Kick-off time will be 5.35pm on the US West Coast and 8.35pm on the East Coast.

The NFL has a four-year contract with Victoria to host at least two games in Melbourne, with an option for a third, and is part of the NFL’s International Series, which started in 2007 at London's Wembley Stadium.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The Victorian government beat out serious bids from both NSW and Western Australia to host these games, and is thought to be paying the NFL about $15 million per game.

The match at the MCG will be one of nine international matches scheduled this season — including matches in Paris, Rio de Janeiro, Munich, Madrid, and London. NFL commissioner Roger Goodell has expressed interest in having every team play once in a foreign market each season.

While exhibition games between NFL teams have been played beyond US borders since 1969, some countries, like England, took time to build a following, while others, like Mexico, embraced it immediately.

In fact, the largest crowd in NFL history is 112,376 at the Azteca Stadium in Mexico City in 1994 when the Houston Oilers beat the Dallas Cowboys.

Other stadiums have also hosted NFL regular-season games outside the United States, including the Bernabéu in Madrid, Croke Park in Dublin, Twickenham in London, plus stadiums in Berlin, Munich, Frankfurt and São Paulo in Brazil.

The NFL has ramped up international efforts in recent times by inviting teams to apply for international marketing rights for various countries.

As of Wednesday afternoon, only one of the two teams playing on Friday — the San Francisco 49ers — has arrived in Australia.

"This has been such a cool experience," said 49ers running back Christian McCaffrey.

"There were question marks when we heard we were playing in Australia. Since we got here, it has been so cool. The people are unbelievable, the food's incredible, the coffee is great. The atmosphere, you can already feel it, it's been so much fun and we are super fired up we're here."

Four teams have been given the rights to Australia and New Zealand — the Los Angeles Rams, Philadelphia Eagles, Las Vegas Raiders, and the reigning Super Bowl champions, the Seattle Seahawks.

body.zh: 旧金山 49 人队将于周五上午在墨尔本板球场迎战洛杉矶公羊队，这将是联盟在澳大利亚的首场常规赛比赛，也是 2026 赛季的第二场比赛。 比赛将于周五上午 10.35 开始，面向美国周四晚间的电视观众。美国西海岸的开球时间为下午 5.35 分，东海岸的开球时间为晚上 8.35 分。 NFL 与维多利亚签订了一份为期四年的合同，将在墨尔本举办至少两场比赛，并可以选择举办第三场比赛，并且是 NFL 国际系列赛的一部分，该系列赛于 2007 年在伦敦温布利体育场开始。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 维多利亚州政府击败了新南威尔士州和西澳大利亚州主办这些比赛的激烈竞标，据信每场比赛将向 NFL 支付约 1500 万美元。 MCG 的这场比赛将是本赛季安排的九场国际比赛之一，其中包括巴黎、里约热内卢、慕尼黑、马德里和伦敦的比赛。 NFL 总裁罗杰·古德尔表示有兴趣让每支球队每个赛季在国外市场比赛一次。 虽然 NFL 球队之间的表演赛自 1969 年起就在美国境外进行，但一些国家（例如英格兰）花了很长时间才培养了一批追随者，而另一些国家（例如墨西哥）则立即接受了这种做法。 事实上，NFL 历史上观众人数最多的一次是 1994 年墨西哥城阿兹台克体育场，当时休斯敦油人队击败达拉斯牛仔队，观众数量达到 112,376 人。 其他体育场馆也在美国境外举办过 NFL 常规赛比赛，包括马德里的伯纳乌球场、都柏林的克罗克公园球场、伦敦的特威克纳姆球场，以及柏林、慕尼黑、法兰克福和巴西圣保罗的体育场馆。 NFL 最近加大了国际力度，邀请球队申请各国的国际营销权。 截至周三下午，周五比赛的两支球队中只有一支——旧金山 49 人队——已抵达澳大利亚。 “这是一次很酷的经历，”49 人队跑卫克里斯蒂安·麦卡弗里 (Christian McCaffrey) 说道。 “当我们听说我们要在澳大利亚比赛时，我们都感到很疑惑。自从我们来到这里以来，一切都太酷了。这里的人们令人难以置信，食物令人难以置信，咖啡也很棒。这里的气氛，你已经可以感受到了，这真是太有趣了，我们对来到这里感到非常兴奋。” 四支球队获得了澳大利亚和新西兰的参赛权——洛杉矶公羊队、费城老鹰队、拉斯维加斯突袭者队和超级碗卫冕冠军西雅图海鹰队。 公羊队是澳大利亚指定球队之一，但他们直到比赛前 24 小时才到达这里，选择...

reflection.en: The NFL's upcoming games in Melbourne, secured through a multi-year contract, represent a significant investment and strategic planning. This endeavor, aiming to bring a major sporting event to a new continent, echoes the wisdom of committing one's plans and work to divine guidance, trusting that Yahweh will establish them. It's a reminder that even grand...
reflection.zh: NFL与维多利亚州签订的多年合同，将在墨尔本举办比赛，这代表着一项重大的投资和战略规划。这项旨在将重大体育赛事引入新大陆的努力，呼应了将人的计划和工作交托给神圣指引的智慧，并信靠雅伟将成就它们。这提醒我们，即使是宏伟的人类事业，最好也是在祈祷和依靠的基础上进行的。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Blanche d'Alpuget, acclaimed writer and wife of Bob Hawke, dies at 82
title.zh: 著名作家、鲍勃·霍克遗孀布兰奇·达尔普吉去世，享年82岁

summary.en: Blanche d'Alpuget, an acclaimed Australian writer and widow of former Prime Minister Bob Hawke, has passed away at the age of 82. Her family remembered her as a vibrant individual who "lived life on her own terms," characterized by her vitality, generosity, and curiosity.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚著名作家、前总理鲍勃·霍克的遗孀布兰奇·达尔普吉（Blanche d'Alpuget）去世，享年82岁。她的家人回忆她是一位充满活力、慷慨大方、好奇心强的人，她“按照自己的意愿生活”。

body.en:
Blanche d'Alpuget, the Australian writer and widow of former prime minister Bob Hawke, has died.

In a statement, d'Alpuget's family remembered her as someone who lived "entirely on her own terms".

"She was full of vitality, generosity and curiosity, with an extraordinary appetite for beauty, ideas, history, new places and spirited conversation. She refused to be confined by convention or by other people's expectations of who she should be," they said.

"We will miss her force, her humour, her curiosity and her love beyond measure."

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

They shared the words d'Alpuget lived by: “Our highest calling and greatest achievement is love, the rule of life. Love one another."

Having never lost her appetite for life, d'Alpuget refused to be confined by convention or by other people's expectations of who she should be, the family said.

Just two years before her death, at age 80, she swam with whale sharks in Indonesia and a year later published her final novel, a murder mystery entitled The Bunny Club.

She is survived by her son, artist and sculptor Louis Pratt, daughter-in-law Brianna and granddaughter Sienna.

The author married Hawke in 1995 after a tumultuous on-again, off-again affair that ran throughout the tenure of his prime ministership.

The pair, who met at a party in 1970, remained together for 24 years until his death in 2019.

Hawke controversially divorced his first wife, the popular Hazel, in 1994, which caused great family upheaval. She died in 2013.

Prime Minister Anthony Albanese has shared his condolences, saying Australia has lost "a true one-off".

"As a writer, she was at home in fiction as she was in non-fiction, working in each realm with a keen eye for every telling detail that opened up the humanity of her subject to her readers," he said.

"Blanche’s novels were compelling works of verve and originality, and her biographies comprehensive and definitive – most famously those she wrote of Bob Hawke, who became her great love and ultimately her husband."

Born in Sydney on January 3, 1944, d'Alpuget was shaped by early travels in Indonesia, Malaysia and Europe with first husband and diplomat, Tony Pratt, with whom she had her son.

She began a more than six-decade career as a writer at The Daily Mirror and Woman's Day in Sydney and later at the News of the World in London.

Gaining literary acclaim for her fictional works, d'Alpuget was also a lauded biographer, including a 1982 book on her later husband titled, Robert J. Hawke: A Biography.

She met Hawke in Jakarta in 1970, but reconnected later in life — taking a job writing his biography, work that would later cement...
body.zh: 澳大利亚作家、前总理鲍勃·霍克的遗孀布兰奇·达尔普盖特去世。 在一份声明中，达普吉特的家人记得她是一个“完全按照自己的方式生活”的人。 他们说：“她充满活力、慷慨和好奇心，对美、思想、历史、新地方和充满活力的谈话有着非凡的兴趣。她拒绝受传统或其他人对她应该成为什么样的人的期望的限制。” “我们会怀念她的力量、她的幽默、她的好奇心和她无法估量的爱。” 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 他们分享了 d'Alpuget 的人生格言：“我们最高的使命和最大的成就是爱，是生活的准则。彼此相爱。” 澳大利亚总理安东尼·阿尔巴内塞表达了哀悼，称澳大利亚失去了“真正的一次性”。 他说：“作为一名作家，她既擅长小说，也擅长非小说类作品，在每个领域都以敏锐的眼光关注每一个细节，向读者展示她的主题的人性。” “布兰奇的小说是充满活力和独创性的引人入胜的作品，她的传记全面而明确——最著名的是她写的鲍勃·霍克的传记，鲍勃·霍克成为了她的挚爱，并最终成为她的丈夫。” 20 多岁时，她开始从事新闻事业，并与第一任丈夫托尼·普拉特 (Tony Pratt) 一起环游世界。 她在印度尼西亚、马来西亚和欧洲旅行和生活过，然后在 30 多岁时返回澳大利亚。 1970 年，她在雅加达遇见了霍克，但后来又重新建立了联系——接受了为霍克撰写传记的工作，这份工作后来巩固了她作为一名获奖作家的地位。 两人于 1995 年结婚，在霍克于 2019 年去世之前，他们共同生活了二十多年。 她的家人说：“80岁时，她回到印度尼西亚水域，与四王群岛的鲸鲨一起游泳。” 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

Her passing reminds us of the universal human appointment with death, a reality that touches every life, regardless of how fully it is lived. As Hebrews 9:27 states, death comes to all, a shared human experience that calls us to reflect on the brevity and...
reflection.zh: 布兰奇·达尔普吉，这位以其充满活力的精神和“按照自己的意愿生活”而闻名的作家，已于82岁辞世。她的离世提醒我们，死亡是全人类的定数，无论生命多么精彩，这都是一个触及每个人的现实。正如希伯来书9:27所说，人人都有一死，这是人类共同的经历，促使我们反思生命的短暂与宝贵。

verse.textEn: Just as people are destined to die once, and after that to face judgment.
verse.textZh: 按着定命，人人都有一死，死后且有审判。

title.en: The crime more Australians are committing amid cost of living pressures
title.zh: 生活成本压力下，澳大利亚人犯罪增多

summary.en: Rising living costs and stagnant wages are increasingly leading Australians to steal petrol, with studies indicating these economic pressures are a stronger driver of petrol theft than fluctuating fuel prices.
summary.zh: 不断上涨的生活成本和停滞不前的工资正日益导致澳大利亚人盗窃汽油，研究表明，这些经济压力比波动的燃油价格更能驱动汽油盗窃。

body.en:
Cost of living pressures are driving more people to speed away without paying at the bowser than sky-high petrol prices, a study has revealed.

The NSW Bureau of Crime Statistics has released a report that found higher living costs and decreased wages had a stronger link to rates of petrol theft than fluctuating prices.

The bureau launched its investigation after a sharp increase in petrol theft following the COVID-19 pandemic despite stable fuel prices, executive director Jackie Fitzgerald told the Australian Associated Press (AAP).

"[Cost of living pressure] tends to mount up over time, and that will encourage people to commit these kinds of crimes, but they can weather a short-term fluctuation," she said.

"It's not just a criminal subclass that is involved in these matters. It's kind of bleeding into other parts of the community."

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

According to the report, a 1 per cent increase in petrol price was associated with a 1 per cent increase in thefts.

By comparison, a 1 per cent spike in living costs was linked to a 6 per cent increase in thefts.

Petrol thieves are also rather likely to get away with the crime, Fitzgerald said, with police only laying charges in 4 to 8 per cent of cases.

"People are more likely to engage in crime if they think they can get away with it," she said.

"There's clearly some people … whose economic situation is sufficiently dire that they will start to consider those options."

Rates of petrol theft in NSW peaked in 2024 — even higher than when the price of fuel skyrocketed in early 2026 due to the Iran-Israel-US conflict.

Australasian Convenience and Petroleum Marketers Association chief executive officer Rowan Lee told AAP the spike in thefts had been recorded nationwide, with no single state or territory standing out.

There had also been a rise in aggression towards service station staff, the association said.

Fitzgerald said requiring motorists to pay before filling up could help prevent thefts.

"It's inconvenient for people, but ... this study suggests you could turn on those kind of strategies when the conditions are ripe for an increase in petrol theft," she said.

body.zh: 一项研究显示，与天价汽油相比，生活成本压力促使更多人不付钱就加速出行。 新南威尔士州犯罪统计局发布的一份报告发现，与价格波动相比，生活成本上升和工资下降与汽油盗窃率的关系更强。 该局执行董事杰基·菲茨杰拉德 (Jackie Fitzgerald) 告诉澳大利亚美联社 (AAP)，尽管燃油价格稳定，但自 COVID-19 大流行以来，汽油盗窃事件急剧增加，该局启动了调查。 “[生活成本压力]往往会随着时间的推移而增加，这将鼓励人们犯下此类犯罪，但他们可以承受短期波动，”她说。 “参与这些事情的不仅仅是犯罪阶层。它正在渗透到社区的其他部分。” 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 报告称，汽油价格每上涨 1%，盗窃案就会增加 1%。 相比之下，生活成本每上涨 1%，盗窃案就会增加 6%。 菲茨杰拉德说，汽油窃贼也很有可能逃脱惩罚，警方只对 4% 至 8% 的案件提出指控。 “如果人们认为自己可以逃脱惩罚，他们就更有可能参与犯罪，”她说。 “显然有些人……他们的经济状况非常糟糕，他们会开始考虑这些选择。” 新南威尔士州的汽油盗窃率在 2024 年达到顶峰，甚至高于 2026 年初因伊朗、以色列和美国冲突而导致燃油价格飙升的情况。 澳大利亚便利和石油营销商协会首席执行官罗文·李 (Rowan Lee) 告诉澳联社，全国范围内的盗窃案件激增，没有一个州或地区表现突出。 该协会表示，针对加油站工作人员的攻击行为也有所增加。 菲茨杰拉德表示，要求驾车者在加油前付款可能有助于防止盗窃。 “这对人们来说很不方便，但是……这项研究表明，当汽油盗窃案增加的条件成熟时，你可以采取这种策略，”她说。 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

title.en: Suicide reporting guidelines expanded for social media
title.zh: 香港扩大社交媒体自杀报告指南

summary.en: Hong Kong's primary suicide surveillance center has updated its suicide reporting recommendations to include social media platforms, aiming to reduce harm and promote responsible information sharing, especially for young people. The University of Hong Kong's Centre for Suicide Research and Prevention released the 2026...
summary.zh: 香港主要的自杀监测中心已将其自杀报告建议扩展到社交媒体平台，旨在减少伤害并促进负责任的信息传播，特别是针对年轻人。香港大学预防自杀研究中心在世界自杀预防日发布了2026年版指南，指出尽管总体自杀率自2003年达到峰值以来有所下降，但青少年自杀问题仍然令人担忧。

body.en: The city’s primary suicide surveillance centre has expanded its suicide reporting recommendations to cover social media in a push to minimise harm and encourage responsible information dissemination, particularly among young people. On World Suicide Prevention Day on Thursday, the University of Hong Kong’s Centre for Suicide Research and Prevention (CSRP) released the 2026 edition of its suicide reporting recommendations, which was expanded to cover social media users and platform operators. Hong Kong recorded an estimated 976 suicides in 2025, a rate of 13 deaths per 100,000 residents. While overall rates have declined since the 2003 peak, youth suicide remains at a high level, with suicide the third leading cause of death among people aged 15 to 29 globally. The recommendations follow a study in collaboration with the Hong Kong Press Council that reviewed 1,200 online suicide-related news reports published between December 2023 and November 2025. Researchers found persistent gaps in traditional coverage, including missing warning signs, excessive location details, insufficient prevention resources, and explicit descriptions of methods. The study also found that while social media does not appear to influence suicide rates in the general population, it has a significant effect on young people. With adolescents and young adults increasingly relying on social platforms for news, the updated recommendations call on journalists to report on suicide cases only when there is clear public interest in doing so. The study also recommended including crisis hotlines and support resources in the body of the story while avoiding speculation on any possible causes. They also urged newsrooms to withhold from talking about specific methods and locations, avoid publishing suicide notes, and using neutral, non-stigmatising language. “I think we have to be aware that every single one of us are information disseminators, so there is a public duty that we should do our best for the public,” said Melissa Pang, chairman of the Press Council. “When we realise social media is doing a report on suicide incidents, we have to ensure we do not just keep reposting that. We have to be aware of the consequences.” Organisers said the goal is to promote “responsible information dissemination” across society, stressing that safe communication now depends not only on professional newsrooms, but also on platforms and individual users. Edited by Tony Sabine
body.zh: 该市主要的自杀监测中心已将自杀报告建议范围扩大到社交媒体，以尽量减少伤害并鼓励负责任的信息传播，特别是在年轻人中。周四世界预防自杀日，香港大学自杀研究及预防中心（CSRP）发布了2026年版自杀报告建议，范围扩大到涵盖社交媒体用户和平台运营商。 2025 年，香港估计有 976 人自杀，即每 10 万居民中有 13 人死亡。尽管整体自杀率自 2003 年峰值以来有所下降，但青少年自杀率仍处于较高水平，自杀是全球 15 至 29 岁人群的第三大死因。这些建议是在与香港报业评议会合作进行的一项研究之后提出的，该研究审查了 2023 年 12 月至 2025 年 11 月期间发布的 1,200 篇与自杀相关的在线新闻报道。研究人员发现传统报道中持续存在缺陷，包括缺少警告标志、过多的位置细节、预防资源不足以及对方法的明确描述。研究还发现，虽然社交媒体似乎不会影响普通人群的自杀率，但它对年轻人有显着影响。随着青少年和年轻人越来越依赖社交平台获取新闻，更新后的建议呼吁记者只有在公众有明确兴趣的情况下才报道自杀案件。该研究还建议在故事正文中加入危机热线和支持资源，同时避免猜测任何可能的原因。他们还敦促新闻编辑室不要谈论具体的方法和地点，避免发表遗书，并使用中立、非污名化的语言。 “我认为我们必须意识到，我们每个人都是信息传播者，因此我们有一项公共责任，那就是我们应该为公众尽力而为，”报评会主席彭梅丽莎说。 “当我们意识到社交媒体正在报道自杀事件时，我们必须确保我们不会只是不断转发。我们必须意识到后果。”组织者表示，目标是促进全社会“负责任的信息传播”，并强调现在的安全沟通不仅取决于专业新闻编辑室，还取决于平台和个人用户。托尼·萨宾编辑

reflection.en: In Hong Kong, new guidelines aim to protect young people by addressing how suicide is reported on social media. This effort acknowledges the profound distress that can lead individuals to despair. Yahweh is close to those who are brokenhearted and crushed in spirit, offering solace and presence amidst suffering.
reflection.zh: 在香港，新的指南旨在通过规范社交媒体上的自杀报道来保护年轻人。这项努力认识到可能导致个体陷入绝望的深切痛苦。雅伟靠近心灵破碎、灵里忧伤的人，在苦难中提供安慰和同在。

verse.textEn: Yahweh is close to the brokenhearted and saves those who are crushed in spirit.
verse.textZh: 雅伟靠近伤心的人，拯救灵性痛悔的人。

title.en: Hong Kong signs 2 MOUs with Greater Bay Area partners to commercialise aerial technology

Deputy Financial Secretary Michael Wong Wai-lun said on Thursday the cross-border pacts would combine the production and testing capabilities of the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macau bay area with Hong Kong’s strengths in research and standards setting. “These...

It echoes the wisdom of committing our endeavors to divine guidance, trusting that our plans, when aligned with higher purposes, will be established. May this venture be marked by integrity and foresight.

title.en: Hong Kong ready to be biotech bridge, says Paul Chan
title.zh: 陈茂波：香港准备好成为生物科技的桥梁

summary.en: Financial Secretary Paul Chan stated that Hong Kong is prepared to serve as the preferred partner linking international investment with China's biotechnology advancements. He noted the significant growth in global biotech fundraising and deal values last year, driven by factors such as aging populations, increased...
summary.zh: 财政司司长陈茂波表示，香港已准备好成为连接全球资本与中国生物科技创新的“首选合作伙伴”。他指出，去年全球生物科技融资额和交易额均大幅增长，这得益于人口老龄化、医疗需求增加以及人工智能在药物发现等技术进步的推动。陈茂波强调，香港是全球第二大生物科技融资平台。

body.en: Financial Secretary Paul Chan said Hong Kong stands ready to be the "partner of choice" that connects global capital with Chinese biotech innovation in an address to the Biotechnology Investment Forum of BIOHK2026 on Thursday. He pointed out that global biotech fundraising reached approximately US$70 billion last year, an increase of more than 10 percent, and the value of deals hit US$300 billion –an all-time high. The sector's momentum, he said, is being driven by ageing populations, rising healthcare needs and technological progress, including the use of artificial intelligence in drug discovery. Chan highlighted Hong Kong's role as the world's second-largest biotech fundraising platform, with close to 300 healthcare companies listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange and a combined market capitalisation exceeding US$480 billion. A Hong Kong listing, he pointed out, connects emerging pharmaceutical firms with global capital while allowing international investors to access Chinese innovation. Chan also pointed to the Hong Kong Investment Corporation's allocation of 22 percent of its funds to the biotech sector and the Greater Bay Area as a rapidly emerging centre for biomedical innovation. Five of the world's top 10 pharmaceutical companies, he stressed, have already chosen Hong Kong as their regional research and development base. "The convergence of capital, talent, enterprises and industry creates powerful opportunities for the biotech sector," Chan said. "Scientific progress, social benefit and sustainable returns can – and should – advance together." Edited by Tony Sabine
body.zh: 财政司司长陈茂波周四在 BIOHK2026 生物科技投资论坛上致辞时表示，香港已准备好成为连接全球资本与中国生物科技创新的“首选合作伙伴”。他指出，去年全球生物科技融资额达到约700亿美元，增长超过10%，交易金额达到3000亿美元，创历史新高。他说，该行业的发展势头是由人口老龄化、不断增长的医疗保健需求和技术进步（包括在药物发现中使用人工智能）推动的。陈强调香港作为全球第二大生物科技融资平台的地位，有近300家医疗保健公司在香港联交所上市，总市值超过4800亿美元。他指出，在香港上市将新兴制药公司与全球资本联系起来，同时让国际投资者能够接触到中国的创新。陈还指出，香港投资公司将22%的资金分配给生物科技行业和大湾区作为快速新兴的生物医药创新中心。他强调，全球十大制药公司中有五家已选择香港作为区域研发基地。 “资本、人才、企业和产业的融合为生物技术行业创造了强大的机遇，”陈说。 “科学进步、社会效益和可持续回报可以而且应该共同进步。”托尼·萨宾编辑

reflection.en: Hong Kong's ambition to bridge global finance and Chinese biotech innovation is a significant undertaking. Proverbs 16:3 reminds us that success in our endeavors, especially those involving careful planning and execution like connecting capital with innovation, comes when we commit our work to Yahweh. May the city's leaders and innovators seek wisdom and...
reflection.zh: 香港立志成为连接全球金融与中国生物科技创新的桥梁，这是一项意义重大的事业。箴言16章3节提醒我们，在我们所做的各项事上，尤其是在需要周密计划和执行的领域，如连接资本与创新，成功源于将工作交托于雅伟。愿这座城市的领导者和创新者寻求智慧和指引，将他们的计划交托给雅伟，以期获得丰硕的成果。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.zh: 以社会价值观为导向发展知识

summary.en: The educational philosophy of “cultivating values and nurturing people” is rooted in a classic Chinese saying that emphasizes building good morals and social responsibility alongside academic and technical knowledge. This ethos guides the Education University of Hong Kong's (EdUHK) strategic growth, influencing its...
summary.zh: “以德育人、培养人才”的教育理念源于中国一句古语，强调在学术和技术知识之外，培养良好的道德品质和社会责任感。香港教育大学（EdUHK）以此为核心，指导其发展战略，包括本科和研究生课程设计、研究工作以及全球合作伙伴关系。

body.en: The educational ethos of “cultivating values and nurturing people” is based on a classic Chinese saying that emphasises building good morals and a sense of social responsibility alongside academic and technical knowledge. At the Education University of Hong Kong (EdUHK), this ethos drives the institution’s approach to its growth strategy, from the way its undergraduate and postgraduate programmes are designed to its research work and the partnerships it is building around the world to share...
body.zh: “立德树人”的教育理念源于中国古典谚语，强调在学术和技术知识的同时培养良好的道德和社会责任感。在香港教育大学（EdUHK），这种精神推动了该机构的发展战略，从本科和研究生课程的设计方式到研究工作以及在世界各地建立的合作伙伴关系……

reflection.en: In an age where knowledge and technology advance at an unprecedented pace, the wisdom of integrating moral and social values into education becomes ever more critical. The Education University of Hong Kong's commitment to 'cultivating values and nurturing people' reminds us that true progress lies not just in what we know, but in how we apply that knowledge...
reflection.zh: 在这个知识和技术以前所未有的速度发展的时代，将道德和社会价值观融入教育的智慧变得至关重要。香港教育大学“以德育人、培养人才”的承诺提醒我们，真正的进步不仅在于我们所知道的，更在于我们如何以正直和关爱他人的方式运用这些知识。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。
