The Centre for Suicide Research and Prevention at the University of Hong Kong also used World Suicide Prevention Day on Thursday to call for schools to ramp up support for students in light of a spate of suicide attempts around the start of the academic...

It underscores the profound spiritual and emotional struggles many young people face today, often amplified by the pressures of social media. He said the pair had jointly devised a “full plan” to...

reflection.en: This case brings to light the vulnerability of individuals with autism within the justice system. Proverbs 31:8-9 calls us to "Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute." It reminds us to advocate for the marginalized and ensure their voices are heard, especially when they may struggle to articulate their...
reflection.zh: 此案凸显了自闭症患者在司法体系中的脆弱性。《箴言》31:8-9 呼吁我们“为不能自辩的开口，为所有孤苦者伸张正义”。这提醒我们要为边缘化群体发声，确保他们的声音被听见，尤其是在他们可能难以表达自身需求或理解复杂情况时。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Cigarette packs to get a plain look starting in March
title.zh: 香烟包装将从三月起采用统一外观

summary.en: Hong Kong authorities announced that conventional tobacco products will transition to uniform packaging methods starting in March over a nine-month period. This change restricts physical features, colors, and brand logos to remove appealing design elements. Additionally, 12 existing health warnings, in use since 2018,...
summary.zh: 香港政府周四宣布，传统烟草产品将从三月起进入为期九个月的统一包装过渡期。此次转变将限制烟草产品的物理特征、颜色和品牌标识，以消除其吸引力。此外，自2018年以来使用的12条图文健康警语将进行更新，以维持其对吸烟的警示作用，吸烟是导致失明和癌症等慢性疾病的原因。

body.en: Conventional smoking products in Hong Kong will have to start adopting uniform packaging methods from March as part of a nine-month transition period, the government announced on Thursday. With the switchover, the physical features, colours and brand logos of tobacco products face restrictions to ensure that the packaging has no brand elements and design to enhance its appeal. In addition, 12 health warnings – both in the form of pictures and text that have been in use since 2018 – will be updated so as to maintain their deterrent effect against smoking for being the cause of such disabilities as blindness or chronic diseases as cancers. An existing requirement for manufacturers to display tar and nicotine levels will also be scrapped to avoid creating the false impression that products with low levels of the two components are less harmful. A duty stamp system will also be implemented simultaneously, meaning that all products on which levies have been paid have to come with both physical and digital anti-counterfeiting stamps. Those who violate the uniform packaging requirement could be fined up to HK$50,000. Manny Lam, head of the Tobacco and Alcohol Control Office, said nearly 30 countries and regions have already adopted plain packaging. "There are lots of overseas experience and studies showing that after introducing these new measures, the smoking prevalence, the overall attractiveness [of] smoking products and also the youth initiation [into] smoking demonstrated a significant decrease," he said. "We believe that after introducing these measures in Hong Kong, we will also benefit from these measures and have a similar effect." Lam is also confident that the new look would not give rise to trade in illicit cigarettes as their buyers would stand out due to the stark difference in packaging. The transition period offers sufficient time for the industry to adapt to the requirement ahead of its full implementation in December next year, he stressed. Henry Tong, chairman of the Hong Kong Council on Smoking and Health, said the statutory body fully supports the government's implementation of uniform packaging as soon as possible to prevent children and teenagers from smoking. "Parents or school principals [have told] us that when the young people see the colourful display of the cigarette packs and also some kind of promotional wording... they were attracted [in learning about] smoking cigarettes, which is very dangerous." The legislation governing cigarette packaging will be gazetted on Friday. Edited by Tony Sabine
body.zh: 政府周四宣布，作为九个月过渡期的一部分，香港的传统吸烟产品必须从三月份开始采用统一的包装方法。随着转换，烟草制品的物理特征、颜色和品牌标志面临限制，以确保包装没有品牌元素和设计来增强其吸引力。此外，自2018年起使用的12条图文形式的健康警语也将得到更新，以保持对吸烟导致失明等残疾或癌症等慢性疾病的威慑作用。制造商显示焦油和尼古丁含量的现有要求也将被取消，以避免造成两种成分含量低的产品危害较小的错误印象。印花税制度也将同时实施，这意味着所有已征税的产品都必须带有实体和数字防伪印章。违反统一包装要求者，最高可被罚款港币 50,000 元。国家控烟酒办公室主任林文斌表示，已有近30个国家和地区采用平装。他说：“大量海外经验和研究表明，实施这些新措施后，吸烟率、吸烟产品的整体吸引力以及青少年开始吸烟的情况都显着下降。” “我们相信，香港推出这些措施后，我们也会从这些措施中受益，并产生类似的效果。”林还相信，新外观不会引起非法卷烟贸易，因为包装上的明显差异会让买家脱颖而出。他强调，过渡期为行业在明年12月全面实施之前提供了足够的时间来适应该要求。香港吸烟与健康委员会主席唐英年表示，法定机构全力支持政府尽快实施统一包装，以防止儿童和青少年吸烟。 “家长或学校校长告诉我们，当年轻人看到烟盒上色彩缤纷的展示以及某种促销措辞时……他们被吸引去学习吸烟，这是非常危险的。”管理卷烟包装的立法将于周五在宪报刊登。托尼·萨宾编辑

reflection.en: Hong Kong's move towards plain cigarette packaging is a significant public health intervention. By removing brand appeal and emphasizing stark health warnings, the government seeks to protect citizens from the devastating consequences of smoking. This effort to shield people from harm and promote well-being echoes the biblical call to defend the vulnerable...
reflection.zh: 香港推行香烟统一包装是公共卫生领域的一项重要举措。通过去除品牌吸引力并强调严峻的健康警示，政府旨在保护市民免受吸烟带来的毁灭性后果。这种保护人们免受伤害、促进福祉的努力，呼应了圣经中为弱者辩护、倡导公义的呼召，确保公共政策将人类的福祉置于商业利益之上。

verse.textEn: Learn to do right; seek justice. Defend the oppressed. Take up the cause of the fatherless; plead the case of the widow.
verse.textZh: 学习行善，寻求公平，解救受欺压的；给孤儿伸冤，为寡妇辨屈。

title.en: Australia jails marketing executive who compiled reports for China
title.zh: 澳大利亚判处为中国编译报告的营销主管入狱

summary.en: An Australian marketing executive, Alexander Csergo, has been sentenced to over three years in prison in Sydney for reckless foreign interference. He was convicted of accepting money from Chinese intelligence agents to produce reports on sensitive topics, including Australia's AUKUS submarine partnership and critical...
summary.zh: 澳大利亚一名营销主管亚历山大·切尔戈因鲁莽进行外国干涉，在悉尼被判处三年多监禁。他被判接受中国情报人员的钱财，撰写关于澳大利亚AUKUS核潜艇伙伴关系和关键矿产等敏感话题的报告，并于2023年被捕。

body.en: An Australian man convicted of reckless foreign interference for compiling reports for Chinese intelligence was sentenced to more than three years in jail by a Sydney court on Thursday. Downing Centre, a seat of the District Court in Sydney. Photo: Wikicommons. Marketing executive Alexander Csergo, 58, was arrested in Sydney by Australian police in 2023, shortly after he returned from living in Shanghai. He was accused of accepting cash from Chinese intelligence agents to write reports on topics including Australia’s AUKUS nuclear submarine partnership with the United States and Britain, and critical minerals. Sydney’s district court on Thursday sentenced Csergo to three years and six months in jail, eligible for parole from next month, a court official said. “Foreign interference is an assault on Australian sovereignty,” Australia’s spy chief Mike Burgess said, responding to the sentencing. “In this case, the spies wanted the Australian to target individuals in Australia’s intelligence community, Prime Minister’s Office, defence sector, judiciary and think tanks,” he added. Then-US President Joe Biden delivers remarks on the Australia-United Kingdom-United States (AUKUS) security partnership with then-UK Prime Minister Rishi Sunak and Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese March 13, 2023 at Sierra Pier at Point Loma Naval Base in San Diego, California. Photo: Hannah Foslien/White House Photo. Csergo is only the second person convicted under foreign interference laws introduced in 2018 to criminalise activity that helps a foreign power interfere with Australia’s sovereignty or national interest. He is the first person sentenced for reckless foreign interference. LinkedIn connection The court heard that Csergo had met two suspected Chinese agents, known to him as Ken and Evelyn, in Shanghai after they made contact on professional networking platform LinkedIn. He met the pair in empty cafes in Shanghai, where he suspected the venues had been cleared for their meetings. He returned to Australia in 2023 with a “shopping list” of topics Ken wanted information collected on. The police discovered the list three weeks after Csergo arrived in Australia to live with his family at Bondi Beach. LinkedIn app. Photo: Zulfugar Karimov, via Pexels. The court heard that Csergo exchanged thousands of WeChat messages with the pair between 2021 and 2023, and accepted cash in envelopes. Csergo, found guilty by the court in March, had argued that much of the information in the reports was publicly available. The Australian Federal Police assistant commissioner for cyber and special investigations, Sandra Booth, said the best defence against foreign interference was community awareness....
body.zh: 一名澳大利亚男子因为中国情报机构编写报告而被判鲁莽外国干涉罪，周四被悉尼一家法院判处三年以上监禁。唐宁中心，悉尼地方法院所在地。照片：维基共享资源。 58 岁的营销主管 Alexander Csergo 于 2023 年从上海返回后不久在悉尼被澳大利亚警方逮捕。他被指控接受中国情报人员的现金，以撰写有关澳大利亚与美国和英国的 AUKUS 核潜艇合作伙伴关系以及关键矿产等主题的报告。一名法庭官员称，悉尼地方法院周四判处切尔戈三年零六个月监禁，从下个月起可假释。 “外国干涉是对澳大利亚主权的侵犯，”澳大利亚间谍负责人迈克·伯吉斯在回应判决时表示。他补充说：“在这起案件中，间谍希望澳大利亚人将目标锁定在澳大利亚情报部门、总理办公室、国防部门、司法部门和智库中的个人。” 2023 年 3 月 13 日，时任美国总统乔·拜登在加利福尼亚州圣地亚哥洛马角海军基地塞拉码头与时任英国首相里希·苏纳克和澳大利亚总理安东尼·阿尔巴内斯就澳大利亚-英国-美国 (AUKUS) 安全伙伴关系发表讲话。照片：Hannah Foslien/白宫照片。 Csergo 是根据 2018 年出台的《外国干涉法》被定罪的第二人，该法将帮助外国势力干涉澳大利亚主权或国家利益的活动定为刑事犯罪。他是第一个因鲁莽的外国干涉而被判刑的人。 LinkedIn 连接 法院获悉，Csergo 在专业社交平台 LinkedIn 上联系后，在上海结识了两名涉嫌中国特工的人，他们分别是 Ken 和 Evelyn。他在上海空荡荡的咖啡馆里见到了两人，他怀疑那里的场地已经被清理干净，可以进行会面了。他于 2023 年返回澳大利亚，并带着 Ken 希望收集的主题信息的“购物清单”。切尔戈抵达澳大利亚与家人住在邦迪海滩三周后，警方发现了这份名单。领英应用程序。照片：Zulfugar Karimov，来自 Pexels。法院获悉，Csergo 在 2021 年至 2023 年间与两人交换了数千条微信消息，并接受了信封中的现金。 Csergo 三月份被法院判有罪，他辩称报告中的大部分信息都是公开的。澳大利亚联邦警察局负责网络和特别调查的助理局长桑德拉·布斯 (Sandra Booth) 表示，抵御外国干涉的最佳防御措施是社区意识……

reflection.en: The conviction of Alexander Csergo underscores the serious consequences when individuals engage in activities that compromise national security and ethical standards. This case serves as a stark reminder of the biblical call to 'act justly and to love mercy,' urging us to consider the integrity and impact of our actions in a globalized world.
reflection.zh: 亚历山大·切尔戈的定罪，凸显了个人从事损害国家安全和道德标准的活动所带来的严重后果。此案严厉提醒我们，圣经呼吁要“秉公行义，喜爱怜悯”，敦促我们在全球化的世界中，审慎考虑我们行为的正直性和影响。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: China says US accusations of AI theft are ‘groundless’
title.zh: 中国称美国对人工智能盗窃的指控“毫无根据”

summary.en: China has dismissed US accusations that its AI labs are stealing capabilities from American models as 'groundless,' amidst a fierce technological race between the two nations. The US cyber defense agency issued an advisory Tuesday alleging that top Chinese AI labs, including DeepSeek and Moonshot AI, systematically...
summary.zh: 在中国与美国争夺技术霸权的背景下，中国周三表示，美国指控中国人工智能实验室窃取美国模型能力的说法“毫无根据”。美国网络防御机构周二发布的一份公告指控包括 DeepSeek 和 MoonShot AI...

body.en: China said on Wednesday that US accusations of Chinese labs stealing the capabilities of American models were “groundless”, as the two countries race for tech supremacy. Ministry of Commerce of China. Photo: Wikicommons via CC2.0. The US cyber defense agency released an advisory on Tuesday accusing top Chinese AI labs including DeepSeek and Moonshot AI of systematically stealing the capabilities “through industrial-scale knowledge distillation campaigns”. It came ahead of an expected meeting this month between President Donald Trump and his Chinese counterpart Xi Jinping at the White House, where AI could be an important discussion topic. China hit back on Wednesday, calling the accusations “groundless”. “The US approach is a typical case of using the crackdown on distillation as a pretext to achieve industrial monopoly,” the Ministry of Commerce said in a statement. The US accusations are a “case of double standards”, it added. Distillation is where an AI model is trained to mimic the output of a larger, more capable one. Chinese startup DeepSeek’s AI assistant. File photo: Kelly Ho/HKFP. The method is widely used across the industry, but Washington says Chinese firms have deployed it at scale to illicitly copy American systems. The US advisory also detailed how DeepSeek, Moonshot AI, Alibaba, MiniMax, StepFun and Z.AI allegedly used millions of exchanges and requests to steal the capabilities of US models from the likes of OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and xAI. Chinese companies that adopt this strategy “see significantly shorter AI development timelines and reduced financial expenditures in training a frontier model”, the advisory said. These actions, taken “likely with Chinese government awareness”, have occurred since at least late 2024, it said. AFP contacted the Chinese companies apart from StepFun, which was not immediately reachable. Moonshot AI declined to comment. Trump is under pressure to respond to the increasing success of Chinese AI models that many companies prefer to the more powerful, but pricier, US versions from Anthropic or OpenAI. US President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping pose for a photo at Zhongnanhai in Beijing on May 15, 2026. Photo: The White House, via Flickr. In July, dozens of startups wrote a letter to the Trump administration urging it to think twice against any outright ban or strict curbs on foreign-made AI models, saying this should only be considered for government use of the technology. That month, Beijing also turned the tables by accusing US AI of using Chinese examples to train their models. Asked about the accusations at a regular briefing on Wednesday, Chinese foreign ministry spokeswoman Mao Ning said the...
body.zh: 中国周三表示，在两国争夺技术霸主地位之际，美国对中国实验室窃取美国模型能力的指控“毫无根据”。中国商务部。照片：维基共享资源，来自 CC2.0。美国网络防御机构周二发布了一份咨询报告，指责 DeepSeek 和 Moonshot AI 等中国顶级人工智能实验室“通过工业规模的知识蒸馏活动”系统性地窃取能力。唐纳德·特朗普总统和中国国家主席习近平预计将于本月在白宫举行会议，人工智能可能成为重要的讨论话题。中国周三予以回击，称这些指控“毫无根据”。商务部在一份声明中表示：“美国的做法是以打击蒸馏为借口，实现行业垄断的典型案例。”声明补充说，美国的指控是“双重标准”。蒸馏是训练人工智能模型来模仿更大、能力更强的模型的输出。中国初创公司 DeepSeek 的人工智能助手。资料照片：Kelly Ho/HKFP。该方法在整个行业广泛使用，但华盛顿表示，中国公司已大规模部署该方法来非法复制美国系统。美国的通报还详细介绍了 DeepSeek、Moonshot AI、阿里巴巴、MiniMax、StepFun 和 Z.AI 据称如何利用数百万次交换和请求从 OpenAI、Anthropic、谷歌和 xAI 等公司窃取美国模型的功能。该咨询称，采用这一策略的中国公司“发现人工智能开发时间明显缩短，培训前沿模型的财务支出也减少了”。报告称，这些行动“可能是在中国政府意识到的情况下”采取的，至少自 2024 年底以来就已发生。法新社联系了除StepFun之外的其他中国公司，但未能立即联系上。 Moonshot AI 拒绝置评。特朗普面临着应对中国人工智能模型日益成功的压力，许多公司更喜欢中国人工智能模型，而不是 Anthropic 或 OpenAI 的更强大但价格更高的美国版本。 2026 年 5 月 15 日，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普和中国国家主席习近平在北京中南海合影。照片：白宫，来自 Flickr。今年 7 月，数十家初创公司写信给特朗普政府，敦促其三思而后行，反对对外国制造的人工智能模型的任何彻底禁令或严格限制，并表示只有政府使用该技术才应考虑这样做。当月，北京还指责美国人工智能使用中国的例子来训练他们的模型，从而扭转了局势。中国外交部发言人毛宁在周三的例行吹风会上被问及这些指控时表示...

reflection.en: The rapid advancement and competition in artificial intelligence, as seen in the US-China tech race, can mirror the ambition described in the Tower of Babel story. Humanity's drive to reach new heights, whether through technology or construction, can become a source of division if not tempered by humility and a recognition of limits.
reflection.zh: 人工智能的快速发展和竞争，正如美中科技竞赛中所见，可能与《圣经》中巴别塔故事所描述的野心相呼应。人类追求更高成就的动力，无论是通过技术还是建筑，如果缺乏谦卑和对自身局限的认识，都可能成为分裂的根源。

verse.textEn: Yahweh said, 'If as one people speaking the same language they have begun to do this, then nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.'
verse.textZh: 雅伟说：「看哪，他们成为一样的人民，都是一样的言语，如今既做起这事来，以后他们所要做的事就没有不成就的了。」

title.en: Man, 61, dies in hospital after collapsing on board Hong Kong train
title.zh: 男子在香港火车上晕倒后不治身亡

summary.en: A 61-year-old man passed away in the hospital on Thursday after collapsing on a Hong Kong train earlier that morning. Passengers reported finding him collapsed on a Central-bound train upon its arrival at Cheung Sha Wan station, leading to temporary disruptions on the MTR's Tsuen Wan line.
summary.zh: 一名61岁男子周四在香港一列火车上晕倒后送医不治身亡。乘客于早上7时39分报警，称在列车抵达长沙湾站时发现该男子晕倒，事件一度扰乱了荃湾线的港铁服务。

body.en: A 61-year-old man died in hospital on Thursday after collapsing on board a Hong Kong train earlier in the morning. Police said they received a report at 7.39am from passengers who found the man collapsed on a Central-bound train as it arrived at Cheung Sha Wan station. The incident temporarily disrupted MTR services along the Tsuen Wan line. The force added that firefighters and paramedics had arrived and found the man unconscious. He was rushed to Caritas Medical Centre in Sham Shui Po and...
body.zh: 周四早上，一名 61 岁男子在香港火车上晕倒，在医院死亡。警方表示，早上7时39分接到乘客报案，发现该男子在一辆开往中环的列车抵达长沙湾站时倒地。该事件暂时扰乱了荃湾线沿线的港铁服务。警方补充说，消防队员和护理人员已经赶到，发现该男子昏迷不醒。他被紧急送往深水埗明爱医疗中心...

reflection.en: The sudden death of a 61-year-old man on a train is a stark reminder of our shared human mortality. Hebrews 9:27 speaks to this reality, stating that death is appointed for all. In moments like these, we are called to reflect on the brevity of life and the importance of cherishing each day.
reflection.zh: 一名61岁男子在火车上突然离世，是人类共同命运的严峻提醒。希伯来书9章27节谈到这一现实，指出人人都有一死。在这样的时刻，我们被呼召反思生命的短暂，以及珍惜每一天的重要性。

verse.textEn: Just as people are destined to die once, and after that to face judgment.
verse.textZh: 按着定命，人人都有一死，死后且有审判。

title.en: Wall Street Journal publisher convicted in Hong Kong of deterring reporter from union role
title.zh: 《华尔街日报》出版商在香港被判犯有阻止记者担任工会职务的罪名

summary.en: Dow Jones, the publisher of The Wall Street Journal, has been convicted in a Hong Kong court of one count of deterring reporter Selina Cheng from taking up a role at the Hong Kong Journalist Association. The case raised concerns about press freedom in the city, as Cheng was dismissed weeks after her appointment as...
summary.zh: 《华尔街日报》的出版商道琼斯公司在香港一家法院被判犯有一项阻止记者郑丽莎担任香港记者协会职务的罪名。此案引发了对该市新闻自由的担忧，郑女士在2024年被任命为香港记协主席数周后被公司以重组为由解雇。

body.en: Dow Jones convicted of one count of deterring Selina Cheng from role at Hong Kong Journalist Association but cleared of second charge A Hong Kong court has convicted the publisher of the Wall Street Journal of deterring a reporter from taking up a trade union role, in a case that raised concerns about press freedom in the city. The newspaper dismissed Selina Cheng just weeks after she was appointed chair of the Hong Kong Journalist Association (HKJA) in 2024. She was told at the time her termination was officially due to restructuring. Continue reading...
body.zh: 道琼斯因一项阻止郑秀玲在香港记者协会任职的罪名被定罪，但第二项指控被洗清。香港一家法院判定《华尔街日报》出版商阻止一名记者担任工会职务的罪名成立，此案引起了人们对香港新闻自由的担忧。该报在 2024 年被任命为香港记者协会 (HKJA) 主席几周后解雇了郑嘉颖。当时她被告知，她的解雇正式是由于重组。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The conviction of Dow Jones in Hong Kong for deterring a reporter from union activity underscores a troubling trend where corporate actions can stifle worker advocacy. The prophet Micah reminds us that true righteousness involves acting justly and loving mercy, even in the face of corporate restructuring or perceived inconvenience. May we pray for leaders...
reflection.zh: 道琼斯公司在香港被判阻止记者参与工会活动，这凸显了一个令人担忧的趋势：企业行为可能扼杀工人维权。先知弥迦提醒我们，真正的公义在于秉行公义，喜爱怜悯，即使面对企业重组或所谓的“不便”。愿我们为媒体和商业界的领导者祈祷，愿他们坚守这些原则，确保追求利润不会掩盖员工的基本权利和尊严。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: 2 men with autism jailed for 3 years over joining a Taiwan group that advocated independence for Hong Kong
title.zh: 两名患有自闭症的男子因加入倡导香港独立的台湾团体而被判入狱三年

summary.en: Two young men, Chan Tai-sum (27) and Ng Chi-tung (25), both diagnosed with autism, have been sentenced to 36 and 38 months in prison respectively for their participation in a Taiwan-based group that advocated for Hong Kong independence and US sanctions. They pleaded guilty to conspiracy to commit secession.
summary.zh: 两名年轻男子陈泰森（27岁）和吴志东（25岁），均被诊断患有自闭症，因参与一个倡导香港独立和美国制裁的台湾团体而被分别判处36个月和38个月监禁。他们对共谋分裂国家罪表示认罪。

body.en: Two young men have been jailed for 36 months and 38 months over their participation in a Taiwan-based group which called for Hong Kong independence and US sanctions . Wan Chai Law Courts Building. Photo: Candice Chau/HKFP. Chan Tai-sum, 27, and Ng Chi-tung, 25, received their sentences at the District Court on Thursday morning. Chan was jailed for 38 months while Ng was sentenced to 36 months’ imprisonment, local media reported . The pair pleaded guilty in early July to conspiracy to commit secession. According to a mitigation statement submitted by the defence, both Chan and Ng suffer from autism: Chan had been seeking treatment since the age of 12, while Ng was diagnosed when he was in primary school. Chan and Ng admitted to being “active members” of the Hong Kong Democratic Independence Union between November 2024 and July 2025. The Taiwan-based group was founded by a self-exiled Hongkonger and advocates for Hong Kong’s independence from China. In December last year, Hong Kong authorities announced that the operations of the organisation in Hong Kong would be banned, along with the Hong Kong Parliament group. Judge Ernest Lin said on Thursday that Chan claimed to have joined the Taiwan-based group and committed the offence in order to seek foreign political asylum. This meant he tried to attract foreign forces to act at the expense of the country and Hong Kong, in a ploy that amounted to “selling out one’s country for personal glory.” The judge added that their actions had a negative impact on Hong Kong’s stability and the national administration. A screenshot of the Facebook page of Taiwan-based group Hong Kong Democratic Independence Union on July 10, 2025. Photo: Screenshot, via Facebook. He also noted that Chan had previously been imprisoned for sedition and was a repeat offender. Chan was sentenced to 12 months’ imprisonment in 2022 over inciting people to gather in Causeway Bay and Yau Tsim Mong on Christmas Eve in 2021. Under the Beijing-imposed national security law, the maximum penalty for secession is life behind bars. Arrests last July Chan and Ng have been detained since their arrests in July last year over the Taiwan-based organisation. The court heard in early July that Chan had told police after his arrest how he had joined the group in order to obtain political asylum in Canada, while Ng said he joined out of “curiosity.” Police found chat logs on the pair’s phones showing they had communicated with other group members via the messaging app Line, and that Chan had contributed to the group’s logo design and the drafting of an organisational charter. Police found a draft logo for the Hong Kong Democratic Independence Union and draft letters on Chan’s Google Drive urging the US government to...
body.zh: 两名年轻人因参与一个呼吁香港独立和美国制裁的台湾组织而被分别判入狱 36 个月和 38 个月。湾仔法院大楼。照片：Candice Chau/HKFP。 27岁的陈大心和25岁的吴志栋于周四上午在区域法院接受判刑。据当地媒体报道，陈被判入狱 38 个月，吴被判入狱 36 个月。两人于七月初承认密谋分裂国家罪。根据辩方提交的一份缓解声明，陈和吴均患有自闭症：陈从12岁起就开始寻求治疗，而吴则在上小学时被诊断出患有自闭症。陈和吴承认在2024年11月至2025年7月期间是香港民主独立联盟的“活跃成员”。这个总部位于台湾的组织由一名自我流亡的香港人创立，主张香港从中国独立。去年12月，香港当局宣布禁止该组织以及香港议会小组在香港的活动。法官欧内斯特·林(Ernest Lin)周四表示，陈声称自己加入了这个台湾组织并犯罪，以寻求外国政治庇护。这意味着他试图吸引外国势力以牺牲国家和香港为代价来行动，其策略无异于“为了个人荣耀而出卖国家”。法官补充说，他们的行为对香港的稳定和国家行政造成了负面影响。 2025 年 7 月 10 日台湾团体香港民主独立联盟 Facebook 页面的屏幕截图。照片：屏幕截图，来自 Facebook。他还指出，陈曾因煽动叛乱入狱，并且是屡犯。陈先生因在2021年圣诞节前夕煽动人们在铜锣湾和油尖旺聚集而于2022年被判处12个月监禁。根据北京实施的国家安全法，分裂国家的最高刑罚是终身监禁。去年七月被捕 陈和吴自去年七月因台湾组织被捕以来一直被拘留。 7月初，法庭获悉，陈在被捕后告诉警方，他是如何加入该组织以获得加拿大政治庇护的，而吴则表示，他加入该组织是出于“好奇心”。警方在两人手机上的聊天记录显示，他们通过消息应用程序 Line 与其他团体成员进行了交流，并且陈参与了该团体的标志设计和组织章程的起草。警方在陈的 Google Drive 上发现了香港民主独立联盟的徽标草稿和敦促美国政府......

reflection.en: The imprisonment of Chan Tai-sum and Ng Chi-tung, both young men with autism, for their involvement with a pro-independence group raises concerns about their vulnerability and capacity to understand the full implications of their actions. This situation calls to mind the importance of advocating for those who may struggle to speak for themselves, ensuring...
reflection.zh: 陈泰森和吴志东两名患有自闭症的年轻男子，因参与一个支持香港独立的团体而被判入狱，这引发了人们对他们脆弱性以及理解其行为全部后果能力的担忧。这一情况提醒我们，为那些可能难以替自己发声的人进行倡导，确保他们的声音被听到并保护他们的权利至关重要。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Wall St Journal publisher guilty of preventing ex-reporter Selina Cheng from running for press union chair
title.zh: 《华尔街日报》出版商被判妨碍前记者竞选新闻工会主席罪名成立

summary.en: A Hong Kong court has convicted the Wall Street Journal's publisher of attempting to prevent a former reporter, Selina Cheng, from taking up leadership of an embattled press union, though it cleared the publisher of unlawfully firing her. Cheng, the chairperson of the Hong Kong Journalists Association, had initiated a...
summary.zh: 香港法院裁定《华尔街日报》出版商阻止前记者程尚仁（Selina Cheng）担任备受打压的新闻工会主席的企图罪名成立，但驳回了非法解雇她的指控。香港记者协会主席程尚仁曾就此对道琼斯出版公司提起私人检控。

body.en: A Hong Kong court has convicted the Wall Street Journal’s publisher of attempting to prevent a former reporter from taking up leadership of an embattled press union, but cleared it of unlawfully firing her. Selina Cheng, the chairperson of the Hong Kong Journalists Association, arrives at the Eastern Magistrates’ Courts on September 10, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Principal Magistrate David Cheung delivered his ruling to Selina Cheng, a former reporter for the WSJ and chair of the Hong Kong Journalists Association (HKJA), at the Eastern Magistrates’ Courts on Thursday. Cheng initiated the private prosecution against Dow Jones Publishing, the parent company of her former employer, alleging that she had been unlawfully dismissed in July 2024 , after she was elected chair of the press union. Representing Cheng, Senior Counsel Nigel Kat said in his closing statements in July that an employee enjoys “far-reaching protection” under the city’s Employment Ordinance , which prohibits employers from preventing, deterring, or firing a worker over union participation. The HKJA has seen increasing pressure from authorities in recent years, facing tax audits alongside several local independent media outlets and their employees, and being discredited in comments by the city’s security chief. Wall Street Journal Corporate Headquarters in New York. File photo: John Wisniewski, via Flickr CC2.0. In a July 2024 press conference held the day she was fired, Cheng said the paper had told her that WSJ employees should not be seen as advocating press freedom “in a place like Hong Kong.” ‘Directing mind and will’ In their closing submissions, lawyers for the two parties also argued over whether Cheng’s then-supervisor and a human resources director represented the company when they cited her leadership bid in conversations about her dismissal. Senior Counsel Benson Tsoi, representing Dow Jones, argued that the prosecution had not proven that the two individuals were indeed instructed by the “directing mind and will” of the company in their communications with Cheng. Before Cheng’s firing, Deborah Ball, the journal’s Asia editor and Cheng’s supervisor at the time, told Cheng that her intention to stand for office at the HKJA was “not compatible” with her employment, the court heard. Ex-Wall Street Journal reporter Selina Cheng speaking with journalists outside Eastern Magistrates’ Courts after receiving her verdict on September 10, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Kerene Ko, a human resources director at Dow Jones at the time, later informed Cheng by email that she “did not seek, and will not receive the company’s approval” to pursue the role of HKJA chairperson. Reading his ruling aloud on Thursday, Magistrate Cheung said that the “only possible inference” that...
body.zh: 香港一家法院判定《华尔街日报》出版商试图阻止一名前记者担任陷入困境的新闻工会的领导职务，但澄清了该报非法解雇她的罪名。香港记者协会主席郑Selina于2026年9月10日抵达东区裁判法院。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。周四，首席裁判官张大卫在东区裁判法院向《华尔街日报》前记者、香港记者协会主席郑秀玲作出裁决。程女士对前雇主的母公司道琼斯出版公司提起自诉，指控她在2024年7月当选新闻工会主席后被非法解雇。郑先生的代表，高级律师奈杰尔·凯特 (Nigel Kat) 在 7 月份的结案陈词中表示，根据该市的《雇佣条例》，雇员享有“深远的保护”，该条例禁止雇主阻止、阻止或解雇因工人参加工会而被解雇的工人。近年来，记协面临的来自当局的压力越来越大，与当地多家独立媒体及其员工一起面临税务审计，并因市安全局长的言论而名誉扫地。华尔街日报公司总部位于纽约。资料照片：John Wisniewski，来自 Flickr CC2.0。在 2024 年 7 月被解雇当天举行的新闻发布会上，郑表示，该报告诉她，《华尔街日报》的员工不应被视为“在香港这样的地方”倡导新闻自由。 “引导思想和意志” 在结案陈词中，双方律师还争论了程时任主管和人力资源总监在谈论她被解雇的谈话中提到她的领导力竞标时是否代表公司。道琼斯的代表高级律师Benson Tsoi辩称，检方未能证明这两个人在与郑的沟通中确实受到了该公司“指导思想和意志”的指示。法庭获悉，在郑被解雇之前，该杂志的亚洲编辑、郑当时的主管黛博拉·鲍尔(Deborah Ball)告诉郑，她在记协任职的意图与她的工作“不相容”。 2026 年 9 月 10 日，前《华尔街日报》记者 Selina Cheng 在收到判决后在东区裁判法院外与记者交谈。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。时任道琼斯人力资源总监的凯琳·柯(Kerene Ko)后来通过电子邮件告知郑女士，她“没有寻求也不会得到公司的批准”来担任记协主席一职。周四，张法官宣读了他的裁决，他说“唯一可能的推论”是……

reflection.en: The court's decision in Hong Kong brings a measure of accountability to the situation involving the Wall Street Journal's publisher and former reporter Selina Cheng. It underscores the ongoing struggle for fairness and integrity in professional organizations, reminding us of the importance of upholding justice even in complex situations.
reflection.zh: 香港法院就《华尔街日报》出版商与前记者程尚仁一案的裁决，为该事件带来了一定程度的问责。这凸显了在专业组织中争取公正和诚信的持续斗争，提醒我们即使在复杂的情况下，坚持正义也至关重要。

verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: IOMed marks first year with 47 signatories
title.zh: 国际调解组织（IOMed）迎来成立一周年，签署方增至47个

summary.en: The International Organisation for Mediation (IOMed), the first treaty-based intergovernmental body for mediation, headquartered in Wan Chai, has expanded its signatory states to 47 from 37 in its first year. Its Secretary-General noted that 16 contracting states are participants in the Belt and Road Initiative, with...
summary.zh: 总部设在湾仔、首个专门处理调解事务的条约型政府间国际组织——国际调解组织（IOMed）在成立一年内，签署国数量已从37个增至47个。其秘书长指出，有16个缔约国是“一带一路”倡议的参与者，并且在近期的一次峰会上有多国领导人出席。

body.en: Membership in the International Organisation for Mediation (IOMed), the first treaty-based intergovernmental body dedicated exclusively to mediation that is headquartered in Wan Chai, has grown to 47 signatory states from 37 since its inauguration in October, its secretary-general said on Thursday. Speaking at the Belt and Road Summit, IOMed chief Teresa Cheng said the organisation now has 16 contracting states, all of which are participants in the Belt and Road Initiative. Senior leaders from Uzbekistan, Laos, Kazakhstan, Timor-Leste and founding IOMed member Pakistan, she noted, were among those present at the summit. Cheng said the organisation administers mediation for three types of disputes: state to state, international commercial and those between investors and states. She cited a successfully resolved maritime dispute involving a Chinese party and a Singaporean party as an early case handled through IOMed-administered mediation. The organisation's work contributes to all five areas of Belt and Road connectivity – policy, infrastructure, trade, finance and people-to-people exchanges, Cheng said. She described mediation as a tool to prevent escalation, preserve long-term relationships and replace zero-sum thinking with a win-win approach. "IOMed can be a lubricant for Belt and Road cooperation so that disputes become bumps in the road rather than roadblocks," Cheng said. The organisation plans to host dialogue series and capacity-building activities for member states and is exploring specialised panels for disputes in sectors such as commodities, aviation, and shipping. Edited by Tony Sabine
body.zh: 国际调解组织 (IOMed) 秘书长周四表示，自 10 月成立以来，总部位于湾仔的第一个专门致力于调解的基于条约的政府间机构，其成员已从 37 个增加到 47 个。 IOMed 主席 Teresa Cheng 在“一带一路”峰会上发表讲话时表示，该组织目前有 16 个缔约国，都是“一带一路”倡议的参与者。她指出，来自乌兹别克斯坦、老挝、哈萨克斯坦、东帝汶和创始成员国巴基斯坦的高级领导人出席了峰会。程说，该组织负责三类纠纷的调解：国家间纠纷、国际商业纠纷以及投资者与国家之间的纠纷。她列举了一起成功解决的涉及中国一方和新加坡一方的海事纠纷，作为通过 IOMed 调解处理的早期案件。程说，该组织的工作为“一带一路”互联互通的所有五个领域——政策、基础设施、贸易、金融和人文交流做出了贡献。她将调解描述为防止事态升级、维护长期关系以及以双赢方式取代零和思维的工具。程说：“IOMed可以成为‘一带一路’合作的润滑剂，让争端成为路上的坎坷而不是障碍。”该组织计划为成员国举办系列对话和能力建设活动，并正在探讨针对大宗商品、航空和航运等领域的争端设立专门小组。托尼·萨宾编辑

reflection.en: The establishment and growth of the International Organisation for Mediation (IOMed) offer a hopeful sign in a world often marked by conflict. By dedicating itself to mediation, IOMed embodies the beatitude, 'Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God.' This organization's first year shows a growing commitment to resolving disputes...
reflection.zh: 国际调解组织（IOMed）的成立及其发展，在充满冲突的世界中带来了希望的迹象。《马太福音》中说：“使人和睦的人有福了，因为他们必得称为神的儿子。”该组织的成立第一年，显示出日益增长的决心，即通过对话而非对抗来解决争端。

verse.textEn: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God.
verse.textZh: 使人和睦的人有福了，因为他们必称为神的儿子。

title.zh: 巴基斯坦在香港峰会上承诺深化“一带一路”合作

summary.en: Pakistan's Federal Minister for Commerce Jam Kamal Khan reaffirmed Islamabad's commitment to the Belt and Road Initiative on Thursday, stating that the China-Pakistan Economic Corridor has transformed the country into a key regional hub connecting landlocked Central Asia and western China to warm-water ports. Speaking...
summary.zh: 巴基斯坦联邦商务部长贾姆·卡马尔·汗周四重申了伊斯兰堡对“一带一路”倡议的承诺，并表示中巴经济走廊已将该国转变为连接内陆中亚和中国西部与温水港口的主要区域枢纽。在香港举行的“一带一路”峰会上，汗表示，在作为“一带一路”倡议旗舰项目的经济走廊内，能源、基础设施和工业化方面的深化合作正在重塑巴基斯坦的经济格局，并促进一个具...

body.en: Pakistan's Federal Minister for Commerce Jam Kamal Khan reaffirmed Islamabad's commitment to the Belt and Road Initiative on Thursday, saying the China-Pakistan Economic Corridor had turned his country into a major regional connectivity hub linking landlocked Central Asia and western China to warm-water ports. Speaking at the Belt and Road Summit in Hong Kong, Khan said deeper collaboration in energy, infrastructure and industrialisation in the corridor, a flagship project of the Belt and Road Initiative (BRI), was reshaping Pakistan's economic landscape. He described the initiative as a transformative vision of a global community with a shared future. "The Belt and Road Initiative represents a transformative vision of a global community with a shared future and over the past decade has inspired nations to accelerate development, unlock economic opportunity and deepen cultural ties," Khan said during a special address at the summit. He said regional cooperation was evolving from transport routes towards integrated value chains and that Pakistan was positioning itself as a link between west, central and east Asia. He cited the Trans-Afghan Railway Initiative and expanded rail and road linkages with China as steps towards making the country the shortest viable route for trade with Central Asia while also opening up markets among the 1.5 billion people in African states. Khan said Pakistan's economic strategy rested on export-led growth, industrial modernisation and deeper integration into global supply chains. He noted the country's vast agricultural potential, mineral wealth – from copper to gold and critical minerals – and a young, growing population as key areas for Belt and Road Initiative partnership. Khan also extended an invitation to Chief Executive John Lee to visit Pakistan, praising his leadership and Hong Kong's initiative in offering around 150 scholarships to students from Belt and Road partner countries. "Building on BRI's green agenda, we seek deeper cooperation with partners like Hong Kong on climate adaptation and sustainable growth. Our shared future also rests on people-to-people ties," he said. Edited by Tony Sabine
body.zh: 巴基斯坦联邦商务部长贾姆·卡迈勒·汗周四重申伊斯兰堡对“一带一路”倡议的承诺，称中巴经济走廊已将巴基斯坦转变为连接中亚内陆和中国西部与温水港口的主要区域互联互通枢纽。汗在香港举行的“一带一路”峰会上发表讲话时表示，走廊作为“一带一路”倡议的旗舰项目，在能源、基础设施和工业化方面深化合作正在重塑巴基斯坦的经济格局。他将这一倡议描述为全球命运共同体的变革愿景。汗在峰会上发表特别讲话时表示：“‘一带一路’倡议代表了全球命运共同体的变革愿景，在过去十年中激励各国加速发展、释放经济机遇、深化文化联系。”他表示，区域合作正在从运输路线向一体化价值链发展，巴基斯坦将自己定位为西亚、中亚和东亚之间的纽带。他引用了横贯阿富汗铁路计划以及扩大与中国的铁路和公路联系作为使该国成为与中亚进行贸易的最短可行路线的步骤，同时也为非洲国家的15亿人口开放了市场。汗表示，巴基斯坦的经济战略依赖于出口导向型增长、工业现代化和更深层次地融入全球供应链。他指出，中国巨大的农业潜力、矿产财富（从铜到黄金和关键矿产）以及不断增长的年轻人口是“一带一路”倡议伙伴关系的关键领域。汗还邀请行政长官李约翰访问巴基斯坦，赞扬他的领导能力和香港为“一带一路”伙伴国家学生提供约150个奖学金的举措。他表示：“在‘一带一路’的绿色议程的基础上，我们寻求与香港等伙伴在气候适应和可持续增长方面进行更深入的合作。我们的共同未来也取决于人民之间的联系。”托尼·萨宾编辑

reflection.en: In Hong Kong, Pakistan's commerce minister spoke of deepening ties through the Belt and Road Initiative, seeing it as a force reshaping their nation's economy. This echoes the wisdom of committing one's plans and endeavors to Yahweh, trusting that He will establish them. May leaders and nations seek divine guidance in their ambitious projects, ensuring they...
reflection.zh: 在香港，巴基斯坦商务部长谈到通过“一带一路”倡议深化合作，并将其视为重塑国家经济的力量。这呼应了将人的计划和工作交托给雅伟，并相信他会成就的智慧。愿领导者和国家在他们宏伟的计划中寻求神的指引，确保它们不仅服务于经济增长，也服务于人类的繁荣与和平。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Unidentified Murder review – playful sendup of alien abduction and true crime influencers in Hong Kong
title.zh: 《不明谋杀》评论——香港外星人绑架和真实犯罪网红的戏谑模仿

summary.en: Childhood friends claim to have witnessed the disappearance of a schoolkid in this low-budget comedy caper that pushes limits of storytelling. Modestly scaled and intricately structured, Kwok Ka-Hei and Jack Lee Chun-Kit’s comedy is a capriciously playful send-up of true crime aficionados and wannabe influencers, done...
summary.zh: 在这部突破叙事界限的低成本喜剧冒险片中，儿时好友声称目睹了一名学童的失踪。由郭嘉曦和李振杰执导的这部规模不大、结构精巧的喜剧，以一种随心所欲的戏谑方式模仿了真实犯罪爱好者和伪网红，但其出发点是喜爱而非恶意。影片围绕一个（虚构的）25年前的案件展开，该案件吸引了整个香港的关注。

body.en: Childhood friends claim to have witnessed the disappearance of a schoolkid in this low-budget comedy caper that pushes limits of storytelling Modestly scaled and intricately structured, Kwok Ka-Hei and Jack Lee Chun-Kit’s comedy is a capriciously playful send-up of true crime aficionados and wannabe influencers, done with affection rather than malice. It revolves around a (fictional) 25-year-old case that captivates the whole of Hong Kong. Back when they were seven, childhood friends Mark (Ling Man-lung) and Kit (Ronald Lam Tsz-kit) claimed to have witnessed the abduction by aliens of their classmate Ho in the woods of Tung Tau Hill. On the 25th anniversary of this supposed incident, the pair re-enter the internet’s consciousness after an interview on an online chatshow about unsolved mysteries. Cashing in on their viral fame, Mark’s girlfriend Man (Renci Yeung) hires actor Kim (Peter Chan Charm-man) to pretend to be Ho, all in the hope of racking up views on her social channels. Just when the cameras are all set up, Man watches in horror as the staged reunion leads to a real murder … or does it? The film unfolds in a series of increasingly tricksy complications and reversals. All of a sudden, apparent victims are revealed to be scheming masterminds, and vice versa. As most of the actions take place in the forest where the abduction supposedly occurred, the plot derives comic relief from the increasingly blurred line between truth and playacting. Largely shot with handheld cameras, it has a visual style that lends authenticity to representations of online media, though occasionally this distracts from the physical comedy performed by the cast. The constant twists also turn into bit of a competitive sport, meaning the film becomes more of a writing exercise than anything else. Continue reading...
body.zh: 儿时的朋友声称在这部低成本喜剧中目睹了一名小学生的失踪，这部喜剧突破了讲故事的极限。郭家熙和李俊杰的这部喜剧规模适中，结构复杂，是对真正的犯罪爱好者和想要成为影响者的反复无常的讽刺，是出于感情而不是恶意。它围绕着一个（虚构的）25 年前震惊整个香港的案件展开。七岁时，青梅竹马的Mark（凌文龙饰）和Kit（林中基饰）声称在东头山的树林里亲眼目睹了同学何氏被外星人绑架。在这起所谓的事件发生 25 周年之际，两人在一次关于未解之谜的在线访谈节目中接受采访后，重新进入了互联网的视野。马克的女友曼（杨仁慈饰）利用他们的病毒名气，聘请演员金（陈可辛饰）假扮何浩，希望能在她的社交频道上获得更多的关注。就在摄像机全部架好时，曼惊恐地看着这场上演的重聚导致了一场真正的谋杀……是吗？影片在一系列日益棘手的复杂情况和逆转中展开。突然之间，表面上的受害者被揭露为诡计多端的策划者，反之亦然。由于大部分情节都发生在据称发生绑架的森林中，因此事实与表演之间的界限越来越模糊，情节因此而变得喜剧化。它主要是用手持摄像机拍摄的，其视觉风格为在线媒体的表现提供了真实性，尽管有时这会分散演员们表演的肢体喜剧的注意力。不断的曲折也变成了一场竞技运动，这意味着这部电影更像是一场写作练习。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This film playfully satirizes our fascination with true crime and the influencers who amplify these stories. In a world saturated with sensational narratives, Philippians 4:8 reminds us to focus our minds on what is true, honorable, and excellent, rather than getting lost in speculation or manufactured drama. May we cultivate discernment in what we consume...
reflection.zh: 这部电影以一种戏谑的方式讽刺了我们对真实犯罪故事和放大这些故事的网红们的迷恋。在一个充斥着耸人听闻叙事的世界里，《腓立比书》4:8 提醒我们要将心思意念专注于真实、可敬、公义、清洁、可爱、有美名的事，而不是沉溺于猜测或人为制造的戏剧。愿我们培养辨别力，选择所消费和分享的内容，寻求真理与良善。

verse.textEn: Whatever is true, whatever is noble, whatever is right, whatever is pure, whatever is lovely, whatever is admirable — think about such things.
verse.textZh: 凡是真实的、可敬的、公义的、清洁的、可爱的、有美名的，这些事你们都要思念。

title.en: Hong Kong pro-democracy activist Joshua Wong pleads guilty in second national security case
title.zh: 香港民主派活动人士黄之锋承认在第二起国安案中认罪

summary.en: Joshua Wong, a prominent pro-democracy activist in Hong Kong, pleaded guilty on Wednesday to charges under the national security law, specifically conspiring to seek foreign sanctions against China. The charge carries a maximum penalty of life imprisonment.
summary.zh: 香港一位著名的民主派活动人士黄之锋周三承认触犯国安法，罪名是共谋寻求外国制裁中国，该罪名最高可判处无期徒刑。

body.en: Wong, 29, is accused of urging foreign powers to impose sanctions, blockades and other hostile measures against China Joshua Wong , one of Hong Kong’s most prominent pro-democracy activists, pleaded guilty on Wednesday to conspiring to seek foreign sanctions against Hong Kong and China, a national security charge that carries a maximum life sentence. Prosecutors have accused Wong, 29, of working with the exiled Hong Kong activist Nathan Law to urge foreign powers to impose sanctions, blockades or other hostile measures against China. Continue reading...
body.zh: 29 岁的黄之锋被指控敦促外国势力对中国实施制裁、封锁和其他敌对措施。香港最著名的民主活动人士之一黄之锋周三承认密谋寻求外国对香港和中国实施制裁，这一国家安全指控最高可判处无期徒刑。检察官指控 29 岁的黄与流亡香港活动人士罗冠聪合作，敦促外国势力对中国实施制裁、封锁或其他敌对措施。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Joshua Wong, a young activist known for his role in Hong Kong's democracy movement, has pleaded guilty to charges under the national security law. This situation brings to the fore the difficult tension between civic obedience and deeply held convictions. The apostles' unwavering stance, 'We must obey God rather than human beings,' offers a timeless...
reflection.zh: 香港一位以其在民主运动中角色而闻名的年轻活动人士黄之锋，已承认触犯国安法。这一局面凸显了公民服从与内心深处信念之间的艰难张力。使徒们坚定的立场——“顺从神，过于顺从人”——为这种良心冲突提供了永恒的视角。

verse.textEn: We must obey God rather than human beings!
verse.textZh: 顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。

title.en: Shein shares slide on fast-fashion retailer’s stock market debut
title.zh: Shein股价在快时尚零售商上市首日下跌

The company, founded in China and now headquartered in Singapore, was valued at just over $26bn, a significant drop from its previous valuation of nearly $100bn. The listing followed unsuccessful attempts to go...
summary.zh: 快时尚品牌Shein在香港股市上市首日股价下跌高达10%。这家中国创立、现总部设在新加坡的公司，上市估值略高于260亿美元，远低于其此前近1000亿美元的估值。此次上市此前曾尝试在美国和英国进行但未果。

body.en: Hong Kong flotation at $26bn by firm once valued at $100bn follows failure to list in US and UK Shares in the fast-fashion brand Shein slumped by as much as 10% as the China-founded company made its long-anticipated trading debut on the Hong Kong stock exchange. The Singapore-headquartered company, once valued at almost $100bn (£74bn), went public on Tuesday pricing shares at HK$48.56, valuing the business at just over $26bn. Continue reading...
body.zh: 曾估值 1000 亿美元的公司在香港上市 260 亿美元，此前快时尚品牌 Shein 在美国和英国上市失败，这家中国成立的公司在香港证券交易所首次上市，股价下跌 10%。这家总部位于新加坡的公司一度估值近 1000 亿美元（740 亿英镑），周二上市，股价为 48.56 港元，业务估值略高于 260 亿美元。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The dramatic fall in Shein's stock value on its Hong Kong debut, from a peak of nearly $100 billion to just over $26 billion, underscores the volatile nature of the business world. Proverbs 16:3 reminds us to commit our endeavors to Yahweh, trusting that He will establish our plans, even when market forces lead to unexpected outcomes.
reflection.zh: Shein公司在香港上市首日股价大幅下跌，从近1000亿美元的峰值跌至260亿美元以上，凸显了商业世界的波动性。箴言16:3提醒我们，要将所做的事交托给雅伟，相信祂会成就我们的计划，即使市场力量带来意想不到的结果。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Online and undercover: Saving trafficked wildlife in Thailand
title.zh: 线上和秘密行动：泰国拯救被贩运的野生动物

summary.en: Nawee Changpirom has dedicated years to rescuing trafficked wildlife in Thailand, encountering creatures like leopards, hornbills, and anteaters. He leads a raid unit that combats the illegal trade of various wildlife products, from elephant ivory to animals sought for labs or as pets, which is a significant global...
summary.zh: Nawee Changpirom 投入多年时间拯救泰国被贩运的野生动物，他曾救助过豹子、犀鸟和食蚁兽等生物。他领导着一个国家公园、野生动物和植物保护部（DNP）的突袭小组，打击从非洲象牙到被用作宠物或实验室测试的猴子等各种野生动物制品的非法交易。这项非法野生动物贸易与武器、毒品和人口贩运一样，是全球主要的犯罪活动之一。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Nawee Changpirom has spent years working to rescue trafficked wildlife in Thailand, but even he can sometimes hardly believe the creatures he has found: leopards, hornbills and, once, an anteater.

Nawee heads a raid unit in the Department of National Parks, Wildlife and Plant Conservation (DNP) that tries to stop the sale of everything from African elephant ivory to monkeys wanted as pets or for laboratory testing.

Alongside weapons, drugs and human trafficking, the illegal wildlife trade is among the most widespread and profitable forms of organized crime globally, run by cross-border cartels.

Thailand occupies a rare position because of its abundant local wildlife, the availability of rare species in nearby countries, and its accessibility by sea, air and land.

The DNP set up a dedicated Wildlife Crime Intelligence Unit (WCU) in 2023 with three permanent staff charged with tracking and intercepting illegal purchases.

They spend much of their time trawling social media , which is now "the key channel" for buying and selling illegal animals, said WCU director Polawee Buchakiet.

Wildlife traders often describe animals as needing to be "rehomed," rather than explicitly offering them for sale, and post tightly cropped images of their wares to avoid revealing their locations.

One undercover officer known by the pseudonym "Tee" has shinnied up electricity poles disguised as a repairman to peer into courtyards and take photos, and posed as a land surveyor to look into windows on neighboring plots.

The WCU needs such evidence to obtain court warrants to go in and seize the animals.

He is still haunted by cases where sellers could not be located, or the team arrived too late, finding the creatures either dead or so sickly they died soon after rescue.

Trafficked animals are often weakened by the process of smuggling, stressed by the loss of their habitat and family group, and vulnerable to unfamiliar diseases.

"I wonder to myself if we could have done something to get there sooner," Tee, 43, told AFP.

At just 6 months old, the leaf monkey curled up inside DNP vet Thanawadee Phaichana's rubber-gloved hand is very small indeed.

He was intercepted in luggage at Bangkok's Suvarnabhumi Airport, bound for India, where demand for exotic animals as pets has been growing.

"Most of these smuggled animals will be in a weak condition ... some are given sedatives or even mild anesthetic to keep them from moving or making noise," Thanawadee said.

Animals rescued in and around Bangkok often come to the DNP's small facility for initial treatment before being transferred to a...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 纳威·昌皮隆 (Nawee Changpirom) 多年来一直致力于拯救泰国被贩运的野生动物，但即使是他有时也很难相信自己发现的生物：豹子、犀鸟，还有曾经的食蚁兽。 纳维领导着国家公园、野生动物和植物保护部 (DNP) 的一个突袭小组，该小组试图阻止从非洲象牙到想要作为宠物或实验室测试的猴子等各种物品的销售。 除了武器、毒品和人口贩运之外，非法野生动物贸易是全球范围内最广泛、最有利可图的有组织犯罪形式之一，由跨境卡特尔进行。 泰国因其丰富的当地野生动物、邻近国家的稀有物种以及海、空、陆交通便利而占据着罕见的地位。 DNP 于 2023 年成立了专门的野生动物犯罪情报部门 (WCU)，配备三名常驻工作人员，负责跟踪和拦截非法购买行为。 WCU 主任 Polawee Buchakiet 表示，他们花费大量时间在社交媒体上进行搜索，而社交媒体现在已成为买卖非法动物的“关键渠道”。 野生动物贸易商经常将动物描述为需要“重新安置”，而不是明确地出售它们，并发布经过严格裁剪的商品图片以避免暴露它们的位置。 一名化名“Tee”的卧底警官伪装成修理工，把电线杆打亮，往庭院里窥视并拍照，并冒充土地测量员查看邻近地块的窗户。 WCU 需要此类证据才能获得法庭搜查令，以进入并扣押动物。 他仍然对无法找到卖家的情况感到困扰，或者团队到达得太晚，发现这些生物要么已经死亡，要么病得很重，在获救后很快就死了。 被贩运的动物往往因走私过程而变得虚弱，因栖息地和家庭群体的丧失而承受压力，并且容易感染不熟悉的疾病。 43 岁的蒂告诉法新社：“我心里想，我们是否可以采取一些措施来更快地实现这一目标。” 这只叶猴只有 6 个月大，蜷缩在 DNP 兽医 Thanawadee Phichana 戴着橡胶手套的手中，确实很小。 他在曼谷素万那普机场的行李中被拦截，该机场正飞往印度，印度对珍奇动物作为宠物的需求一直在增长。 塔纳瓦迪说：“大多数走私动物都处于虚弱状态……有些动物会被注射镇静剂，甚至轻度麻醉剂，以防止它们移动或发出噪音。” 在曼谷及其周边地区获救的动物通常会来到 DNP 的小型设施进行初步治疗，然后被转移到...

reflection.en: In Thailand, Nawee Changpirom bravely works to protect trafficked wildlife, giving a voice to creatures who cannot speak for themselves. His efforts to rescue leopards, hornbills, and anteaters from illegal trade echo the biblical call to advocate for those who are exploited and silenced. This dedication reminds us of our responsibility to stand up for the...
reflection.zh: 在泰国，Nawee Changpirom 勇敢地致力于保护被贩运的野生动物，为那些无法为自己发声的生灵代言。他努力从非法贸易中拯救豹子、犀鸟和食蚁兽，这呼应了圣经中为受剥削和沉默者辩护的呼召。这种奉献精神提醒我们，在这个充满残忍的世界里，我们有责任为弱者——无论是人类还是动物——挺身而出。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Coyote density is 9 times higher in Seattle than in Washington's wildlands
title.zh: 西雅图郊狼密度是华盛顿州野外的9倍

summary.en: Coyotes are increasingly adapting to urban environments, with research indicating significantly higher densities in cities like Seattle compared to wildlands. This adaptation is driven by abundant food sources and a lack of natural predators in urban settings, allowing them to thrive despite human presence.
summary.zh: 郊狼越来越多地适应城市环境，研究表明西雅图等城市的郊狼密度远高于野外。这种适应是由城市环境中丰富的食物来源和缺乏天敌所驱动的，使它们能够在人类存在的情况下茁壮成长。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Once coyotes get a taste for city living, the call of the wild fades to a whisper. Food is abundant and predators are few. Research indicates that coyotes enjoy the benefits of urban areas enough to put up with all the people, and Seattle is no exception.

Over the past century, coyotes have colonized every major metropolitan area in North America. Chicago is home to an estimated 4,000 coyotes , and in Los Angeles, urban coyote density is at least seven times higher than in wild areas. Coyotes are often spotted in parks and neighborhoods throughout Seattle, but the lack of formal data makes it difficult for researchers to track trends.

"We observed a ninefold increase in coyote density in Seattle compared to more natural areas of the state," said lead author Laura Prugh, a UW professor of environmental and forest sciences. "That might surprise people who think of coyotes as afraid of humans, but I think it just shows how ideal the urban setting is for coyotes."

In the study, researchers analyzed coyote scats collected throughout Seattle and from wild study areas near Winthrop in north-central Washington and Chewelah in the northeastern part of the state. They calculated density based on how often they picked up a scat from the same animal, identifying 213 coyotes from 842 scats.

Researchers were also curious about what factors influence density within the city, such as the luxury effect—where wealthier neighborhoods have more plant and animal diversity. Researchers compared the coyote density maps with maps showing pollution levels, tree cover, buildings and roads, human population density and income level. Of those factors, only human density seemed to influence the coyotes.

"In Seattle, human population density had a negative effect on coyote density. But when you compare coyote abundance in Seattle to areas with far fewer people, the coyote population was much higher in the city," Prugh said.

Although coyotes are wary of people, the conditions that dense human populations create favor their survival. Urban coyotes are less likely to be killed or go hungry than their wild counterparts.

Research shows that fear of mortality may play a role in determining where coyotes live. In the wild, larger carnivores such as wolves and mountain lions hunt coyotes, but in cities, they get to masquerade as apex predators. Farmers and landowners are also more likely to kill coyotes to protect their livestock in rural settings.

Cities also offer a wider variety of food options for coyotes. Scat analyses showed that urban coyotes' diets were more than twice as diverse as those of...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 一旦郊狼尝到了城市生活的滋味，野性的呼唤就会消失得无影无踪。食物丰富，掠食者很少。研究表明，土狼享受城市地区的好处足以忍受所有人，西雅图也不例外。 在过去的一个世纪里，土狼已经占领了北美每个主要大都市区。芝加哥估计有 4,000 只郊狼，而在洛杉矶，城市郊狼密度至少是野生地区的七倍。土狼经常出现在西雅图的公园和社区中，但由于缺乏正式数据，研究人员很难追踪趋势。 “我们观察到，与该州更自然的地区相比，西雅图的郊狼密度增加了九倍，”该研究的主要作者、威斯康星大学环境与森林科学教授劳拉·普鲁格 (Laura Prugh) 说。 “这可能会让那些认为土狼害怕人类的人感到惊讶，但我认为这只是表明城市环境对土狼来说是多么理想。” 在这项研究中，研究人员分析了在西雅图各地以及华盛顿中北部温思罗普和该州东北部切韦拉附近野生研究区收集的土狼粪便。他们根据从同一动物身上采集粪便的频率来计算密度，从 842 个粪便中识别出 213 只土狼。 研究人员还很好奇哪些因素会影响城市内的密度，例如奢华效应——较富裕的社区拥有更多的植物和动物多样性。研究人员将土狼密度图与显示污染水平、树木覆盖、建筑物和道路、人口密度和收入水平的地图进行了比较。在这些因素中，似乎只有人类密度会影响土狼。 “在西雅图，人口密度对土狼密度产生了负面影响。但是当你将西雅图的土狼数量与人口少得多的地区进行比较时，你会发现该市的土狼数量要高得多，”普鲁说。 尽管郊狼对人类很警惕，但密集的人口创造的条件有利于它们的生存。与野生土狼相比，城市土狼被杀死或挨饿的可能性较小。 研究表明，对死亡的恐惧可能在决定郊狼的居住地点方面发挥着重要作用。在野外，狼和美洲狮等大型食肉动物会猎杀郊狼，但在城市中，它们会伪装成顶级掠食者。农民和土地所有者也更有可能杀死土狼以保护农村地区的牲畜。 城市还为土狼提供了更广泛的食物选择。粪便分析表明，城市郊狼的饮食多样性是郊狼的两倍多……

reflection.en: The adaptability of coyotes in Seattle, thriving amidst human activity, offers a curious parallel to the spiritual principle of overcoming adversity. Even in challenging or unexpected environments, life finds a way to persist and even flourish, a testament to resilience. This reminds us that even when circumstances seem overwhelming, there is a way to...
reflection.zh: 西雅图郊狼在人类活动中茁壮成长的适应能力，为克服逆境的属灵原则提供了一个有趣的借鉴。即使在充满挑战或意想不到的环境中，生命也能找到生存甚至繁荣的方式，这是韧性的证明。这提醒我们，即使在看似压倒性的环境下，也有办法去应对和寻找生计，不是屈服于环境，而是通过适应和坚持。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: Global heat stuck on high. Scientists say August was Earth's hottest month they've measured.
title.zh: 全球高温持续。科学家称八月为有记录以来最热的月份。

summary.en: Earth experienced its hottest recorded month in August, exceeding a significant climate threshold. This was attributed to the combined effects of human-caused climate change and a strong El Niño, according to the European climate service Copernicus.
summary.zh: 根据欧洲气候服务机构哥白尼的数据，地球在八月份经历了有记录以来最热的月份，远超了一个重要的气候阈值。这归因于人为引起的气候变化和强烈的厄尔尼诺现象的双重影响。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Earth cooked to its hottest month on record in August, blowing far past a key climate threshold, due to the dangerous double whammy of human-caused climate change and a supersized El Niño, according to the European climate service Copernicus .

August's sizzle also helped push the globe and the United States to swelter through the hottest Northern Hemisphere summer scientists have measured.

Last month the world averaged 62.53 degrees Fahrenheit (16.96 degrees Celsius), which technically was one-hundredth of a degree Celsius more than the all-time global mark set in July 2023, but because that's also the uncertainty level, it's considered a tie, said Samantha Burgess, strategic climate lead for Copernicus.

"It is now time to stop acting surprised that our warming planet keeps getting warmer. This is occurring exactly as forecast by scientists literally decades ago," Texas A&M University climate scientist Andrew Dessler said in an email. "The interesting question is not whether we will keep breaking heat records (we will), but whether we're going to do anything about it or just stand there while the climate train runs us over."

Globally, August was 1.65 degrees Celsius (nearly 3 degrees Fahrenheit) above pre-industrial levels, far exceeding the longer term 1.5 degrees Celsius (2.7 degrees Fahrenheit) threshold set by the 2015 Paris climate agreement . The eight hottest months on record have all been from July 2023 on, according to Copernicus data.

"Our climate system is really operating well outside the range we would have expected just a decade ago," Burgess said Wednesday from a United Kingdom that has been beset with heat waves. "We've transitioned from climate being very abstract and perhaps impacting the global South or far away places to climate impacting and disrupting our daily lives with schools closing, hospitals being overwhelmed, roads melting, train lines buckling. And the reality is we will get more of these conditions that we've seen this summer."

Global monthly ocean temperatures in August tied a March 2024 all-time record for warmest month recorded, while Aug. 22 set a record for hottest day recorded in the world's seas, according to Copernicus.

"This summer has really been exceptional. We've seen records that existed for close to 100 years be broken, in the U.S. in particular," Burgess said.

The U.S. National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration on Wednesday announced that for the first time, summer in the Lower 48 states was hotter than during the peak of the devastating Dust Bowl in 1936. June through August of 2026 in the contiguous United...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 据欧洲气候服务机构哥白尼称，由于人为气候变化和特大厄尔尼诺现象的双重打击，地球在八月份达到了有记录以来最热的月份，远远超过了关键的气候阈值。 八月的炎热天气还推动全球和美国度过了科学家测量到的北半球最热的夏季。 哥白尼战略气候主管萨曼莎·伯吉斯 (Samantha Burgess) 表示，上个月全球平均气温为 62.53 华氏度（16.96 摄氏度），从技术上讲，比 2023 年 7 月设定的历史全球气温高百分之一摄氏度，但由于这也是不确定性水平，因此被认为是平局。 德克萨斯农工大学气候科学家安德鲁·德斯勒在一封电子邮件中说：“现在是时候停止对我们正在变暖的地球持续变暖感到惊讶了。这种情况的发生与科学家几十年前的预测完全一致。” “有趣的问题不是我们是否会继续打破高温记录（我们会的），而是我们是否会采取任何措施，或者只是站在那儿，让气候列车碾过我们。” 从全球范围来看，8 月份的气温比工业化前水平高出 1.65 摄氏度（近 3 华氏度），远远超过 2015 年巴黎气候协议规定的 1.5 摄氏度（2.7 华氏度）的长期阈值。根据哥白尼的数据，有记录以来最热的八个月都发生在 2023 年 7 月之后。 伯吉斯周三在饱受热浪困扰的英国表示：“我们的气候系统运行情况确实远远超出了我们十年前的预期。” “我们已经从非常抽象的、可能影响南半球或遥远地方的气候转变为气候影响和扰乱我们的日常生活，学校关闭、医院不堪重负、道路融化、火车线路弯曲。现实是，今年夏天我们将遇到更多这样的情况。” 根据哥白尼的数据，8 月全球每月海洋温度追平了 2024 年 3 月有记录以来最热月份的历史记录，而 8 月 22 日则创下了世界海洋有记录以来最热一天的记录。 “今年夏天真的很特别。我们看到存在了近 100 年的记录被打破，特别是在美国，”伯吉斯说。 美国国家海洋和大气管理局周三宣布，美国本土 48 个州的夏季首次比 1936 年毁灭性沙尘暴高峰期更热。2026 年 6 月至 8 月，邻近的美国...

reflection.en: The record-breaking heat of August serves as a stark reminder of our planet's fragility. As stewards of this Earth, we are called to care for creation, recognizing that it belongs to Yahweh. May we seek wisdom and act with responsibility to protect the home we have been given.
reflection.zh: 八月创纪录的高温提醒我们地球的脆弱性。作为这片土地的管家，我们被呼召去关爱受造物，并认识到这一切都属于雅伟。愿我们寻求智慧，并负责任地行动，以保护我们被赐予的家园。

verse.textEn: The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
verse.textZh: 地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属雅伟。

title.en: Anthropic researcher resigns with warning about the dangers of AI development
title.zh: Anthropic 研究员辞职并警告人工智能发展的危险

summary.en: A researcher at Anthropic is resigning due to concerns that the artificial intelligence firm, along with its competitors, is not developing AI responsibly. This echoes broader industry and external worries about AI's potential to escape human control.
summary.zh: 一位 Anthropic 的研究员因担心该公司及其竞争对手在人工智能开发方面不够负责而辞职。这呼应了业内和业外对人工智能可能失控的广泛担忧。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

An Anthropic researcher said he is resigning from the company over concerns the artificial intelligence firm and its competitors are not acting responsibly in AI development, echoing concerns raised inside and outside of the industry about the technology's potential to elude human control .

Jacob Coxon, who said he spent three years doing research at both Anthropic and OpenAI, said Tuesday on the social platform X that the two AI companies are more focused on beating each other and global competitors in developing the most advanced model possible than they are on safety.

OpenAI and Anthropic caused a stir this summer when they announced, about a week apart, that their models had broken out of testing environments and obtained unauthorized access to real computer systems. The announcements prompted concerns about models going rogue and carrying out other, more harmful tasks. Both companies said at the time they were pausing some evaluations while they put more monitoring measures and guardrails in place.

The technology's rapid development has led some in the U.S. as well as global leaders to call for a more cautious approach. U.N. human rights chief Volker Türk urged countries this week to put "cast-iron guarantees in place around the safety and security of AI before it is too late."

In his social media posts, Coxon said Anthropic and its chief rival OpenAI "are racing straight to self-improving superintelligence and gambling with our lives." He warned that some working on AI development believe it could threaten human life by the end of the decade.

"Do not underestimate the power of this technology," he continued. "These will soon be superhuman systems that can hack anything, revolutionize any field overnight, and acquire real power and resources. We have all witnessed the progress in each of these domains, and progress is not slowing."

Coxon is not the first AI insider to publicly raise such concerns. Both Anthropic and OpenAI have seen high-profile resignations in recent years that were tied to safety concerns. Two current Anthropic employees also responded to Coxon's post in agreement.

Sen. Bernie Sanders, a Vermont independent who has called for AI safeguards and regulation, agreed with Coxon's concerns and said he would soon introduce legislation to pause AI development and ban superintelligence.

"The very people building this technology admit that it could threaten the future of humanity," Sanders said Wednesday on social media.

AI companies themselves have at times highlighted the technology's threat to humanity, which skeptics have seen as part of a push...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 一位 Anthropic 研究员表示，由于担心这家人工智能公司及其竞争对手在人工智能开发中不负责任，他将从该公司辞职，这呼应了行业内外对该技术有可能逃脱人类控制的担忧。 雅各布·考克森 (Jacob Coxon) 表示，他花了三年时间在 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 进行研究，他周二在社交平台 X 上表示，这两家人工智能公司更专注于在开发最先进模型方面击败彼此和全球竞争对手，而不是安全性。 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 今年夏天引起了轰动，当时他们相隔大约一周宣布他们的模型已经突破了测试环境并获得了对真实计算机系统的未经授权的访问。这些公告引发了人们对模型失控和执行其他更有害任务的担忧。两家公司当时均表示，他们正在暂停一些评估，同时采取更多的监控措施和防护措施。 该技术的快速发展导致美国和全球领导人呼吁采取更加谨慎的态度。联合国人权事务高级专员沃尔克·蒂尔克本周敦促各国“在为时已晚之前，对人工智能的安全和安保做出铁一般的保证”。 考克森在他的社交媒体帖子中表示，Anthropic 及其主要竞争对手 OpenAI“正在与自我完善的超级智能赛跑，并用我们的生命进行赌博。”他警告说，一些从事人工智能开发工作的人认为，到本世纪末，人工智能可能会威胁人类的生命。 “不要低估这项技术的力量，”他继续说道。 “这些很快将成为超人系统，可以破解任何东西，在一夜之间彻底改变任何领域，并获得真正的力量和资源。我们都见证了这些领域的进步，而且进步并没有放缓。” 考克森并不是第一个公开提出此类担忧的人工智能内部人士。近年来，Anthropic 和 OpenAI 都因安全问题而高调辞职。 Anthropic 的两名现任员工也对 Coxon 的帖子表示同意。 佛蒙特州独立参议员伯尼·桑德斯呼吁对人工智能进行保障和监管，他同意考克森的担忧，并表示他将很快出台立法来暂停人工智能开发并禁止超级智能。 桑德斯周三在社交媒体上表示：“开发这项技术的人承认它可能威胁人类的未来。” 人工智能公司本身有时会强调该技术对人类的威胁，怀疑论者认为这是推动......

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of AI, driven by competition, raises profound questions about the character and motivations of its creators. As Proverbs 27:21 suggests, the intense pressure and praise within the AI race can reveal the true nature of those involved, testing their commitment to responsible development over mere progress.
reflection.zh: 人工智能的快速发展，由竞争驱动，引发了对其创造者品格和动机的深刻质疑。正如箴言 27:21 所暗示的，人工智能竞赛中的巨大压力和赞誉可以揭示参与者的真实本性，考验他们是否将负责任的开发置于仅仅追求进步之上。

verse.textEn: The crucible for silver and the furnace for gold, but people are tested by their praise.
verse.textZh: 鼎为炼银，炉为炼金，人的称赞也试炼人。

title.en: A stronger-than-normal El Nino alarms scientists over Galápagos wildlife and forests
title.zh: 异常强厄尔尼诺现象引发科学家对加拉帕戈斯野生动植物的担忧

summary.en: Scientists are alarmed by predictions that this season's El Niño will be stronger than usual, fearing its impact on the unique flora and fauna of the Galápagos Islands, which host a high concentration of endemic species.
summary.zh: 科学家们对本季厄尔尼诺现象将异常强烈的预测感到担忧，担心其对加拉帕戈斯群岛独特的动植物群产生影响，该群岛拥有高度集中的特有物种。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

The prediction that this season's El Niño phenomenon will be stronger than normal has alarmed the Ecuadorian scientific community, which has warned of its impact on the flora and fauna of the Galapagos Islands, home to the highest concentration of species not found elsewhere on Earth.

The archipelago of more than 230 islands—of which only four are inhabited—is located in the middle of the Pacific Ocean, 1,000 kilometers (620 miles) off the coast of Ecuador.

The climatic phenomenon occurs periodically and in the equatorial Pacific is characterized by an increase in sea temperature and intense rainfall. Its strength is determined by measuring the water temperature in that area and comparing it to the normal average. If it is 2 degrees Celsius (3.6 Fahrenheit) above normal, it is considered "very strong."

The sea temperature will be about 2.2 degrees Celsius (4 F) above normal, according to the latest projection from the U.S. National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA), which means that "the impact will be significant," said Franklin Ormaza, a professor and researcher at the Faculty of Maritime Engineering and Marine Sciences of the Higher Polytechnic School of the Coast (ESPOL).

Animals and fish will be at risk because as the water temperature rises, " plankton, algae, and smaller fish species , which are food for larger marine animals, practically disappear," explained Washington Tapia, director of Biodiversa Ecuador, a conservation organization in the archipelago, to the AP.

He specified that the species most at risk are the iconic Galápagos penguins, blue-footed boobies, petrels, flightless cormorants, albatrosses, and even sea lions. Coral colonies could also be seriously affected, as could tuna fishing.

In the absence of food, "animal colonies stop reproducing," disperse in search of food, and die of starvation in the process, explained scientist Gustavo Jiménez, from the Charles Darwin Foundation.

If the phenomenon occurs with the expected magnitude, the archipelago's vertebrate population could decrease by at least 20% this year, Jiménez added.

One of the most closely monitored species in the islands, the Galápagos penguins, serves as a marker of the impact of this climate phenomenon on the archipelago's fauna.

According to data from the Charles Darwin Foundation, after the 1998 El Niño—one of the most powerful and destructive cycles—only 400 of the 1,300 existing Galápagos penguins remained.

If El Niño strikes with the expected force, the last three remaining Scalesia forests could be at risk of disappearing, scientist Heinke Jager of the...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 本季厄尔尼诺现象将比平常更强的预测引起了厄瓜多尔科学界的警惕，他们警告称，该现象对加拉帕戈斯群岛的动植物群产生了影响，该群岛是地球上其他地方没有发现的物种最集中的地方。 这个群岛由 230 多个岛屿组成，其中只有 4 个有人居住，位于太平洋中部，距离厄瓜多尔海岸 1,000 公里（620 英里）。 这种气候现象周期性发生，赤道太平洋的特点是海水温度升高和强降雨。其强度是通过测量该区域的水温并将其与正常平均值进行比较来确定的。如果温度比正常值高 2 摄氏度（3.6 华氏度），则被视为“非常强”。 海岸高等理工学院 (ESPOL) 海事工程和海洋科学学院教授兼研究员富兰克林·奥尔马扎 (Franklin Ormaza) 表示，根据美国国家海洋和大气管理局 (NOAA) 的最新预测，海水温度将比正常水平高出约 2.2 摄氏度 (4 F)，这意味着“影响将是巨大的”。 厄瓜多尔群岛保护组织 Biodiversa Ecuador 主任华盛顿·塔皮亚 (Washington Tapia) 向美联社解释说，动物和鱼类将面临危险，因为随着水温升高，“作为大型海洋动物食物的浮游生物、藻类和小型鱼类几乎消失”。 他指出，面临最大风险的物种是标志性的加拉帕戈斯企鹅、蓝脚鲣鸟、海燕、不会飞的鸬鹚、信天翁，甚至海狮。珊瑚群落和金枪鱼捕捞也可能受到严重影响。 查尔斯·达尔文基金会的科学家古斯塔沃·希门尼斯解释说，在缺乏食物的情况下，“动物群体会停止繁殖”，分散寻找食物，并在此过程中死于饥饿。 Jiménez 补充道，如果这种现象达到预期的程度，今年该群岛的脊椎动物数量可能会减少至少 20%。 加拉帕戈斯企鹅是群岛上受到最密切监测的物种之一，它是这种气候现象对群岛动物群影响的标志。 根据查尔斯·达尔文基金会的数据，1998 年厄尔尼诺现象（最强大、最具破坏性的周期之一）发生后，现有 1,300 只加拉帕戈斯企鹅中只剩下 400 只。 科学家海因克·雅格（Heinke Jager）表示，如果厄尔尼诺现象达到预期的强度，那么仅存的三片斯卡西亚森林可能面临消失的危险。

reflection.en: The Galápagos Islands, a living laboratory of evolution, face a significant threat from an unusually strong El Niño. This phenomenon, a powerful expression of natural forces, reminds us that creation itself speaks of its Maker's wisdom and power. Even as we lament the potential loss of unique species, we can observe the intricate systems of the natural...
reflection.zh: 加拉帕戈斯群岛，作为进化的活生生实验室，正面临异常强烈的厄尔尼诺现象的重大威胁。这种现象是自然力量的有力体现，提醒我们，创造本身就诉说着其创造者的智慧与大能。即使我们哀叹独特物种可能遭受的损失，我们也能观察到自然界错综复杂的系统，并认识到其背后深邃的智慧。

verse.textEn: Since the creation of the world God's invisible qualities — his eternal power and divine nature — have been clearly seen, being understood from what has been made.
verse.textZh: 自从造天地以来，神的永能和神性是明明可知的，虽是眼不能见，但借着所造之物就可以晓得。

title.en: ‘One of the biggest discoveries in science’: have scientists found dark matter? – podcast
title.zh: “科学界最大的发现之一”：科学家们找到了暗物质吗？——播客

summary.en: For decades, physicists have been puzzled by the enigma of dark matter, which is thought to constitute 85% of the universe's matter but remains invisible and undetectable, known primarily through its gravitational influence. Now, scientists believe they may be closer to detecting it, a finding that could revolutionize...
summary.zh: 数十年来，物理学家一直对暗物质的谜团感到困惑。人们认为它构成了宇宙物质的85%，但它既看不见也无法被探测到，我们主要通过它对其他事物产生的引力效应来了解它。现在，科学家们认为他们可能更接近于探测到它了，这一发现可能会彻底改变我们对宇宙的理解。

body.en: For decades physicists have been puzzling over the enigma of dark matter. We think it makes up 85% of the matter in the universe, but the mysterious substance cannot be seen or detected, and we know about it mainly through observations of the gravitational effects it has on other things. But now scientists believe they may be a step closer to detecting it. Science editor Ian Sample explains to Madeleine Finlay why, if confirmed, the finding could completely transform our understanding of the universe. And Dr Samuel Erikson , senior research associate at the University of Bristol, and first author of the research paper, explains how the finding has been received in the physics community Support the Guardian: theguardian.com/sciencepod Continue reading...
body.zh: 几十年来，物理学家一直对暗物质之谜感到困惑。我们认为它构成了宇宙中85%的物质，但这种神秘物质是看不见或探测不到的，我们主要通过观察它对其他事物的引力效应来了解它。但现在科学家相信他们可能离检测到它又近了一步。 《科学》编辑伊恩·桑普勒 (Ian Sample) 向玛德琳·芬利 (Madeleine Finlay) 解释了为什么这一发现如果得到证实，将彻底改变我们对宇宙的理解。布里斯托大学高级研究员、该研究论文的第一作者塞缪尔·埃里克森博士解释了物理学界如何接受这一发现支持卫报：theguardian.com/sciencepod 继续阅读...

reflection.en: The universe holds mysteries that stretch our understanding, like the elusive dark matter that shapes galaxies through unseen forces. Job 12:7-9 reminds us that creation itself is a source of profound wisdom, inviting us to observe and learn from the intricate workings of the cosmos. May this potential discovery inspire awe and humility, reminding us of the...
reflection.zh: 宇宙充满了我们理解力所不及的奥秘，例如通过看不见的力量塑造星系的暗物质。约伯记12:7-9提醒我们，创造本身就是深刻智慧的源泉，邀请我们观察并学习宇宙错综复杂的运作。 愿这一潜在的发现能激发敬畏之心和谦卑感，提醒我们雅伟创造的浩瀚以及其中人类对知识的不懈追求。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Timing 1080 drops to prevent predators bouncing back
title.zh: 调整1080投放时间以防止捕食者反弹

summary.en: While aerial 1080 drops sharply reduce numbers of rats and stoats, the predators—especially ship rats—can rebound to higher numbers within a few years. Studying 24 years of small-mammal tracking records across New Zealand's public conservation land, researchers found that the timing of these rebounds varies between...
summary.zh: 虽然空中投放1080毒饵能急剧减少老鼠和白鼬的数量，但这些捕食者——尤其是船鼠——会在几年内反弹至更高数量。通过研究新西兰公共保护区24年的小型哺乳动物追踪记录，研究人员发现这些反弹的时间因地区而异。他们表示，为了使捕食者控制有效，应根据当地情况和需要保护的动物来安排重复投放1080毒饵的时间。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

While aerial 1080 drops sharply reduce numbers of rats and stoats, the predators—especially ship rats—can rebound to higher numbers within a few years. Studying 24 years of small-mammal tracking records across New Zealand's public conservation land, researchers found that the timing of these rebounds varies between regions.

For predator control to be effective, they say, repeat 1080 drops should be timed according to the local context and based on the animals being protected. In a second paper using the same data, they report that, because of large variations in rat numbers from year to year, it is not yet possible to tell whether rats have expanded their range because of climate change.

This study , published in New Zealand Journal of Ecology , describes the effects of aerial 1080 predator-control operations on the abundance of ship rats, mice and mustelids across New Zealand forests, using more than 591,000 tracking-tunnel records collected from 1998 to 2022 across 13 conservation regions.

The data show that 1080 is highly effective at reducing numbers of ship rats and stoats in the 1–2 years following its use, consistent with studies showing improvements in nest, chick and overall survival of vulnerable species such as whio/blue duck, pīwakawaka/fantail, kiwi and kākā.

Mouse tracking rates recovered early (within 6–12 months) but then decreased again as ship rat populations rebounded to higher levels than in unmanaged areas over the subsequent 2–3 years. The size of rat rebounds varied greatly by region, with much larger rebounds in warmer zones and northern regions with more diverse low-elevation forests than in cooler southern and eastern South Island regions.

The size of rat rebounds probably reflects the food surplus available to individuals that survive control operations. Stoat activity recovered more slowly than rodent tracking rates, with the longest durations of control in cooler and drier South Island regions.

Unless predators can be locally eliminated, the work shows that indigenous species populations are likely to be protected by 1080 only if operations are repeated regularly at frequencies appropriate to protect the target species from its key predators in a particular geographic region. For example, the findings of this study concur with other research showing that kākā populations in South Westland would grow if 1080 operations were undertaken every two or three years to prevent stoat recoveries.

This study , published in New Zealand Journal of Ecology , models long-term patterns in ship rat, mouse and mustelid activity using more than two...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 虽然空中 1080 的降落大幅减少了老鼠和白鼬的数量，但捕食者——尤其是船鼠——可以在几年内反弹到更高的数量。研究人员研究了新西兰公共保护区 24 年来的小型哺乳动物追踪记录，发现这些反弹的时间因地区而异。 他们说，为了有效控制捕食者，应根据当地情况和受保护的动物来确定重复 1080 次滴落的时间。在使用相同数据的第二篇论文中，他们报告说，由于每年老鼠数量变化很大，目前还无法判断老鼠是否因为气候变化而扩大了活动范围。 这项发表在《新西兰生态学杂志》上的研究利用 1998 年至 2022 年在 13 个保护区收集的 591,000 多条跟踪隧道记录，描述了空中 1080 捕食者控制行动对新西兰森林中船鼠、小鼠和鼬科动物数量的影响。 数据显示，1080 在使用后 1-2 年内可非常有效地减少船鼠和白鼬的数量，这与表明巢穴、雏鸟和脆弱物种（如蓝鸭、pīwakawaka/fantail、猕猴桃和卡卡）的巢穴、雏鸟和整体存活率有所改善的研究一致。 小鼠追踪率较早恢复（6-12 个月内），但随后随着船鼠数量在随后 2-3 年内反弹至高于未管理区域的水平而再次下降。老鼠反弹的规模因地区而异，较温暖的地区和低海拔森林多样化的北部地区的反弹幅度比南岛南部和东部较凉爽的地区要大得多。 老鼠反弹的规模可能反映了在控制行动中幸存下来的个体可获得的食物剩余。白鼬活动的恢复速度比啮齿动物追踪速度慢，在凉爽和干燥的南岛地区控制持续时间最长。 第1080章 不服输的人例如，这项研究的结果与其他研究结果一致，表明如果每两到三年进行 1080 次手术以防止白鼬恢复，南韦斯特兰的卡卡种群数量将会增加。 这项研究发表在《新西兰生态学杂志》上，利用两种以上的方法模拟了船鼠、小鼠和鼬科动物活动的长期模式。

reflection.en: The intricate study of animal populations and ecological cycles, as undertaken by researchers in New Zealand, offers a glimpse into the wisdom embedded within creation. By observing the patterns of predator rebounds, scientists gain understanding that can inform conservation efforts. This pursuit of knowledge through careful observation reflects the ancient...
reflection.zh: 新西兰研究人员对动物种群和生态周期的细致研究，让我们得以一窥造物中蕴含的智慧。通过观察捕食者数量的反弹模式，科学家们获得了可以指导保护工作的理解。这种通过仔细观察来追求知识的做法，反映了一个古老的真理：受造界本身就诉说着其创造者的设计与智慧。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: August joint hottest month on record as climate change and El Niño drive heat
title.zh: 八月创纪录高温，欧洲气候机构称与七月并列

summary.en: August tied with July 2023 as the hottest month on record globally, driven by climate change and the El Niño phenomenon, with temperatures exceeding the critical 1.5C threshold above pre-industrial levels.
summary.zh: 根据欧盟气候服务机构的数据，八月与2023年七月并列成为有记录以来最热的月份，这归因于气候变化和厄尔尼诺现象，气温超过了工业化前水平1.5摄氏度的关键阈值。

body.en:
August was the joint-hottest month ever recorded, tying with July 2023, according to the EU's climate service.

The record was driven by a combination of climate change and the rising influence of El Niño, pushing heat into the atmosphere across the Pacific.

Temperatures for the month were 1.65C above pre-industrial levels - surpassing the critical 1.5C threshold agreed by countries to avoid the worst consequences of climate change.

While a single month above 1.5C does not mean it has been permanently crossed, it shows a trend towards breaching that limit.

The month also capped western Europe's warmest summer, with high temperatures pushing the season past the deadly heat of 2003.

Dr Samantha Burgess, strategic lead for climate at Copernicus, described August as "a remarkable month in the global climate record", and its impacts had been "increasingly being felt by communities, economies and ecosystems across the world".

The combination of record air temperatures, record ocean heat and Europe's exceptional summer showed how climate change was now driving extremes across "both the atmosphere and the oceans", she said.

UN climate chief Simon Stiell said the record clearly showed humanity's impact on the climate.

"The evidence is irrefutable: this is the spiralling price of humanity's fossil fuel addiction, and the global climate crisis it is fuelling," he said.

On top of the ongoing impact of the use of fossil fuels, the rise of a powerful El Niño is making matters worse, the researchers have said.

El Niño is a natural climate pattern in which a band of the eastern Pacific turns unusually warm, releasing vast amounts of stored ocean heat into the atmosphere and nudging global temperatures upwards for around a year.

The one currently being experienced is still strengthening and could become one of the most powerful on record, according to the Copernicus team.

The biggest impact of this natural phenomenon on global temperatures is expected to hit over the coming year, meaning the current run of records may have further to go.

That prospect follows a summer that drove western Europe to its warmest on record.

This was echoed in the UK, which had its hottest summer since records began in 1884 - a high mark the Met Office found had been made around 130 times more likely by human-caused climate change.

This figures carried "a very real human cost", said Dr Clair Barnes, an extreme weather researcher at Imperial College London.

The heat across the UK and Europe disrupted schools, strained hospitals, hit food production, fuelled fires and drought, and claiming "tens of thousands of lives", she said.

"Until we stop burning fossil fuels these records will continue to tumble, and the extremes will worsen faster than we are able to adapt. Crucially,...
body.zh: 根据欧盟气候服务机构的数据，8 月是有记录以来最热的月份，与 2023 年 7 月持平。 这一纪录是由气候变化和厄尔尼诺现象的影响不断加大共同推动的，厄尔尼诺现象将热量推入太平洋彼岸的大气中。 本月气温比工业化前水平高出 1.65 摄氏度，超过了各国为避免气候变化造成最严重后果而商定的 1.5 摄氏度临界阈值。 虽然单月气温高于 1.5 摄氏度并不意味着它已被永久突破，但它显示出突破该限制的趋势。 这个月也结束了西欧最温暖的夏季，高温使这个季节超越了 2003 年的酷热天气。 哥白尼气候战略主管萨曼莎·伯吉斯博士将八月描述为“全球气候记录中非凡的一个月”，其影响“越来越多地被世界各地的社区、经济和生态系统所感受到”。 她说，创纪录的气温、创纪录的海洋热量和欧洲异常的夏季结合在一起，表明气候变化正在如何推动“大气和海洋”出现极端现象。 联合国气候变化负责人西蒙·斯蒂尔表示，这一记录清楚地表明了人类对气候的影响。 他说：“证据是无可辩驳的：这就是人类对化石燃料成瘾的螺旋式上升的价格，以及它正在加剧的全球气候危机。” 研究人员表示，除了使用化石燃料造成的持续影响之外，强大的厄尔尼诺现象的兴起也使情况变得更糟。 厄尔尼诺现象是一种自然气候模式，东太平洋的一段区域变得异常温暖，将大量储存的海洋热量释放到大气中，并推动全球气温在一年左右的时间里上升。 据哥白尼团队称，目前正在经历的这一事件仍在加强，并可能成为有记录以来最强大的之一。 这种自然现象对全球气温的最大影响预计将在明年出现，这意味着目前的记录可能还会进一步延续。 这一前景是在西欧经历了有记录以来最温暖的夏季之后发生的。 英国也出现了这种情况，该国正经历自 1884 年有记录以来最热的夏季——英国气象局发现，人为气候变化的可能性增加了约 130 倍。 伦敦帝国理工学院极端天气研究员克莱尔·巴恩斯博士说，这个数字带来了“非常真实的人力成本”。 她说，英国和欧洲各地的高温天气扰乱了学校，使医院不堪重负，影响了粮食生产，加剧了火灾和干旱，并夺去了“数万人的生命”。 “在我们停止燃烧化石燃料之前，这些记录将继续下降，极端情况的恶化速度将超过我们能够适应的速度。至关重要的是……

reflection.en: The Earth, with its intricate systems and delicate balance, is a testament to its Creator. As we witness record-breaking heat, it calls us to remember that this planet is not ours to exploit, but a sacred trust to steward with wisdom and care. May we approach our responsibility with humility, recognizing Yahweh's ownership and seeking to live in harmony...
