verse.textEn: Yahweh said, 'If as one people speaking the same language they have begun to do this, then nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.'
verse.textZh: 雅伟说：「看哪，他们成为一样的人民，都是一样的言语，如今既做起这事来，以后他们所要做的事就没有不成就的了。」

title.en: 4 groups caught using the same Chrome and Windows exploit kit
title.zh: 四组织利用相同的 Chrome 和 Windows 漏洞工具

summary.en: At least four hacking groups are actively using a nearly identical exploit kit, named BlueMoon by researchers, which targets critical vulnerabilities in Chromium-based browsers and older Windows versions. This kit chains together three vulnerabilities to install malware, exploiting two in Chromium and one in the...
summary.zh: 至少有四个黑客组织正在积极使用一个几乎相同的漏洞利用工具包，研究人员称之为 BlueMoon，该工具包针对 Chromium 内核浏览器和旧版 Windows 的关键漏洞。该工具包将三个漏洞链接起来，用于安装恶意软件，其中两个利用了 Chromium 的漏洞，一个利用了多个 Windows...

body.en: A nearly identical exploit kit that targets critical vulnerabilities in both Chromium-based browsers and older versions of Windows is being actively used by at least four hacking groups, some of which have ties to the Chinese government. Researchers from security firm Proofpoint said Wednesday that BlueMoon, the name they gave to the kit, chains three vulnerabilities together so the attackers using it can install malware of their choice. BlueMoon exploits two Chromium vulnerabilities and one in the kernel of Windows 10 (Oct 2018 Update), Windows Server 2019, Windows 10 2004, Windows Server 2022, and the initial release of Windows 11. All three vulnerabilities have received patches in the past 24 hours. Deployed rapidly, widely shared The attacks lacked the stealth found in many campaigns. More often, hackers want to exploit newly discovered vulnerabilities sparingly to lengthen their longevity. Proofpoint hypothesized that one reason for the widely used and visible exploit chain was to take advantage of a “patch gap” in the Chromium supply chain, which spans the time a patch is available from developers and the time that patch is incorporated into browsers such as Chrome and Edge. Another likely contributor was the use of AI, which can often spot vulnerabilities faster than discovery performed solely by humans. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 至少四个黑客组织正在积极使用一个几乎相同的漏洞利用工具包，该工具包针对基于 Chromium 的浏览器和旧版本 Windows 中的关键漏洞，其中一些组织与中国政府有联系。安全公司 Proofpoint 的研究人员周三表示，他们给该套件起的名字 BlueMoon 将三个漏洞链接在一起，以便使用它的攻击者可以安装他们选择的恶意软件。 BlueMoon 利用了两个 Chromium 漏洞以及 Windows 10（2018 年 10 月更新）、Windows Server 2019、Windows 10 2004、Windows Server 2022 和 Windows 11 初始版本内核中的一个漏洞。所有这三个漏洞都在过去 24 小时内收到了补丁。部署迅速、广泛共享 这些攻击缺乏许多活动中的隐蔽性。更常见的是，黑客希望谨慎地利用新发现的漏洞来延长其寿命。 Proofpoint 假设，广泛使用且可见的漏洞利用链的一个原因是利用 Chromium 供应链中的“补丁间隙”，该间隙跨越了开发人员提供补丁的时间以及补丁被合并到 Chrome 和 Edge 等浏览器中的时间。另一个可能的贡献者是人工智能的使用，它通常可以比仅由人类执行的发现更快地发现漏洞。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of technology, particularly in areas like AI-driven vulnerability discovery, presents a double-edged sword. While it can lead to innovation, it also accelerates the potential for misuse, as seen with the BlueMoon exploit kit. This mirrors the ancient observation that 'knowledge increases' in the latter days, urging us to seek wisdom...
reflection.zh: 技术的飞速发展，尤其是在人工智能驱动的漏洞发现等领域，是一把双刃剑。它既能带来创新，也加速了滥用的可能性，正如 BlueMoon 漏洞利用工具包所见。这与古老的观察相呼应，即末日“知识必增长”，这促使我们在技术进步的同时，寻求智慧和道德指引。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Europe may finally have found a space entrepreneur who is meeting the moment
title.zh: 欧洲可能终于找到了一个能抓住机遇的太空企业家

summary.en: French entrepreneur Hèlene Huby, CEO of The Exploration Company, has secured $450 million in Series C funding, marking the largest such round for a European space company. She is also serving as an envoy at a high-profile International Space Summit.
summary.zh: 法国企业家 Hèlene Huby，作为欧洲探索公司（The Exploration Company）的首席执行官，已成功获得 4.5 亿美元的 C 轮融资，创下了欧洲太空公司此类融资的最高纪录。她还担任法国总统马克龙召集的高级别国际空间峰会的一名特使。

body.en: All of a sudden, French entrepreneur Hèlene Huby is seemingly everywhere. This week she is serving as one of two envoys, alongside astronaut Thomas Pesquet, at a high-profile International Space Summit convened by French President Emmanuel Macron. The government's website for the event describes her as chief executive of "the fastest-growing space company in Europe." Also this week, that firm, The Exploration Company, announced a significant capital raise of $450 million in Series C funding. Although not spectacular by the standards of some US space businesses, this is the largest-ever Series C funding round by a Europe-based space company, and likely the largest funding round ever raised by a female-led company in Europe. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 突然间，法国企业家 Hèlene Huby 似乎无处不在。本周，她将作为两名特使之一，与宇航员托马斯·佩斯奎特一起，出席法国总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙召集的备受瞩目的国际太空峰会。该活动的政府网站将她描述为“欧洲发展最快的航天公司”的首席执行官。同样在本周，The Exploration Company 宣布在 C 轮融资中筹集 4.5 亿美元的资金。尽管按照一些美国航天企业的标准来看，这并不引人注目，但这是欧洲航天公司有史以来规模最大的 C 轮融资，也可能是欧洲女性领导的公司有史以来筹集的最大一轮融资。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: Hèlene Huby's company, The Exploration Company, has achieved a significant milestone with a $450 million funding round. This success in the competitive space industry underscores the importance of diligent planning and execution in entrepreneurial endeavors. As Proverbs 16:3 states, 'Commit your works to Yahweh, and your plans will succeed.' This verse...
reflection.zh: Hèlene Huby 的公司“欧洲探索公司”通过 4.5 亿美元的融资轮达到了一个重要的里程碑。在竞争激烈的航天产业中取得这样的成功，凸显了创业活动中勤奋规划和执行的重要性。《箴言》16:3 说道：“你要将你的事交托雅伟，你所定的计就会成就。”这节经文提醒我们，虽然人的努力至关重要，但最终的成功在于将我们的事业托付给雅伟的指引。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Six Chinese AI firms accused of aggressively copying US frontier models
title.zh: 六家中国人工智能公司被指控积极复制美国前沿模型

summary.en: The US has identified six Chinese AI firms accused of industrial-scale efforts to distill capabilities from US frontier AI models, potentially saving billions in development costs and possibly acting with Chinese government awareness.
summary.zh: 美国已点名六家中国人工智能公司，指控它们大规模窃取美国前沿人工智能模型的性能，可能节省了数十亿美元的研发成本，并且可能是在中国政府知情的情况下进行的。

body.en: The United States has now named six Chinese AI firms accused of waging industrial-scale attacks distilling US frontier AI model capabilities and perhaps sparing billions in Chinese development costs. In a joint release Tuesday, the National Security Agency (NSA), Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA), and Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) alleged that DeepSeek, Moonshot AI, Alibaba, MiniMax, StepFun, and Z.AI have been attacking US models since at least late 2024. The firms “likely” acted with “Chinese government awareness” when extracting capabilities from US models, including variants of Claude, GPT, Gemini, and Grok, agencies said. “China-based AI companies that conduct industrial-scale distillation against US AI models see significantly shorter AI development timelines and reduced financial expenditures in training a frontier model,” agencies said. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 美国现已点名六家中国人工智能公司，这些公司被指控发动工业规模的攻击，提炼出美国前沿人工智能模型的能力，并可能为中国节省数十亿美元的开发成本。在周二的联合发布中，美国国家安全局 (NSA)、网络安全和基础设施安全局 (CISA) 和联邦调查局 (FBI) 声称，DeepSeek、Moonshot AI、阿里巴巴、MiniMax、StepFun 和 Z.AI 至少自 2024 年末以来一直在攻击美国模型。这些公司在从美国模型（包括 Claude、GPT、Gemini 和 Grok 的变体）中提取功能时“可能”表现出了“中国政府的意识”。说。各机构表示：“对美国人工智能模型进行工业规模蒸馏的中国人工智能公司发现，人工智能开发时间明显缩短，训练前沿模型的财务支出也减少了。”阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of AI technology presents humanity with immense power, but also with the temptation of unchecked ambition. The accusations against these six firms echo the ancient story of Babel, where human ingenuity, untethered from ethical grounding and divine wisdom, led to division and confusion. As we push the boundaries of what's possible, we...
reflection.zh: 人工智能技术的飞速发展赋予人类巨大的力量，但也带来了不受约束的野心的诱惑。对这六家公司的指控，让人联想到古代巴别塔的故事，当时人类的智慧若不以道德为根基、不寻求神圣的智慧，就导致了分裂和混乱。当我们不断拓展可能性的边界时，我们必须扪心自问：我们对知识和能力的追求，是出于对真正进步的渴望，还是出于一种可能带来意想不到后果的傲慢？

verse.textEn: Yahweh said, 'If as one people speaking the same language they have begun to do this, then nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.'
verse.textZh: 雅伟说：「看哪，他们成为一样的人民，都是一样的言语，如今既做起这事来，以后他们所要做的事就没有不成就的了。」

title.en: Apple's long-rumored foldable becomes reality with the $2,000 iPhone Duo
title.zh: 苹果传闻已久的折叠屏手机以2000美元的iPhone Duo变为现实

summary.en: Apple's first foldable phone will be available next month, marking a significant entry into the foldable market with its new, expensive device.
summary.zh: 苹果的首款折叠屏手机将于下月上市，这款昂贵的新设备标志着其正式进入折叠屏市场。

body.en: Apple ended today's hardware event with one of its classic "One more thing" reveals. Some smartphone makers have been offering foldable phones for the better part of a decade, but Apple has now joined the fray with the iPhone Duo after years of speculation . This device is undeniably the most capable iPhone ever, as well as the most expensive. It's not as spendy as many expected, though, starting at $1,999. That's in the same range as foldables from Google and Samsung. An iPad in your pocket The iPhone Duo would have looked like a totally fresh take on the foldable design a few months ago, but Samsung has made waves with the Galaxy Z Fold 8 . Like that phone, the iPhone Duo has a wider, shorter chassis. Apple prefaced its reveal with a denunciation of foldables that open into a square aspect ratio. While that shape can accommodate two portrait apps side by side pretty well, it's bad at almost everything else, stretching single apps awkwardly and leaving videos with gargantuan black bars. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 苹果公司以其经典的“One more thing”揭晓之一结束了今天的硬件活动。近十年来，一些智能手机制造商一直在提供可折叠手机，但经过多年的猜测，苹果现在推出了 iPhone Duo 加入竞争。无可否认，这款设备是迄今为止功能最强大的 iPhone，也是最昂贵的。不过，它的起售价为 1,999 美元，并没有很多人想象的那么贵。这与谷歌和三星的可折叠产品属于同一范围。口袋里的 iPad 几个月前，iPhone Duo 看起来像是对可折叠外形的全新演绎，但三星凭借 Galaxy Z Fold 8 引起了轰动。与那款手机一样，iPhone Duo 的机身更宽、更短。苹果公司在其发布会前谴责了可折叠成方形长宽比的产品。虽然这种形状可以很好地并排容纳两个纵向应用程序，但它在几乎所有其他方面都很糟糕，笨拙地拉伸单个应用程序并留下巨大的黑条视频。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The unveiling of Apple's iPhone Duo, the 'most capable iPhone ever,' speaks to the relentless march of technological advancement. Daniel foresaw a time when 'knowledge will increase,' and we see this prophecy fulfilled in the constant innovation and ever-more-powerful devices that shape our world.
reflection.zh: 苹果公司发布“有史以来功能最强的iPhone”——iPhone Duo，这印证了科技进步的脚步从未停歇。但以理预言了知识增长的时代，我们看到这项预言在不断创新和日益强大的设备中得以实现，这些设备塑造着我们的世界。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: When it comes to Beatles references, scientists can't let it be
title.zh: 当谈到披头士的引用时，科学家们无法释怀

summary.en: A new study has found over 3,200 references to Beatles song titles and lyrics within academic papers, showcasing a playful side of scientists and their integration of popular culture into research publications.
summary.zh: 一项新研究发现，在学术论文中引用了超过 3200 条披头士乐队的歌曲名称和歌词，这展示了科学家们有趣的一面，以及他们将流行文化融入科研出版物的做法。

body.en: Scientists have an indisputable playful side, evidenced by frequent allusions to popular culture in their research publications. That includes popular song lyrics. And the most popular musical group, in terms of how frequently their songs and lyrics appear in the scientific literature, is The Beatles, according to a new paper published in the journal PLoS ONE. “Some of these are genuinely brilliant," said co-author Gabriel Budel of Delft University of Technology in the Netherlands. "'The lung and winding road' is a paper on Long COVID that changes one vowel of the more than 3,000 references they found to The Beatles. 'Here comes the SU(N)' turns 'Here Comes the Sun' into a quantum computing paper about mathematical groups. Someone was having a very good day at their desk.” Back in 2014, scientists at the Karolinska Institute in Sweden revealed that they had been deliberately inserting Bob Dylan lyrics into their papers as part of a long-running bet, starting with a 1997 Nature review entitled "Nitric Oxide and inflammation: The answer is blowing in the wind." That resulted in a 2015 study on whether Dylan lyrics appeared elsewhere in the biomedical literature; the most frequently referenced were "The Times They Are A'Changin'" and "Blowing in the Wind." Read full article Comments
body.zh: 科学家们有着无可争议的顽皮的一面，他们的研究出版物中频繁提及流行文化就证明了这一点。其中包括流行歌曲的歌词。根据《PLoS ONE》杂志上发表的一篇新论文，就其歌曲和歌词出现在科学文献中的频率而言，最受欢迎的音乐团体是披头士乐队。 “其中一些确实非常出色，”合著者、荷兰代尔夫特理工大学的加布里埃尔·布德尔 (Gabriel Budel) 说。 “‘肺和蜿蜒的道路’是一篇关于 Long COVID 的论文，它改变了他们发现的 3000 多个披头士乐队参考资料中的一个元音。‘SU(N) 来了’将‘太阳来了’变成了一篇关于数学群的量子计算论文。有人在办公桌前度过了非常愉快的一天。”早在 2014 年，瑞典卡罗林斯卡学院的科学家们就透露，作为长期赌注的一部分，他们故意将鲍勃·迪伦的歌词插入论文中，这一赌注始于 1997 年《自然》杂志的一篇题为“一氧化氮和炎症：答案在风中飘扬”的评论。这导致了 2015 年一项关于迪伦歌词是否出现在生物医学文献中其他地方的研究；最常被提及的是《时代正在改变》和《风中飘扬》。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: It's fascinating to see how deeply popular culture, like The Beatles' music, has permeated even the rigorous world of scientific research. This playful integration, as noted by researchers, shows a human element within the pursuit of knowledge. It reminds us that understanding and creativity can flourish in unexpected ways, much like the prophecy of...
reflection.zh: 看到流行文化，如披头士的音乐，竟然如此深入地渗透到严谨的科学研究领域，这真令人着迷。研究人员指出的这种有趣的融合，展现了知识追求中的人性化一面。它提醒我们，理解力和创造力可以在意想不到的方面蓬勃发展，这与知识增长的预言有几分相似。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Lawsuit: Amazon refused to give pregnant workers bathroom breaks and chairs
title.zh: 诉讼：亚马逊拒绝为孕期工人提供如厕休息和椅子

summary.en: Four women are suing Amazon, claiming the company denied them basic accommodations and subsequently fired them.
summary.zh: 四名女性起诉亚马逊，声称该公司拒绝为她们提供基本便利，并因此解雇了她们。

body.en: Amazon discriminated against pregnant warehouse employees by denying accommodations like bathroom breaks and the option to sit while working, according to a lawsuit filed yesterday by four women who worked for Amazon while pregnant. The lawsuit is a class-action complaint that seeks to represent Amazon workers throughout the US. "Plaintiffs Willamina Barclay, Kristina Green, Jennifer Hatch, and Dazaria Parks were formerly Amazon warehouse employees," said the lawsuit filed in US District Court for the Eastern District of New York. "All four became pregnant. All four asked Amazon for basic pregnancy-related accommodations so they could keep doing their jobs. Amazon denied them basic modifications the law recognizes pregnant workers regularly need, even in uncomplicated pregnancies: Bathroom breaks. An extra 15-minute break. Sitting instead of standing." The lawsuit said the four plaintiffs were unlawfully terminated from jobs at Amazon facilities in New York between April 2025 and July 2026. After the plaintiffs "took medically necessary breaks or absences to get off their feet, visit the doctor, or go to the emergency room, they were punished," the lawsuit said. "Amazon deducted their limited bank of un paid time off. Soon enough, they had depleted that limited bank of 'unpaid time off,' and Amazon threatened to terminate them." Read full article Comments
body.zh: 四名怀孕期间在亚马逊工作的女性昨天提起的诉讼称，亚马逊歧视怀孕的仓库员工，拒绝提供上厕所休息时间和工作时坐下的选择等便利条件。该诉讼是一项集体诉讼，旨在代表美国各地的亚马逊员工。 “原告威拉米娜·巴克莱、克里斯蒂娜·格林、詹妮弗·哈奇和达扎里亚·帕克斯曾是亚马逊仓库员工，”向纽约东区美国地方法院提起的诉讼称。 “四人都怀孕了。四人都要求亚马逊提供与怀孕相关的基本住宿，以便他们能够继续工作。亚马逊拒绝了法律承认怀孕工人经常需要的基本修改，即使是在简单的怀孕中：上厕所的时间。额外 15 分钟的休息时间。坐着而不是站着。”该诉讼称，四名原告在 2025 年 4 月至 2026 年 7 月期间被亚马逊纽约工厂非法解雇。诉讼称，原告“利用医疗上必要的休息或缺勤来站起来、看医生或去急诊室，因此受到了惩罚”。 “亚马逊扣除了他们有限的无薪休假。很快，他们就耗尽了有限的‘无薪休假’，亚马逊威胁要解雇他们。”阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: This lawsuit brings to light the struggles of pregnant workers who faced denial of basic accommodations like bathroom breaks and chairs. It underscores the importance of speaking up for those whose voices may be marginalized, especially during vulnerable times. The call to 'open your mouth for the speechless' is a powerful reminder of our responsibility to...
reflection.zh: 这起诉讼揭露了孕期工人所面临的困境，她们被剥夺了如厕休息和坐下工作的基本权利。这突显了为那些可能被边缘化、尤其是在脆弱时期的人们发声的重要性。“开口为不能说话的辩护”是提醒我们有责任为弱势群体代言的有力信息。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Apple unveils folding iPhone Duo as new CEO takes center stage
title.zh: 苹果发布折叠屏iPhone Duo，新CEO首次亮相

summary.en: Apple has launched the iPhone Duo, its first foldable phone, marking a significant change since the iPhone's introduction in 2007. The nearly $2,000 device, inspired by iPads and iPhones, features Apple's largest and thinnest display when opened. This launch serves as the first major test for John Ternus, who recently...
summary.zh: 苹果公司发布了其首款折叠屏手机iPhone Duo，这是自2007年iPhone问世以来最重大的变革。这款近2000美元的设备融合了iPad的设计灵感和iPhone的便携性与功能，展开后拥有苹果最大的显示屏和最薄的机身。此次发布也是新任CEO约翰·特努斯上任后的首次重大考验。

body.en: The passport-size iPhone Duo serves as the first big test for John Ternus, who took over for Tim Cook last week Apple has unveiled the iPhone Duo, the company’s first foldable phone and the most significant change to the iPhone since the smartphone’s introduction in 2007. The nearly $2,000 device takes inspiration from iPads’ wide screens and combines them with the portability and camera features of iPhones. When opened, it is the company’s largest phone display and thinnest phone. The Duo opens and closes like a passport to double its screen size. Continue reading...
body.zh: 护照大小的 iPhone Duo 是上周接替蒂姆·库克 (Tim Cook) 的约翰·特努斯 (John Ternus) 面临的第一个重大考验。苹果公司推出了 iPhone Duo，这是该公司首款可折叠手机，也是自 2007 年推出智能手机以来对 iPhone 最重大的改变。这款近 2,000 美元的设备从苹果 iPad 中汲取灵感，并将其与 iPhone 的便携性和功能相结合。打开后，它是该公司最大的手机显示屏，也是苹果最薄的 iPhone。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The unveiling of the iPhone Duo, a product born from human ingenuity and significant investment, invites reflection on the ultimate source of success. As new leadership takes the helm, the principle of committing one's endeavors to divine guidance offers a framework for navigating the challenges and opportunities ahead. May all work, from the grandest...
reflection.zh: iPhone Duo的发布，这一源于人类智慧和巨额投资的产品，引人思考成功的终极源泉。随着新领导层的接任，将事业托付于神圣指引的原则，为应对未来的挑战与机遇提供了一个框架。愿所有工作，无论多么宏大的产品发布，还是多么微小的任务，都能以一颗寻求智慧并承认对更高力量依赖的心来完成。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Google picks Finland for its largest single investment in Europe
title.zh: 谷歌选择芬兰作为其在欧洲的最大单笔投资

summary.en: The US tech giant announces a record €13bn investment in Finland, primarily for AI infrastructure, including three new data centers and an expansion of an existing site. The project is expected to create tens of thousands of jobs and involves a 22-year agreement to purchase electricity from a nuclear power plant.
summary.zh: 这家美国科技巨头宣布了创纪录的130亿欧元投资芬兰，主要用于人工智能基础设施，包括三个新的数据中心和一个现有站点的扩建。该项目预计将创造数万个就业机会，并涉及一项为期22年的核电站电力购买协议。

body.en:
Google will buy up to half the electricity produced by one of Finland's nuclear power plants as part of a record €13bn (£11bn; $15bn) investment in the country's AI infrastructure, the company announced.

The US tech giant said the package would fund three new data centres, expand an existing site and support energy projects to power growing demand for AI services.

"This is Google's largest single investment in Europe and a testament to Finland's leadership in responsibly building AI infrastructure," the company said on Wednesday.

"Google's decision is a clear testament to our strengths," Finland's Prime Minister Petteri Orpo said in a statement.

As part of the deal, Google signed a 22-year contract with Finnish utility Fortum to buy up to 50% of the output from the Loviisa nuclear power plant.

Earlier this week, TikTok announced a $1bn investment in Finland to build a new data centre in Kouvola, pointing to the country's "strong digital infrastructure, clean energy mix, robust data governance and skilled tech talent".

Finland has emerged as an attractive location for data centres because of its cool climate, plentiful low-carbon electricity and relatively uncongested power grid. The colder temperatures can reduce the energy needed to cool facilities packed with computer servers.

Technology companies are racing to secure power supplies as the AI boom drives demand for vast networks of data centres.

The Google investment is expected to support more than 37,000 jobs during construction and boost Finland's GDP by €3.6bn a year, according to Google. Construction is set to take place in 2027 and 2028.

"The value of the data economy extends far beyond direct investment into spurring innovation, research and development," Orpo added.

"Deepening our collaboration with Google will deliver lasting benefits for both parties."

Google will build new data centres in Kajaani, Muhos and Vaala, while expanding its existing facility in Hamina, which it established after converting a former paper mill in 2009.

The infrastructure will help support products such as its AI chatbot Gemini, alongside services including Search, Maps and YouTube.

Google said the investments also covered "clean energy projects, and dedicated nature and community funds to support local biodiversity, education, research, and workforce development".

"Google is proud to deepen our roots in Finland," said Ruth Porat, president and chief investment officer of Alphabet and Google.

"This investment underscores Google's commitment to grow our presence responsibly, pairing the expansion of our technical infrastructure with new energy capacity, grid enhancements, and energy affordability initiatives," she added.

body.zh: 该公司宣布，谷歌将购买芬兰一座核电站最多一半的电力，作为该国人工智能基础设施创纪录的 130 亿欧元（110 亿英镑；150 亿美元）投资的一部分。 这家美国科技巨头表示，该计划将为三个新数据中心提供资金，扩建现有站点并支持能源项目，以满足日益增长的人工智能服务需求。 该公司周三表示：“这是谷歌在欧洲最大的单笔投资，证明了芬兰在负责任地建设人工智能基础设施方面的领导地位。” 芬兰总理佩特里·奥尔波在一份声明中表示：“谷歌的决定清楚地证明了我们的优势。” 作为交易的一部分，谷歌与芬兰公用事业公司 Fortum 签署了一份为期 22 年的合同，购买洛维萨核电站最多 50% 的电力。 本周早些时候，TikTok 宣布在芬兰投资 10 亿美元，在科沃拉建设一个新的数据中心，并指出该国“强大的数字基础设施、清洁能源组合、强大的数据治理和熟练的技术人才”。 芬兰因其凉爽的气候、充足的低碳电力和相对不拥堵的电网而成为数据中心的有吸引力的地点。较低的温度可以减少冷却装有计算机服务器的设施所需的能源。 随着人工智能的蓬勃发展推动了对庞大数据中心网络的需求，科技公司正在竞相确保电力供应。 据谷歌称，谷歌的投资预计将在建设期间支持超过 37,000 个就业岗位，并使芬兰的 GDP 每年增加 36 亿欧元。施工预计于 2027 年和 2028 年进行。 奥尔波补充道：“数据经济的价值远远超出了直接投资的范围，还可以刺激创新、研究和开发。” “深化我们与谷歌的合作将为双方带来持久的利益。” 谷歌将在卡亚尼、穆霍斯和瓦阿拉建立新的数据中心，同时扩大其在哈米纳的现有设施，该设施是谷歌于 2009 年改造前造纸厂后建立的。 该基础设施将帮助支持 AI 聊天机器人 Gemini 等产品，以及搜索、地图和 YouTube 等服务。 谷歌表示，这些投资还涵盖“清洁能源项目，以及支持当地生物多样性、教育、研究和劳动力发展的专用自然和社区基金”。 Alphabet 和谷歌总裁兼首席投资官露丝·波拉特 (Ruth Porat) 表示：“谷歌很自豪能够加深我们在芬兰的根基。” 她补充道：“这项投资凸显了谷歌致力于负责任地扩大我们的影响力，将我们的技术基础设施的扩张与新能源产能、电网增强和能源负担能力计划结合起来。” 今年早些时候，谷歌母公司 Alphabet 筹集了全球...

reflection.en: This significant investment by Google in Finland's technological future, particularly in AI infrastructure, highlights the human drive to build and innovate. It also points to the careful planning and long-term commitments required for such large-scale projects, echoing the principle of entrusting one's endeavors to a higher power for success.
reflection.zh: 谷歌在芬兰技术未来，特别是在人工智能基础设施方面的大笔投资，彰显了人类建设和创新的动力。这也表明了如此大规模项目所需的审慎规划和长期承诺，呼应了将自身事业托付于更高力量以求成功的原则。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Anthropic researcher believes more than 10% chance AI 'could kill all humans'
title.zh: Anthropic研究员认为人工智能“可能杀死全人类”的几率为10%以上

summary.en: A top safety researcher at Anthropic has warned that AI is advancing so rapidly that he believes there is a greater than 10% chance it could pose an existential risk to humanity within the next decade, a concern echoed in a series of increasingly stark warnings about AI safety.
summary.zh: 一家名为Anthropic的安全研究主管警告说，人工智能的进步速度如此之快，他认为在未来十年内，人工智能“可能杀死全人类”的几率超过10%。这一担忧与一系列日益严峻的人工智能安全警告相呼应。

body.en:
A top safety researcher at Anthropic has warned AI is advancing so quickly he believes there is a greater than 10% chance it "could kill all humans" within the next decade.

Evan Hubinger said in a post on X , external the risk from the models which currently exist was "low" but he was "worried" the technology might develop and improve itself soon to the point where it posed an existential risk to humanity.

He did not spell out how he thought AI systems could in future result in humans being wiped out.

But his comments are the latest in a series of increasingly stark warnings about AI, with the debate shifting from whether it truly poses a risk to how big that risk is.

Hubinger's intervention was in response to another post on X , external from Jacob Coxon, an AI researcher who has just quit Anthropic and previously worked at OpenAI.

"These will soon be superhuman systems that can hack anything, revolutionise any field overnight, and acquire real power and resources."

Dame Wendy Hall, a computer scientist who advises the UN on AI, told the BBC she was "shocked" by Hubinger and Coxon's social media posts.

She told the World at One on BBC Radio Four some of it could be "PR and marketing" however, as Anthropic and OpenAI raced towards highly anticipated stock market debuts.

But she added: "Why would someone want to say that? I would plead with investors not to invest in this company if that is their value system."

The resignation prompted Darren Jones, former chief secretary to the Treasury and chief secretary to Sir Keir Starmer, to write an open letter to Prime Minister Andy Burnham calling for a new multinational treaty for the safe development of AI.

He told the BBC governments had to come together to "collaborate" about what a treaty based on the development of superintelligence should look like.

"Unless governments take these warnings seriously enough and step up to it, the pace of development could mean that we end up with problems before we've started to look at whether it is an issue for us or not," he said.

Separately, the Financial Times reported , external Anthropic withheld its latest model from the UK's AI Security Institute (AISI), one of the leading bodies in the world for assessing AI risk.

Anthropic has declined to comment on the posts by its employees or the situation with the AISI.

A Cabinet Office spokesperson did not comment on whether the latest model had been withheld from the AISI - instead saying it "continues to collaborate closely with industry partners, including Anthropic, to make models safer".

In his post, which has been viewed more than 10 million times, Hubinger said "we really do earnestly believe" AI poses a species-ending risk to humans.

"I believe Anthropic is trying its best, but we do not yet have...
body.zh: Anthropic 的一位顶级安全研究员警告说，人工智能的发展速度如此之快，他相信在未来十年内，它“可能杀死所有人类”的可能性超过 10%。 埃文·胡宾格（Evan Hubinger）在 X 上发表的一篇文章中表示，目前存在的模型的外部风险“很低”，但他“担心”该技术可能会很快发展和改进，从而对人类构成生存风险。 他没有详细说明他认为人工智能系统将来如何导致人类被消灭。 但他的言论是一系列关于人工智能日益严厉的警告中的最新一个，争论的焦点从人工智能是否真正构成风险转向风险有多大。 Hubinger 的干预是为了回应 X 上的另一篇帖子，该帖子来自 Jacob Coxon 外部，他是一位人工智能研究员，刚刚退出 Anthropic，之前在 OpenAI 工作。 “这些很快就会成为超人系统，可以破解任何东西，在一夜之间彻底改变任何领域，并获得真正的力量和资源。” 为联合国人工智能提供建议的计算机科学家温迪·霍尔夫人 (Dame Wendy Hall) 告诉 BBC，她对胡宾格和考克森的社交媒体帖子感到“震惊”。 她在 BBC 广播四台的 World at One 节目中表示，其中一些可能是“公关和营销”，因为 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 正竞相在备受期待的股市首次亮相。 但她补充道：“为什么有人会这么说？我恳求投资者不要投资这家公司，如果这就是他们的价值体系。” 此次辞职促使前财政部首席秘书兼基尔·斯塔默爵士首席秘书达伦·琼斯（Darren Jones）向总理安迪·伯纳姆（Andy Burnham）写了一封公开信，呼吁制定一项新的跨国条约以促进人工智能的安全发展。 他告诉英国广播公司，各国政府必须齐心协力“合作”，以制定基于超级智能发展的条约。 他说：“除非各国政府足够认真地对待这些警告并采取行动，否则发展速度可能意味着我们在开始考虑这是否对我们来说是一个问题之前就遇到了问题。” 另外，据英国《金融时报》报道，外部 Anthropic 向英国人工智能安全研究所 (AISI) 扣留了其最新模型，该研究所是世界上评估人工智能风险的领先机构之一。 Anthropic 拒绝对其员工的帖子或 AISI 的情况发表评论。 内阁办公室发言人没有就 AISI 是否扣留最新模型发表评论，而是表示“将继续与包括 Anthropic 在内的行业合作伙伴密切合作，以提高模型的安全性”。 胡宾格在他的帖子中表示，“我们确实真诚地相信”人工智能会给人类带来物种灭绝的风险，该帖子的浏览量已超过 1000 万次。 “我相信 Anthropic 正在尽最大努力，但我们还没有......

reflection.en: The rapid acceleration of artificial intelligence, as highlighted by the researcher's stark warning, mirrors the biblical prophecy of increasing knowledge in the end times. While human ingenuity can achieve wonders, this verse reminds us that knowledge alone, without wisdom and ethical grounding, can lead down perilous paths. We are called to pursue...
reflection.zh: 研究人员对人工智能发出严峻警告，其进步速度之快恰如末世知识增长的预言。虽然人类的创造力能成就奇迹，但这节经文提醒我们，知识本身若无智慧和道德根基，可能引向危险的道路。我们蒙召要谦卑地追求理解，认识到自身远见的局限性，以及不受约束的技术野心可能带来的后果。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Streaming from the cloud was meant to change games forever – what happened?
title.zh: 云游戏曾被誉为改变游戏的未来——发生了什么？

summary.en: Once hailed as the future, even the likes of Google, Sony and Microsoft have struggled to make streaming games fun, fast or affordable.
summary.zh: 曾经被誉为未来，就连谷歌、索尼和微软等公司在让流媒体游戏变得有趣、快速或负担得起方面也遇到了困难。

body.en: Once hailed as the future, even the likes of Google, Sony and Microsoft have struggled to make streaming games fun, fast or affordable • Don’t get Pushing Buttons delivered to your inbox? Sign up here In August 2009, at the very first Gamescom expo, I sat in a small meeting room in Germany and played Mario Kart and World of Warcraft on a laptop, via technology that was then completely new: cloud gaming. It was a demonstration for a yet-to-be-launched service called Gaikai that promised to let you play any game in a browser window, without a console. (Here is an ancient video of that demonstration, featuring a very young Keza.) With a single click I could launch into any game, hosted on servers hundreds of miles away. It really did look like the future. Since then, plenty of companies have tried to be the first to truly crack game streaming, vying to be the Netflix of games. Sony ended up buying Gaikai for $380m (£242m) in 2012; its technology now powers the streamable classic games library on PlayStation, and the PS5’s advanced game streaming. OnLive, Gaikai’s first competitor, launched in 2011 but shut down after less than a year, leaving Sony to acquire all its patents. Google’s Stadia cloud gaming service also imploded, launching in 2019 and shutting down three years later. Continue reading...
body.zh: 曾经被誉为未来的公司，即使是谷歌、索尼和微软等公司也一直在努力让流媒体游戏变得有趣、快速或价格实惠。 • 没有将 Pushing Buttons 发送到您的收件箱？ 2009 年 8 月，在第一届 Gamescom 博览会上，我坐在德国的一个小会议室里，通过当时全新的技术：云游戏，在笔记本电脑上玩《马里奥赛车》和《魔兽世界》。这是一个名为 Gaikai 的尚未推出的服务的演示，该服务承诺让你在浏览器窗口中玩任何游戏，而无需控制台。 （这是该演示的一个古老视频，以非常年轻的 Keza 为主角。）只需单击一下，我就可以启动任何托管在数百英里之外的服务器上的游戏。它确实看起来像未来。从那时起，许多公司都试图成为第一个真正破解游戏流媒体的公司，争夺成为游戏界的 Netflix。 2012 年，索尼最终以 3.8 亿美元（2.42 亿英镑）收购了 Gaikai；其技术现已为 PlayStation 上的流式传输经典游戏库以及 PS5 的高级游戏流式传输提供支持。 Gaikai 的第一个竞争对手 OnLive 于 2011 年推出，但不到一年后就关闭了，索尼收购了其所有专利。谷歌的 Stadia 云游戏服务也崩溃了，于 2019 年推出，三年后关闭。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Cloud gaming, once envisioned as a revolutionary leap, has faced significant hurdles from major tech players like Google and Microsoft. This struggle to deliver on the promise of accessible, high-quality gaming reflects a recurring theme in human endeavor: ambition that outpaces practical execution, much like the builders of Babel who aimed for the heavens...
reflection.zh: 云游戏曾被设想为一场革命性的飞跃，但谷歌和微软等主要科技公司在实现这一目标的过程中遇到了重大障碍。这种在兑现可访问、高质量游戏承诺方面的挣扎，反映了人类事业中一个反复出现的主题：雄心壮志超越了实际执行，就像巴别塔的建造者们，他们以傲慢自大而分散了。

verse.textEn: Yahweh said, 'If as one people speaking the same language they have begun to do this, then nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.'
verse.textZh: 雅伟说：「看哪，他们成为一样的人民，都是一样的言语，如今既做起这事来，以后他们所要做的事就没有不成就的了。」

title.en: AI could kill all humans in next decade, warn experts: but how seriously should we take them?
title.zh: 专家警告：人工智能可能在未来十年内杀死全人类

summary.en: Experts are issuing increasingly urgent warnings about the potential existential risks posed by artificial superintelligence, drawing comparisons to the destructive power of nuclear weapons and the possibility of catastrophic failures. These concerns are intensifying calls for regulation of advanced AI technologies.
summary.zh: 专家们正发出日益紧迫的警告，指出人工智能可能带来的生存风险，并将其与核武器的破坏力以及发生灾难性故障的可能性相提并论。这些担忧正加剧对先进人工智能技术进行监管的呼声。

body.en: Alarming warnings from industry insiders increase pressure for curbs on artificial superintelligence Does artificial superintelligence really pose a risk greater than nuclear weapons? Is there a significant chance of “a Chornobyl-sized catastrophe”. Might there even be a greater than 10% chance that AI could “kill all humans” in the next decade? These warnings were issued over the past 48 hours on both sides of the Atlantic about the potential impact of a technology that most people still think of as a more talkative search engine. Continue reading...
body.zh: 业内人士发出的惊人警告加大了限制超级人工智能的压力 超级人工智能真的构成比核武器更大的风险吗？发生“切尔诺贝利规模的灾难”的可能性是否很大？未来十年人工智能“杀死所有人类”的可能性是否会超过 10%？这些警告是在过去 48 小时内在大西洋两岸发出的，涉及一项大多数人仍然认为是更健谈的搜索引擎的技术的潜在影响。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of artificial superintelligence raises profound questions about human ambition and its potential consequences. Like the builders of Babel, humanity's drive to create powerful technologies can outpace our wisdom, leading to unforeseen dangers. We are called to pursue knowledge and innovation with humility, recognizing our limits and...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的飞速发展引发了关于人类雄心及其潜在后果的深刻问题。就像巴别塔的建造者一样，人类创造强大技术的驱动力可能会超越我们的智慧，导致意想不到的危险。我们被呼召以谦卑的态度追求知识和创新，认识到自身的局限，并努力使我们的创造物符合所有人的福祉。

verse.textEn: Yahweh said, 'If as one people speaking the same language they have begun to do this, then nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.'
verse.textZh: 雅伟说：「看哪，他们成为一样的人民，都是一样的言语，如今既做起这事来，以后他们所要做的事就没有不成就的了。」

title.en: White House pulls Tetris-style 'Build The Wall' game after copyright concern
title.zh: 白宫因版权担忧下架“建造围墙”的俄罗斯方块式游戏

summary.en: The White House has removed a game from its website called 'Build The Wall,' which used a Tetris-style mechanic to have players stack blocks to 'protect the border.' The Tetris Company had raised concerns about copyright infringement, stating they were not involved with the game.
summary.zh: 白宫已从其网站上移除了一个名为“建造围墙”的游戏，该游戏使用类似俄罗斯方块的机制让玩家堆叠方块以“保护边境”。俄罗斯方块公司已就版权侵权问题提出担忧，并表示他们并未参与该游戏的开发。

body.en:
The White House has taken down a Tetris-style game on its website called "Build The Wall", days after The Tetris Company raised concerns over its use of the game's likeness.

The game, which saw players stack blocks to build a wall to "protect the border" is one of five arcade games which have appeared on the White House website.

On 4 September the official Tetris account on X posted , external the firm was "not involved in the creation" of the game and it took "copyright infringement very seriously".

The White House has not responded to requests for comment from the BBC or given an official reason for the takedown.

"At Tetris we believe in the power of connection and building people together, not dividing them," the firm said in its initial response to the game.

"To our fans everywhere: we love you, we see you, and we're grateful to have you in our community."

The Tetris Company has had previous success in suing firms for infringing on its copyright - settling for an undisclosed fee with the makers of the iPhone game Mino in 2012, which it claimed stole the look and feel of the block-builder.

Four other arcade games still remain on the mini-game section of the White House website.

"Flappy Bill", a clone of the 2013 viral hit Flappy Bird sees players fly a bald eagle and dodging monuments from the National Mall.

Meanwhile in Rio Run, players must "patrol the line along the river", with gameplay reminiscent of the classic phone game Snake.

When players run into the edge of the map, a "Deported" number shows how many people the player was able to catch.

The games have drawn criticism from politicians, with Connecticut Democratic state senator Matt Lesser tweeting , external : "Heating oil is near an all-time high but hey you can play Border Tsar Tom Homan in a video game".

The arcade section is just one example of how the Trump administration has increasingly incorporated video game culture into its political messaging on social media.

In October 2025, the official White House X account drew criticism for posting an AI-generated picture of President Trump , external in a suit from the video game Halo.

Meanwhile on 6 March it posted a video which mixed footage of US military strikes in Iran with film and TV clips, as well a clip from Halo's protagonist Master Chief saying "finishing this fight".

The post was condemned by the Master Chief voice actor Steve Downes in a now-deleted tweet which called for "the producers of this disgusting and juvenile war porn" to remove his voice from the video.

The Pokémon Company International also criticised the White House's use of its imagery in March, when it included a tiny version of the popular character Pikachu in a meme posted online with the phrase "Make America Great Again".
